==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Fortify\CreateNewUser.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Fortify;

use App\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\CreatesNewUsers;

class CreateNewUser implements CreatesNewUsers
{
    use PasswordValidationRules, ProfileValidationRules;

    /**
     * Validate and create a newly registered customer.
     *
     * @param  array<string, string>  $input
     */
    public function create(array $input): User
    {
        $input['phone'] = User::normalizePhone($input['phone'] ?? '');

        Validator::make($input, [
            ...$this->profileRules(),
            'phone' => $this->phoneRules(),
            'password' => $this->passwordRules(),
        ])->validate();

        return User::create([
            'name' => $input['name'],
            'email' => $input['email'],
            'phone' => $input['phone'],
            'password' => $input['password'],
            'role' => UserRole::Customer,
            'city' => config('sejuk.city'),
        ]);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Fortify\ResetUserPassword.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Fortify;

use App\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\ResetsUserPasswords;

class ResetUserPassword implements ResetsUserPasswords
{
    use PasswordValidationRules;

    /**
     * Validate and reset the user's forgotten password.
     *
     * @param  array<string, string>  $input
     */
    public function reset(User $user, array $input): void
    {
        Validator::make($input, [
            'password' => $this->passwordRules(),
        ])->validate();

        $user->forceFill([
            'password' => $input['password'],
        ])->save();
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Payouts\RecordPayout.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Payouts;

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payout;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Admin confirms a bank transfer to a technician covering every forwarded order not yet paid out.
 */
class RecordPayout
{
    public function handle(TechnicianProfile $technician, User $admin, ?string $reference): Payout
    {
        $account = $technician->payoutAccount;

        if ($account === null) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Teknisi ini belum mengisi rekening pencairan.');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($technician, $admin, $reference, $account) {
            $orders = $technician->orders()
                ->where('fund_status', FundStatus::Diteruskan)
                ->whereNull('payout_id')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get();

            if ($orders->isEmpty()) {
                throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Tidak ada saldo yang perlu dicairkan.');
            }

            $payout = $technician->payouts()->create([
                'amount' => (int) $orders->sum(fn (Order $order) => $order->technicianPayout()),
                'bank_name' => $account->bank_name,
                'account_name' => $account->account_name,
                'account_number' => $account->account_number,
                'status' => Payout::STATUS_TRANSFERRED,
                'transferred_at' => now(),
                'reference' => $reference,
                'created_by' => $admin->id,
            ]);

            Order::whereKey($orders->modelKeys())->update(['fund_status' => FundStatus::Dicairkan, 'payout_id' => $payout->id]);

            return $payout;
        });
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Reviews\SubmitReview.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Reviews;

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Review;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * L-11: the customer rates a finished order. The technician's rating is updated incrementally
 * so it keeps reviews collected before this order (including imported history).
 */
class SubmitReview
{
    public function handle(Order $order, int $rating, ?string $comment): Review
    {
        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::Selesai || $order->technician_id === null) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Ulasan hanya bisa diberikan untuk pesanan yang sudah selesai.');
        }

        if ($order->review()->exists()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Kamu sudah memberi ulasan untuk pesanan ini.');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $rating, $comment) {
            $review = $order->review()->create([
                'customer_id' => $order->customer_id,
                'technician_id' => $order->technician_id,
                'rating' => $rating,
                'comment' => $comment,
            ]);

            $technician = TechnicianProfile::whereKey($order->technician_id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $count = $technician->reviews_count;

            $technician->update([
                'rating_avg' => round(($technician->rating_avg * $count + $rating) / ($count + 1), 1),
                'reviews_count' => $count + 1,
            ]);

            return $review;
        });
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Reviews\ToggleReviewVisibility.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Reviews;

use App\Models\Review;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Admin hides a review that breaks the rules, or shows it again. The technician's rating is
 * adjusted the same incremental way SubmitReview adds it.
 */
class ToggleReviewVisibility
{
    public function handle(Review $review): Review
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($review) {
            $technician = TechnicianProfile::whereKey($review->technician_id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $count = $technician->reviews_count;
            $total = $technician->rating_avg * $count;

            if ($review->is_hidden) {
                $count++;
                $total += $review->rating;
            } else {
                $count = max(0, $count - 1);
                $total = max(0, $total - $review->rating);
            }

            $technician->update([
                'reviews_count' => $count,
                'rating_avg' => $count > 0 ? round($total / $count, 1) : 0,
            ]);

            $review->update(['is_hidden' => ! $review->is_hidden]);

            return $review;
        });
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Technician\RegisterTechnician.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Technician;

use App\Enums\DocumentStatus;
use App\Enums\DocumentType;
use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\TechnicianDocument;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Geocoder;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Creates a technician account waiting for verification, with its identity and competency proof.
 */
class RegisterTechnician
{
    public function __construct(private Geocoder $geocoder) {}

    /**
     * @param  array{name: string, business_name: string, phone: string, email: string, password: string, area: string, service_id: int, radius: int}  $account
     * @param  array{years: int, reference_phone: string, description: string}|null  $experience
     */
    public function handle(array $account, UploadedFile $ktp, ?UploadedFile $certificate, ?array $experience): User
    {
        $coordinates = $this->geocoder->search($account['area']);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($account, $ktp, $certificate, $experience, $coordinates) {
            $user = User::create([
                'name' => $account['name'],
                'email' => $account['email'],
                'phone' => $account['phone'],
                'password' => $account['password'],
                'role' => UserRole::Technician,
                'city' => config('sejuk.city'),
            ]);

            $technician = $user->technicianProfile()->create([
                'business_name' => $account['business_name'],
                'slug' => $this->uniqueSlug($account['business_name']),
                'years_experience' => $experience['years'] ?? 0,
                'service_radius_km' => $account['radius'],
                'base_area' => $account['area'],
                'latitude' => $coordinates['latitude'] ?? config('sejuk.default_location.latitude'),
                'longitude' => $coordinates['longitude'] ?? config('sejuk.default_location.longitude'),
                'badge' => TechnicianBadge::Terdaftar,
                'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Pending,
                'is_accepting_orders' => false,
            ]);

            $technician->services()->attach($account['service_id']);
            $technician->serviceAreas()->create(['area_name' => Str::before($account['area'], ',')]);

            $this->storeDocument($technician, DocumentType::Ktp, $ktp);

            if ($certificate !== null) {
                $this->storeDocument($technician, DocumentType::Sertifikat, $certificate);
            }

            if ($experience !== null) {
                $technician->experience()->create($experience);
            }

            return $user;
        });
    }

    private function storeDocument(TechnicianProfile $technician, DocumentType $type, UploadedFile $file): void
    {
        $technician->documents()->create([
            'type' => $type,
            'path' => $file->store("technician-documents/{$technician->id}", TechnicianDocument::DISK),
            'status' => DocumentStatus::Pending,
        ]);
    }

    private function uniqueSlug(string $businessName): string
    {
        $base = Str::slug($businessName) ?: 'teknisi';
        $slug = $base;

        while (TechnicianProfile::where('slug', $slug)->exists()) {
            $slug = $base.'-'.Str::lower(Str::random(4));
        }

        return $slug;
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Actions\Technician\ReviewTechnicianVerification.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Actions\Technician;

use App\Enums\DocumentStatus;
use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\TechnicianVerificationReviewed;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * An admin's decision on a pending technician: approve with a badge, or reject with a reason.
 */
class ReviewTechnicianVerification
{
    /**
     * Weekly windows given to newly approved technicians until they set their own schedule.
     *
     * @var list<int>
     */
    private const DEFAULT_WORK_DAYS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];

    public function approve(TechnicianProfile $technician, TechnicianBadge $badge, User $admin): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($technician, $badge, $admin) {
            $technician->update([
                'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Approved,
                'verification_note' => null,
                'verified_at' => now(),
                'badge' => $badge,
                'is_active' => true,
                'is_accepting_orders' => true,
            ]);

            $technician->documents()->update([
                'status' => DocumentStatus::Approved,
                'reviewed_by' => $admin->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            if (! $technician->availabilities()->exists()) {
                foreach (self::DEFAULT_WORK_DAYS as $day) {
                    foreach ([TimeWindow::Pagi, TimeWindow::Siang, TimeWindow::Sore] as $window) {
                        $technician->availabilities()->create(['day_of_week' => $day, 'time_window' => $window, 'is_available' => true]);
                    }
                }
            }

            $technician->user->notify(new TechnicianVerificationReviewed($technician, approved: true));
        });
    }

    public function reject(TechnicianProfile $technician, string $reason, User $admin): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($technician, $reason, $admin) {
            $technician->update([
                'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Rejected,
                'verification_note' => $reason,
                'is_accepting_orders' => false,
            ]);

            $technician->documents()->update([
                'status' => DocumentStatus::Rejected,
                'reviewed_by' => $admin->id,
                'reviewed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $technician->user->notify(new TechnicianVerificationReviewed($technician, approved: false));
        });
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Concerns;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

trait PasswordValidationRules
{
    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate passwords.
     *
     * @return array<int, Password|ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    protected function passwordRules(): array
    {
        return ['required', 'string', Password::default(), 'confirmed'];
    }

    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate the current password.
     *
     * @return array<int, Password|ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    protected function currentPasswordRules(): array
    {
        return ['required', 'string', 'current_password'];
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Concerns;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

trait ProfileValidationRules
{
    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate user profiles.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<int, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>>
     */
    protected function profileRules(?int $userId = null): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'email' => $this->emailRules($userId),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate Indonesian phone numbers.
     * Normalize the value with User::normalizePhone() before validating.
     *
     * @return array<int, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    protected function phoneRules(?int $userId = null): array
    {
        return [
            'required',
            'string',
            'regex:/^08\d{8,12}$/',
            $userId === null
                ? Rule::unique(User::class, 'phone')
                : Rule::unique(User::class, 'phone')->ignore($userId),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate user names.
     *
     * @return array<int, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    protected function nameRules(): array
    {
        return ['required', 'string', 'max:255'];
    }

    /**
     * Get the validation rules used to validate user emails.
     *
     * @return array<int, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
     */
    protected function emailRules(?int $userId = null): array
    {
        return [
            'required',
            'string',
            'email',
            'max:255',
            $userId === null
                ? Rule::unique(User::class)
                : Rule::unique(User::class)->ignore($userId),
        ];
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Console\Commands\SendVisitReminders.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Notifications\OrderVisitReminder;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Description;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Signature;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;

#[Signature('orders:send-reminders')]
#[Description('Remind customers and technicians a day and an hour before scheduled visits')]
class SendVisitReminders extends Command
{
    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     */
    public function handle(): int
    {
        $sent = 0;

        Order::query()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::Terjadwal)
            ->whereBetween('scheduled_date', [today()->toDateString(), today()->addDays(2)->toDateString()])
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('reminded_day_before_at')->orWhereNull('reminded_hour_before_at'))
            ->with(['customer', 'technician.user', 'service'])
            ->each(function (Order $order) use (&$sent) {
                $startsAt = $order->visitStartsAt();

                if ($startsAt === null || $startsAt->isPast()) {
                    return;
                }

                $hoursLeft = now()->diffInMinutes($startsAt) / 60;

                if ($order->reminded_hour_before_at === null && $hoursLeft <= 1) {
                    $this->notify($order, OrderVisitReminder::HOUR_BEFORE);
                    $order->forceFill(['reminded_hour_before_at' => now(), 'reminded_day_before_at' => $order->reminded_day_before_at ?? now()])->save();
                    $sent++;
                } elseif ($order->reminded_day_before_at === null && $hoursLeft <= 24 && $hoursLeft > 1) {
                    $this->notify($order, OrderVisitReminder::DAY_BEFORE);
                    $order->forceFill(['reminded_day_before_at' => now()])->save();
                    $sent++;
                }
            });

        $this->info("{$sent} pengingat dikirim.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function notify(Order $order, string $timing): void
    {
        $order->customer->notify(new OrderVisitReminder($order, $timing));
        $order->technician?->user->notify(new OrderVisitReminder($order, $timing));
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Console\Commands\SyncPendingPayments.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Services\PaymentService;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Description;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Signature;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;

#[Signature('payments:sync')]
#[Description('Reconcile pending payments with Midtrans and expire the ones past their deadline')]
class SyncPendingPayments extends Command
{
    /**
     * Execute the console command.
     */
    public function handle(PaymentService $payments): int
    {
        $pending = Payment::where('status', PaymentStatus::Pending)->get();

        $pending->each(fn (Payment $payment) => $payments->sync($payment));

        $this->info("{$pending->count()} pembayaran dicek.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

enum OrderStatus: string
{
    case MenungguRespons = 'menunggu_respons';
    case CariCadangan = 'cari_cadangan';
    case EstimasiMasuk = 'estimasi_masuk';
    case Terjadwal = 'terjadwal';
    case MenungguPersetujuanBiaya = 'menunggu_persetujuan_biaya';
    case MenungguPembayaran = 'menunggu_pembayaran';
    case Dikerjakan = 'dikerjakan';
    case MenungguKonfirmasi = 'menunggu_konfirmasi';
    case PerbaikanUlang = 'perbaikan_ulang';
    case Sengketa = 'sengketa';
    case Selesai = 'selesai';
    case Dibatalkan = 'dibatalkan';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::MenungguRespons => 'Menunggu respons',
            self::CariCadangan => 'Mencari cadangan',
            self::EstimasiMasuk => 'Estimasi masuk',
            self::Terjadwal => 'Terjadwal',
            self::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya => 'Perlu persetujuan',
            self::MenungguPembayaran => 'Menunggu pembayaran',
            self::Dikerjakan => 'Sedang dikerjakan',
            self::MenungguKonfirmasi => 'Menunggu konfirmasimu',
            self::PerbaikanUlang => 'Perbaikan ulang',
            self::Sengketa => 'Ditinjau admin',
            self::Selesai => 'Selesai',
            self::Dibatalkan => 'Dibatalkan',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Tone used by status pills: ice, sun, leaf, coral, or mute.
     */
    public function tone(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::MenungguRespons, self::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya, self::MenungguPembayaran, self::MenungguKonfirmasi, self::PerbaikanUlang => 'sun',
            self::CariCadangan, self::EstimasiMasuk, self::Terjadwal, self::Dikerjakan => 'ice',
            self::Sengketa, self::Dibatalkan => 'coral',
            self::Selesai => 'leaf',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Index (0-7) in the 8-step customer progress bar:
     * Respons, Estimasi, Terjadwal, Biaya final, Pembayaran, Pengerjaan, Konfirmasi, Selesai.
     */
    public function progressStep(): int
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::MenungguRespons, self::CariCadangan, self::Dibatalkan => 0,
            self::EstimasiMasuk => 1,
            self::Terjadwal => 2,
            self::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya => 3,
            self::MenungguPembayaran => 4,
            self::Dikerjakan, self::PerbaikanUlang => 5,
            self::MenungguKonfirmasi, self::Sengketa => 6,
            self::Selesai => 7,
        };
    }

    public function isActive(): bool
    {
        return ! in_array($this, [self::Selesai, self::Dibatalkan], true);
    }

    public function isCancellableByCustomer(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::MenungguRespons, self::CariCadangan, self::EstimasiMasuk, self::Terjadwal], true);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<self>
     */
    public static function active(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(self::cases(), fn (self $status) => $status->isActive()));
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Enums\PaymentMethod.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * The nine payment methods from the design. OVO and DANA have no Midtrans Core API channel,
 * so they are charged as QRIS and the customer scans the code from that app.
 */
enum PaymentMethod: string
{
    case Qris = 'qris';
    case BcaVa = 'bca_va';
    case BniVa = 'bni_va';
    case BriVa = 'bri_va';
    case MandiriVa = 'mandiri_va';
    case Gopay = 'gopay';
    case Ovo = 'ovo';
    case Dana = 'dana';
    case Shopeepay = 'shopeepay';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Qris => 'QRIS',
            self::BcaVa => 'BCA Virtual Account',
            self::BniVa => 'BNI Virtual Account',
            self::BriVa => 'BRI Virtual Account',
            self::MandiriVa => 'Mandiri Virtual Account',
            self::Gopay => 'GoPay',
            self::Ovo => 'OVO',
            self::Dana => 'DANA',
            self::Shopeepay => 'ShopeePay',
        };
    }

    public function hint(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Qris => 'Scan dari m-banking atau e-wallet apa pun',
            self::BcaVa, self::BniVa, self::BriVa, self::MandiriVa => 'Dicek otomatis',
            self::Gopay, self::Shopeepay => 'Bayar di aplikasi',
            self::Ovo, self::Dana => 'Scan QRIS dari aplikasi',
        };
    }

    public function group(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Qris => 'QRIS',
            self::BcaVa, self::BniVa, self::BriVa, self::MandiriVa => 'Virtual Account',
            default => 'E-wallet',
        };
    }

    public function groupIcon(): string
    {
        return match ($this->group()) {
            'QRIS' => 'qr-code',
            'Virtual Account' => 'landmark',
            default => 'smartphone',
        };
    }

    public function isVirtualAccount(): bool
    {
        return $this->group() === 'Virtual Account';
    }

    /**
     * Methods shown as a scannable QR code.
     */
    public function usesQr(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this, [self::Qris, self::Ovo, self::Dana, self::Gopay], true);
    }

    /**
     * The method-specific part of a Midtrans Core API charge request.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function chargeParameters(string $orderCode, string $callbackUrl): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Qris, self::Ovo, self::Dana => ['payment_type' => 'qris', 'qris' => ['acquirer' => 'gopay']],
            self::BcaVa => ['payment_type' => 'bank_transfer', 'bank_transfer' => ['bank' => 'bca']],
            self::BniVa => ['payment_type' => 'bank_transfer', 'bank_transfer' => ['bank' => 'bni']],
            self::BriVa => ['payment_type' => 'bank_transfer', 'bank_transfer' => ['bank' => 'bri']],
            self::MandiriVa => ['payment_type' => 'echannel', 'echannel' => ['bill_info1' => 'Pembayaran:', 'bill_info2' => 'Sejuk '.$orderCode]],
            self::Gopay => ['payment_type' => 'gopay', 'gopay' => ['enable_callback' => true, 'callback_url' => $callbackUrl]],
            self::Shopeepay => ['payment_type' => 'shopeepay', 'shopeepay' => ['callback_url' => $callbackUrl]],
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, list<self>>
     */
    public static function grouped(): array
    {
        $groups = [];

        foreach (self::cases() as $method) {
            $groups[$method->group()][] = $method;
        }

        return $groups;
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Http\Controllers\MidtransWebhookController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\PaymentService;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class MidtransWebhookController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Receive Midtrans payment notifications. Unknown or unsigned requests get a 403 so Midtrans retries
     * only genuine ones; everything else is acknowledged with 200.
     */
    public function __invoke(Request $request, PaymentService $payments): JsonResponse
    {
        $handled = $payments->handleNotification($request->json()->all());

        return response()->json(['received' => $handled], $handled ? 200 : 403);
    }
}

        ]);

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureTechnicianIsApproved
{
    /**
     * Send technicians who are not verified yet to the verification status page.
     *
     * @param  Closure(Request): (Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $profile = $request->user()?->technicianProfile;

            return redirect()->route('mitra.verification');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Http\Middleware\EnsureUserHasRole.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureUserHasRole
{
    /**
     * Allow the request only when the signed-in user has one of the given roles.
     *
     * @param  Closure(Request): (Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, string ...$roles): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user === null || ! in_array($user->role, array_map(UserRole::from(...), $roles), true)) {
            abort(403);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class RedirectNonCustomers
{
    /**
     * Redirect authenticated technicians and admins to their respective portals
     * when they try to access customer-facing pages.
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user !== null && ! $user->isCustomer()) {
            return redirect($user->homeRoute());
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Http\Responses\RoleHomeResponse.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Responses;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\LoginResponse;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\RegisterResponse;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\TwoFactorLoginResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Sends each user to their own portal after signing in or registering.
 */
class RoleHomeResponse implements LoginResponse, RegisterResponse, TwoFactorLoginResponse
{
    /**
     * @param  Request  $request
     */
    public function toResponse($request): Response
    {
        if ($request->wantsJson()) {
            return new JsonResponse(['two_factor' => false]);
        }

        /** @var User $user */
        $user = $request->user();
        $intended = $request->session()->pull('url.intended');

        return redirect(is_string($intended) && $this->belongsToPortal($user, $intended) ? $intended : $user->homeRoute());
    }

    /**
     * Only follow an intended URL inside the signed-in user's own portal, so a page left over
     * from another account (e.g. a customer order) does not end in a 403.
     */
    private function belongsToPortal(User $user, string $url): bool
    {
        $path = '/'.ltrim((string) parse_url($url, PHP_URL_PATH), '/');
        $isMitra = Str::startsWith($path, '/mitra');
        $isAdmin = Str::startsWith($path, '/admin');

        return match ($user->role) {
            UserRole::Technician => $isMitra,
            UserRole::Admin => $isAdmin,
            UserRole::Customer => ! $isMitra && ! $isAdmin,
        };
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Listeners\SendOrderStatusNotifications.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Listeners;

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Events\OrderStatusChanged;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\OrderUpdated;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

/**
 * Tells the customer and the technician what changed on their order. Nobody is notified about
 * a change they made themselves.
 */
class SendOrderStatusNotifications
{
    public function handle(OrderStatusChanged $event): void
    {
        $order = $event->order->loadMissing(['customer', 'technician.user', 'service']);

        foreach ($this->messagesFor($event, $order) as [$recipient, $title, $body]) {
            if ($recipient instanceof User && $recipient->isNot($event->actor)) {
                $recipient->notify(new OrderUpdated($order, $title, $body, $this->urlFor($recipient, $order)));
            }
        }

        if ($event->to === OrderStatus::Sengketa) {
            Notification::send(
                User::where('role', UserRole::Admin)->get(),
                new OrderUpdated($order, "Sengketa pesanan #{$order->code}", 'Pelanggan masih belum puas setelah perbaikan ulang. Mohon ditinjau.', route('admin.orders.show', $order)),
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{0: User|null, 1: string, 2: string}>
     */
    private function messagesFor(OrderStatusChanged $event, Order $order): array
    {
        $customer = $order->customer;
        $technician = $order->technician?->user;
        $business = $order->technician->business_name ?? 'Teknisi';
        $service = $order->service->name;
        $slot = $order->scheduled_date?->translatedFormat('l, j F').', '.$order->scheduled_window?->range().' WIB';

        return match ($event->to) {
            OrderStatus::MenungguRespons => [
                [$technician, 'Pesanan baru masuk', "{$service} Â· {$order->brandLabel()} {$order->ac_capacity->label()} di {$order->address}. Tanggapi dalam ".config('sejuk.response_minutes').' menit.'],
            ],
            OrderStatus::CariCadangan => $event->from === OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk
                ? [[$technician, 'Estimasi ditolak pelanggan', "Pelanggan memilih teknisi lain untuk pesanan #{$order->code}."]]
                : [[$customer, 'Pilih teknisi cadangan', "{$business} belum bisa mengambil pesananmu. Pilih teknisi lain tanpa mengisi formulir ulang."]],
            OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk => [
                [$customer, 'Estimasi sudah masuk', "{$business} mengirim estimasi ".rupiah($order->estimate_min).' â€“ '.rupiah($order->estimate_max).'. Setujui untuk menjadwalkan kunjungan.'],
            ],
            OrderStatus::Terjadwal => [
                [$technician, 'Estimasi disetujui', "Kunjungan ke {$customer->name} terjadwal {$slot}."],
            ],
            OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya => [
                [$customer, 'Biaya final perlu persetujuanmu', 'Total '.rupiah($order->final_total).'. Pekerjaan baru dimulai setelah kamu menyetujui dan membayar.'],
            ],
            OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran => [
                [$technician, 'Biaya final disetujui', 'Pelanggan menyetujui '.rupiah($order->final_total).' dan sedang membayar.'],
            ],
            OrderStatus::Dikerjakan => [
                [$customer, 'Pembayaran diterima', 'Dana ditahan Sejuk sampai kamu mengonfirmasi pekerjaan selesai.'],
                [$technician, 'Pembayaran diterima, mulai kerjakan', "Pelanggan sudah membayar pesanan #{$order->code}. Unggah bukti kerja setelah selesai."],
            ],
            OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi => [
                [$customer, 'Cek hasil pekerjaan', "{$business} menandai pekerjaan selesai. Periksa bukti kerja; tanpa konfirmasi, pesanan selesai otomatis dalam ".config('sejuk.auto_complete_hours').' jam.'],
            ],
            OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang => [
                [$technician, 'Pelanggan meminta perbaikan ulang', "AC pada pesanan #{$order->code} masih bermasalah. Perbaiki tanpa biaya tambahan lalu unggah bukti baru."],
            ],
            OrderStatus::Sengketa => [
                [$customer, 'Pesanan ditinjau tim Sejuk', 'Tim Sejuk akan menghubungimu untuk mencari penyelesaian. Dana tetap ditahan.'],
                [$technician, 'Pesanan ditinjau tim Sejuk', "Pesanan #{$order->code} masuk peninjauan setelah beberapa kali perbaikan ulang."],
            ],
            OrderStatus::Selesai => [
                [$technician, 'Pesanan selesai, dana diteruskan', rupiah($order->technicianPayout())." masuk ke saldo pencairanmu untuk pesanan #{$order->code}."],
                [$event->actor === null || $event->actor->isAdmin() ? $customer : null, 'Pesanan selesai', "Pesanan #{$order->code} ditutup dan dana diteruskan ke {$business}. Jangan lupa beri ulasan."],
            ],
            OrderStatus::Dibatalkan => [
                [$event->from !== OrderStatus::CariCadangan ? $technician : null, 'Pesanan dibatalkan', $order->cancelled_reason === OrderWorkflow::REASON_FINAL_COST_REJECTED
                    ? "Pelanggan menolak biaya final pesanan #{$order->code}. Pekerjaan tidak dimulai."
                    : "Pesanan #{$order->code} dibatalkan."],
                [$customer, 'Pesanan dibatalkan', (string) $order->cancelled_reason],
            ],
        };
    }

    private function urlFor(User $recipient, Order $order): string
    {
        return $recipient->isTechnician() ? route('mitra.orders.show', $order) : route('orders.show', $order);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Livewire\Actions\Logout.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Actions;

use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Session;
use Livewire\Features\SupportRedirects\Redirector;

class Logout
{
    /**
     * Log the current user out of the application.
     */
    public function __invoke(): Redirector|RedirectResponse
    {
        Auth::guard('web')->logout();

        Session::invalidate();
        Session::regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/');
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Models\Order.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\AcCapacity;
use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\OrderFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Scope;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $code
 * @property int $customer_id
 * @property int|null $technician_id
 * @property int $service_id
 * @property AcCapacity $ac_capacity
 * @property string $ac_brand
 * @property string|null $ac_brand_other
 * @property string $address
 * @property string|null $address_detail
 * @property float|null $latitude
 * @property float|null $longitude
 * @property CarbonImmutable $preferred_date
 * @property TimeWindow $time_window
 * @property string|null $notes
 * @property bool $warranty
 * @property int $warranty_fee
 * @property int|null $estimate_min
 * @property int|null $estimate_max
 * @property string|null $estimate_note
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $scheduled_date
 * @property TimeWindow|null $scheduled_window
 * @property int|null $final_total
 * @property int|null $commission_amount
 * @property OrderStatus $status
 * @property FundStatus|null $fund_status
 * @property int|null $payout_id
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $final_cost_submitted_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $reminded_day_before_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $reminded_hour_before_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $response_deadline
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $proof_submitted_at
 * @property int $rework_count
 * @property string|null $cancelled_reason
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $completed_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $created_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $updated_at
 * @property-read User $customer
 * @property-read TechnicianProfile|null $technician
 * @property-read Service $service
 * @property-read Collection<int, OrderOffer> $offers
 * @property-read Collection<int, OrderMedia> $media
 * @property-read Collection<int, OrderCostItem> $costItems
 * @property-read Collection<int, WorkProof> $workProofs
 * @property-read Collection<int, Payment> $payments
 * @property-read Review|null $review
 */
#[Fillable([
    'customer_id', 'technician_id', 'service_id', 'ac_capacity', 'ac_brand', 'ac_brand_other', 'address',
    'address_detail', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'preferred_date', 'time_window', 'notes', 'warranty', 'warranty_fee',
    'estimate_min', 'estimate_max', 'estimate_note', 'scheduled_date', 'scheduled_window', 'final_total',
    'commission_amount', 'final_cost_submitted_at', 'reminded_day_before_at', 'reminded_hour_before_at', 'status', 'fund_status', 'payout_id', 'response_deadline', 'proof_submitted_at', 'rework_count',
    'cancelled_reason', 'completed_at',
])]
class Order extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<OrderFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::creating(function (Order $order) {
            $order->code ??= static::generateCode();
        });
    }

    /**
     * Unique order code in the SJK-XXXX format.
     */
    public static function generateCode(): string
    {
        do {
            $code = 'SJK-'.str_pad((string) random_int(0, 9999), 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        } while (static::where('code', $code)->exists());

        return $code;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'ac_capacity' => AcCapacity::class,
            'latitude' => 'float',
            'longitude' => 'float',
            'preferred_date' => 'date',
            'time_window' => TimeWindow::class,
            'warranty' => 'boolean',
            'scheduled_date' => 'date',
            'scheduled_window' => TimeWindow::class,
            'status' => OrderStatus::class,
            'fund_status' => FundStatus::class,
            'response_deadline' => 'datetime',
            'final_cost_submitted_at' => 'datetime',
            'reminded_day_before_at' => 'datetime',
            'reminded_hour_before_at' => 'datetime',
            'proof_submitted_at' => 'datetime',
            'completed_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function getRouteKeyName(): string
    {
        return 'code';
    }

    /**
     * @param  Builder<self>  $query
     */
    #[Scope]
    protected function active(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->whereIn('status', OrderStatus::active());
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function customer(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'customer_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<TechnicianProfile, $this>
     */
    public function technician(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(TechnicianProfile::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Service, $this>
     */
    public function service(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Service::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<OrderStatusLog, $this>
     */
    public function statusLogs(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderStatusLog::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<OrderOffer, $this>
     */
    public function offers(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderOffer::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Payout, $this>
     */
    public function payout(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Payout::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<Review, $this>
     */
    public function review(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(Review::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<WorkProof, $this>
     */
    public function workProofs(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(WorkProof::class)->orderBy('round');
    }

    public function latestProof(): ?WorkProof
    {
        return $this->workProofs->sortByDesc('round')->first();
    }

    /**
     * When the order closes by itself if the customer does not confirm.
     */
    public function autoCompletesAt(): ?CarbonImmutable
    {
        return $this->proof_submitted_at?->addHours((int) config('sejuk.auto_complete_hours'));
    }

    /**
     * What the technician receives once funds are forwarded. Before completion the commission
     * is not recorded yet, so the configured rate gives the expected amount.
     */
    public function technicianPayout(): int
    {
        $total = (int) $this->final_total;
        $commission = $this->commission_amount ?? (int) round($total * (int) config('sejuk.commission_percent') / 100);

        return max(0, $total - $commission);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Payment, $this>
     */
    public function payments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Payment::class);
    }

    /**
     * The attempt that settled this order, if any.
     */
    public function paidPayment(): ?Payment
    {
        return $this->payments->firstWhere('status', PaymentStatus::Paid);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<OrderCostItem, $this>
     */
    public function costItems(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderCostItem::class)->orderBy('id');
    }

    /**
     * How far the final total lands above the estimate maximum (0 when within the estimate).
     */
    public function amountOverEstimate(): int
    {
        if ($this->final_total === null || $this->estimate_max === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        return max(0, $this->final_total - $this->estimate_max - $this->warranty_fee);
    }

    /**
     * When the technician is due to arrive: the start of the scheduled window.
     */
    public function visitStartsAt(): ?CarbonInterface
    {
        if ($this->scheduled_date === null || $this->scheduled_window === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->scheduled_date->setTime($this->scheduled_window->startHour(), 0);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<OrderMedia, $this>
     */
    public function media(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderMedia::class);
    }

    /**
     * The offer currently waiting on the assigned technician, if any.
     */
    public function pendingOffer(): ?OrderOffer
    {
        return $this->offers
            ->where('technician_id', $this->technician_id)
            ->firstWhere('status', OfferStatus::Menunggu);
    }

    /**
     * Seconds left for the technician to respond, or 0 once the deadline has passed.
     */
    public function secondsToRespond(): int
    {
        if ($this->status !== OrderStatus::MenungguRespons || $this->response_deadline === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        return max(0, (int) now()->diffInSeconds($this->response_deadline, false));
    }

    public function brandLabel(): string
    {
        return $this->ac_brand === 'Lainnya' && $this->ac_brand_other ? $this->ac_brand_other : $this->ac_brand;
    }

    public function fullAddress(): string
    {
        return collect([$this->address, $this->address_detail])->filter()->implode(', ');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\PaymentMethod;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * One payment attempt for an order through Midtrans. A failed or expired attempt is kept,
 * and the customer starts a new one.
 *
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $order_id
 * @property PaymentMethod $method
 * @property string|null $gateway_ref Midtrans order_id, unique per attempt.
 * @property string|null $transaction_id
 * @property string|null $va_number
 * @property string|null $biller_code
 * @property string|null $qr_string
 * @property string|null $qr_url
 * @property string|null $deeplink_url
 * @property int $amount
 * @property PaymentStatus $status
 * @property string|null $gateway_status
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $expires_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $paid_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $synced_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $created_at
 * @property CarbonImmutable|null $updated_at
 * @property-read Order $order
 */
#[Fillable([
    'method', 'gateway_ref', 'transaction_id', 'va_number', 'biller_code', 'qr_string', 'qr_url', 'deeplink_url',
    'amount', 'status', 'gateway_status', 'expires_at', 'paid_at', 'synced_at',
])]
class Payment extends Model
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'method' => PaymentMethod::class,
            'status' => PaymentStatus::class,
            'amount' => 'integer',
            'expires_at' => 'datetime',
            'paid_at' => 'datetime',
            'synced_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function isOverdue(): bool
    {
        return $this->status === PaymentStatus::Pending && $this->expires_at !== null && $this->expires_at->isPast();
    }

    public function secondsLeft(): int
    {
        return $this->expires_at === null ? 0 : max(0, (int) now()->diffInSeconds($this->expires_at, false));
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Order, $this>
     */
    public function order(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Order::class);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Models\TechnicianProfile.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Database\Factories\TechnicianProfileFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Scope;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property int $user_id
 * @property string $business_name
 * @property string $slug
 * @property string|null $bio
 * @property int $years_experience
 * @property int $jobs_count
 * @property int $service_radius_km
 * @property string|null $base_area
 * @property float|null $latitude
 * @property float|null $longitude
 * @property TechnicianBadge $badge
 * @property VerificationStatus $verification_status
 * @property string|null $verification_note
 * @property Carbon|null $verified_at
 * @property bool $is_active
 * @property bool $is_accepting_orders
 * @property bool $is_promoted
 * @property Carbon|null $promoted_until
 * @property int|null $avg_response_minutes
 * @property float $rating_avg
 * @property int $reviews_count
 * @property Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property-read User $user
 * @property-read Collection<int, Service> $services
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianPrice> $prices
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianServiceArea> $serviceAreas
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianBrand> $brands
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianPhoto> $photos
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianAvailability> $availabilities
 * @property-read Collection<int, Review> $reviews
 * @property-read Collection<int, TechnicianDocument> $documents
 * @property-read TechnicianExperience|null $experience
 * @property-read TechnicianPayoutAccount|null $payoutAccount
 */
#[Fillable([
    'business_name', 'slug', 'bio', 'years_experience', 'jobs_count', 'service_radius_km', 'base_area',
    'latitude', 'longitude', 'badge', 'verification_status', 'verification_note', 'verified_at', 'is_active',
    'is_accepting_orders', 'is_promoted', 'promoted_until', 'avg_response_minutes', 'rating_avg', 'reviews_count',
])]
class TechnicianProfile extends Model
{
    /** @use HasFactory<TechnicianProfileFactory> */
    use HasFactory;

    /**
     * Distance from the searching customer, set by the search service.
     */
    public ?float $distanceKm = null;

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'latitude' => 'float',
            'longitude' => 'float',
            'badge' => TechnicianBadge::class,
            'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::class,
            'verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'is_accepting_orders' => 'boolean',
            'is_promoted' => 'boolean',
            'promoted_until' => 'datetime',
            'rating_avg' => 'float',
        ];
    }

    public function getRouteKeyName(): string
    {
        return 'slug';
    }

    /**
     * Technicians customers can find and book.
     *
     * @param  Builder<self>  $query
     */
    #[Scope]
    protected function published(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('verification_status', VerificationStatus::Approved)
            ->where('is_active', true);
    }

    public function isPromotedNow(): bool
    {
        return $this->is_promoted && ($this->promoted_until === null || $this->promoted_until->isFuture());
    }

    /**
     * Available time windows on the given date, from weekly rules with date overrides.
     *
     * Today's windows close two hours after they start.
     *
     * @return list<TimeWindow>
     */
    public function windowsOn(CarbonInterface $date): array
    {
        $rules = $this->availabilities;
        $overrides = $rules->filter(fn (TechnicianAvailability $rule) => $rule->date !== null && $rule->date->isSameDay($date));
        $weekly = $rules->filter(fn (TechnicianAvailability $rule) => $rule->date === null && $rule->day_of_week === $date->dayOfWeek);

        return array_values(array_filter(TimeWindow::cases(), function (TimeWindow $window) use ($overrides, $weekly, $date) {
            $override = $overrides->first(fn (TechnicianAvailability $rule) => $rule->time_window === $window);
            $available = $override !== null
                ? $override->is_available
                : $weekly->contains(fn (TechnicianAvailability $rule) => $rule->time_window === $window && $rule->is_available);

            return $available && (! $date->isToday() || now()->hour < $window->startHour() + 2);
        }));
    }

    public function isAvailableToday(): bool
    {
        return $this->is_accepting_orders && $this->windowsOn(now()->startOfDay()) !== [];
    }

    /**
     * The next date and window this technician can visit, within the booking horizon.
     *
     * @return array{date: CarbonInterface, window: TimeWindow}|null
     */
    public function nextSlot(): ?array
    {
        if (! $this->is_accepting_orders) {
            return null;
        }

        foreach (range(0, (int) config('sejuk.booking_days_ahead')) as $offset) {
            $date = now()->startOfDay()->addDays($offset);
            $window = $this->windowsOn($date)[0] ?? null;

            if ($window !== null) {
                return ['date' => $date, 'window' => $window];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Lowest minimum price for a service ("Mulai dari").
     */
    public function startingPriceFor(int $serviceId): ?int
    {
        $minimum = $this->prices->where('service_id', $serviceId)->min('price_min');

        return $minimum === null ? null : (int) $minimum;
    }

    public function startingPrice(): ?int
    {
        $minimum = $this->prices->min('price_min');

        return $minimum === null ? null : (int) $minimum;
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsToMany<Service, $this>
     */
    public function services(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Service::class, 'technician_services', 'technician_id')->orderBy('sort_order');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianPrice, $this>
     */
    public function prices(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianPrice::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianServiceArea, $this>
     */
    public function serviceAreas(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianServiceArea::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianBrand, $this>
     */
    public function brands(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianBrand::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianPhoto, $this>
     */
    public function photos(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianPhoto::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianAvailability, $this>
     */
    public function availabilities(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianAvailability::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<TechnicianPayoutAccount, $this>
     */
    public function payoutAccount(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(TechnicianPayoutAccount::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Payout, $this>
     */
    public function payouts(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Payout::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Order, $this>
     */
    public function orders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<OrderOffer, $this>
     */
    public function offers(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(OrderOffer::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * Suggested estimate range for an order, from this technician's reference prices.
     * Larger units (1,5 PK and up) use the second price row when one exists.
     *
     * @return array{min: int, max: int}|null
     */
    public function suggestedEstimate(Order $order): ?array
    {
        $rows = $this->prices->where('service_id', $order->service_id)->sortBy('price_min')->values();

        if ($rows->isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        $isLarge = in_array($order->ac_capacity->value, ['1.5', '2'], true);
        $row = $isLarge && $rows->count() > 1 ? $rows[1] : $rows[0];

        return ['min' => $row->price_min, 'max' => $row->price_max];
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TechnicianDocument, $this>
     */
    public function documents(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TechnicianDocument::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<TechnicianExperience, $this>
     */
    public function experience(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(TechnicianExperience::class, 'technician_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Review, $this>
     */
    public function reviews(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Review::class, 'technician_id');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $name
 * @property string $email
 * @property string|null $phone
 * @property Carbon|null $phone_verified_at
 * @property Carbon|null $email_verified_at
 * @property string $password
 * @property UserRole $role
 * @property string|null $city
 * @property string|null $avatar_path
 * @property string|null $two_factor_secret
 * @property string|null $two_factor_recovery_codes
 * @property Carbon|null $two_factor_confirmed_at
 * @property string|null $remember_token
 * @property Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property-read TechnicianProfile|null $technicianProfile
 * @property-read CustomerAddress|null $primaryAddress
 */
#[Fillable(['name', 'email', 'phone', 'password', 'role', 'city'])]
#[Hidden(['password', 'two_factor_secret', 'two_factor_recovery_codes', 'remember_token'])]
class User extends Authenticatable
{
    /** @use HasFactory<UserFactory> */
    use HasFactory, Notifiable;

    /**
     * Get the attributes that should be cast.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'phone_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
            'role' => UserRole::class,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Get the user's initials
     */
    public function initials(): string
    {
        $initials = Str::initials($this->name, true);

        return Str::length($initials) > 1
            ? Str::substr($initials, 0, 1).Str::substr($initials, -1)
            : $initials;
    }

    /**
     * Normalize Indonesian phone numbers to the 08xx form, e.g. "+62 812-3456" becomes "08123456".
     */
    public static function normalizePhone(string $phone): string
    {
        $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $phone) ?? '';

        if (Str::startsWith($digits, '62')) {
            $digits = '0'.Str::substr($digits, 2);
        } elseif (Str::startsWith($digits, '8')) {
            $digits = '0'.$digits;
        }

        return $digits;
    }

    /**
     * Profile photo URL, or null when the user has none.
     */
    public function avatarUrl(): ?string
    {
        if ($this->avatar_path === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return Str::startsWith($this->avatar_path, ['http://', 'https://'])
            ? $this->avatar_path
            : Storage::disk('public')->url($this->avatar_path);
    }

    public function isCustomer(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === UserRole::Customer;
    }

    public function isTechnician(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === UserRole::Technician;
    }

    public function isAdmin(): bool
    {
        return $this->role === UserRole::Admin;
    }

    /**
     * The route this user lands on after signing in.
     */
    public function homeRoute(): string
    {
        return match ($this->role) {
            UserRole::Customer => route('home'),
            UserRole::Technician => route('mitra.dashboard'),
            UserRole::Admin => route('admin.dashboard'),
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<TechnicianProfile, $this>
     */
    public function technicianProfile(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(TechnicianProfile::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<CustomerAddress, $this>
     */
    public function addresses(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(CustomerAddress::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Order, $this>
     */
    public function orders(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Order::class, 'customer_id');
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<CustomerAddress, $this>
     */
    public function primaryAddress(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(CustomerAddress::class)->where('is_primary', true);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * A short update about an order, shown in the web notification bell and sent by email.
 */
class OrderUpdated extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(
        public Order $order,
        public string $title,
        public string $body,
        public string $url,
    ) {
        $this->afterCommit();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['database', 'mail'];
    }

    public function toMail(User $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        return (new MailMessage)
            ->subject($this->title)
            ->greeting('Halo, '.str($notifiable->name)->before(' ').'!')
            ->line($this->body)
            ->action('Buka pesanan', $this->url)
            ->line('Pesanan #'.$this->order->code);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return [
            'order_code' => $this->order->code,
            'title' => $this->title,
            'body' => $this->body,
            'url' => $this->url,
        ];
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Notifications\OrderVisitReminder.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Notifications;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Messages\MailMessage;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notification;

/**
 * Reminds the customer and the technician of a scheduled visit, a day before and an hour before.
 */
class OrderVisitReminder extends Notification implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public const DAY_BEFORE = 'day';

    public const HOUR_BEFORE = 'hour';

    public function __construct(public Order $order, public string $timing) {}

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function via(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return ['mail', 'database'];
    }

    public function toMail(User $notifiable): MailMessage
    {
        return (new MailMessage)
            ->subject($this->title($notifiable))
            ->greeting('Halo, '.str($notifiable->name)->before(' ').'!')
            ->line($this->body($notifiable))
            ->line('Lokasi: '.$this->order->fullAddress())
            ->action('Lihat pesanan', $this->url($notifiable))
            ->line('Pesanan #'.$this->order->code);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(User $notifiable): array
    {
        return [
            'order_code' => $this->order->code,
            'timing' => $this->timing,
            'title' => $this->title($notifiable),
            'body' => $this->body($notifiable),
            'url' => $this->url($notifiable),
        ];
    }

    private function title(User $notifiable): string
    {
        $when = $this->timing === self::DAY_BEFORE ? 'besok' : '1 jam lagi';

        return $notifiable->isTechnician()
            ? "Pengingat: kunjungan {$when} ke {$this->order->customer->name}"
            : "Pengingat: teknisi datang {$when}";
    }

    private function body(User $notifiable): string
    {
        $slot = $this->order->scheduled_date?->translatedFormat('l, j F').', '.$this->order->scheduled_window?->range().' WIB';

        return $notifiable->isTechnician()
            ? "Jadwal kunjungan {$this->order->service->name} untuk {$this->order->customer->name}: {$slot}."
            : "{$this->order->technician?->business_name} akan datang {$slot} untuk {$this->order->service->name}.";
    }

    private function url(User $notifiable): string
    {
        return $notifiable->isTechnician()
            ? route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order)
            : route('orders.show', $this->order);
    }
}

{

    {
        $this->afterCommit();
    }

     * @return list<string>

    {
        return ['database', 'mail'];
    }

    {

            ? $mail->action('Buka Sejuk Mitra', route('mitra.dashboard'))

<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;

class OrderPolicy
{
    /**
     * The customer who placed it, any technician it was offered to, and admins.
     */
    public function view(User $user, Order $order): bool
    {
        if ($user->isAdmin() || $order->customer_id === $user->id) {
            return true;
        }

        $technicianId = $user->technicianProfile?->id;

        return $technicianId !== null && $order->offers()->where('technician_id', $technicianId)->exists();
    }

    /**
     * Customer actions: approve or reject an estimate, pick a backup, cancel.
     */
    public function manage(User $user, Order $order): bool
    {
        return $order->customer_id === $user->id;
    }

    /**
     * Technician actions on the order currently assigned to them.
     */
    public function respond(User $user, Order $order): bool
    {
        $technicianId = $user->technicianProfile?->id;

        return $technicianId !== null && $order->technician_id === $technicianId;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Support\CustomerLocation;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Date;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->configureDefaults();
        $this->configureViews();
    }

    /**
     * Share header data with the customer header.
     */
    protected function configureViews(): void
    {
        View::composer('components.customer.header', function (\Illuminate\View\View $view): void {
            $user = auth()->user();

            $view->with([
                'locationLabel' => app(CustomerLocation::class)->shortLabel($user),
                'hasActiveOrder' => $user?->isCustomer() === true && $user->orders()->active()->exists(),
            ]);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Configure default behaviors for production-ready applications.
     */
    protected function configureDefaults(): void
    {
        Date::use(CarbonImmutable::class);

        CarbonImmutable::setLocale(config('app.locale'));

        // Damage videos can exceed Livewire's default 12 MB temporary upload limit.
        config(['livewire.temporary_file_upload.rules' => ['required', 'file', 'max:20480']]);

        DB::prohibitDestructiveCommands(
            app()->isProduction(),
        );

        Password::defaults(fn (): ?Password => app()->isProduction()
            ? Password::min(12)
                ->mixedCase()
                ->letters()
                ->numbers()
                ->symbols()
                ->uncompromised()
            : null,
        );
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Actions\Fortify\CreateNewUser;
use App\Actions\Fortify\ResetUserPassword;
use App\Http\Responses\RoleHomeResponse;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Cache\RateLimiting\Limit;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\LoginResponse;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\RegisterResponse;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\TwoFactorLoginResponse;
use Laravel\Fortify\Fortify;

class FortifyServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        $this->app->singleton(LoginResponse::class, RoleHomeResponse::class);
        $this->app->singleton(RegisterResponse::class, RoleHomeResponse::class);
        $this->app->singleton(TwoFactorLoginResponse::class, RoleHomeResponse::class);
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->configureActions();
        $this->configureViews();
        $this->configureAuthentication();
        $this->configureRateLimiting();
    }

    /**
     * Configure Fortify actions.
     */
    private function configureActions(): void
    {
        Fortify::resetUserPasswordsUsing(ResetUserPassword::class);
        Fortify::createUsersUsing(CreateNewUser::class);
    }

    /**
     * Configure Fortify views.
     */
    private function configureViews(): void
    {
        Fortify::loginView(fn () => view('pages::auth.login'));
        Fortify::confirmPasswordView(fn () => view('pages::auth.confirm-password'));
        Fortify::registerView(fn () => view('pages::auth.register'));
        Fortify::resetPasswordView(fn () => view('pages::auth.reset-password'));
        Fortify::requestPasswordResetLinkView(fn () => view('pages::auth.forgot-password'));
    }

    /**
     * Allow signing in with either an email address or a phone number.
     */
    private function configureAuthentication(): void
    {
        Fortify::authenticateUsing(function (Request $request): ?User {
            $login = Str::lower(trim((string) $request->input(Fortify::username())));

            $user = Str::contains($login, '@')
                ? User::where('email', $login)->first()
                : User::where('phone', User::normalizePhone($login))->first();

            return $user && Hash::check((string) $request->input('password'), $user->password) ? $user : null;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Configure rate limiting.
     */
    private function configureRateLimiting(): void
    {
        RateLimiter::for('two-factor', function (Request $request) {
            return Limit::perMinute(5)->by($request->session()->get('login.id'));
        });

        RateLimiter::for('login', function (Request $request) {
            $throttleKey = Str::transliterate(Str::lower($request->input(Fortify::username())).'|'.$request->ip());

            return Limit::perMinute(5)->by($throttleKey);
        });

    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\Midtrans\MidtransClient.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services\Midtrans;

use Illuminate\Http\Client\ConnectionException;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\PendingRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\RequestException;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\Response;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

/**
 * Thin wrapper over the Midtrans Core API (charge, status, cancel) and notification signatures.
 */
class MidtransClient
{
    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return filled(config('services.midtrans.server_key'));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     *
     * @throws MidtransException
     */
    public function charge(array $payload): array
    {
        return $this->send(fn (PendingRequest $request) => $request->post('/v2/charge', $payload), expectSuccess: true);
    }

    /**
     * Current transaction state straight from Midtrans, used to reconcile missed webhooks.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     *
     * @throws MidtransException
     */
    public function status(string $orderId): array
    {
        return $this->send(fn (PendingRequest $request) => $request->get('/v2/'.rawurlencode($orderId).'/status'));
    }

    /**
     * Cancel a pending transaction so it can no longer be paid. Failures are ignored by callers.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     *
     * @throws MidtransException
     */
    public function cancel(string $orderId): array
    {
        return $this->send(fn (PendingRequest $request) => $request->post('/v2/'.rawurlencode($orderId).'/cancel'));
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $notification
     */
    public function hasValidSignature(array $notification): bool
    {
        $expected = hash('sha512',
            ($notification['order_id'] ?? '').($notification['status_code'] ?? '').($notification['gross_amount'] ?? '').config('services.midtrans.server_key'),
        );

        return is_string($notification['signature_key'] ?? null) && hash_equals($expected, $notification['signature_key']);
    }

    /**
     * @param  callable(PendingRequest): Response  $call
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     *
     * @throws MidtransException
     */
    private function send(callable $call, bool $expectSuccess = false): array
    {
        if (! $this->isConfigured()) {
            throw new MidtransException('Pembayaran belum dikonfigurasi. Isi MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY di .env.');
        }

        try {
            $response = $call($this->client())->throw();
        } catch (ConnectionException|RequestException $exception) {
            throw new MidtransException('Layanan pembayaran sedang tidak bisa dihubungi. Coba lagi sebentar.', previous: $exception);
        }

        /** @var array<string, mixed> $body */
        $body = $response->json() ?? [];
        $statusCode = (string) ($body['status_code'] ?? '');

        if ($expectSuccess && ! in_array($statusCode, ['200', '201'], true)) {
            throw new MidtransException('Pembayaran ditolak: '.($body['status_message'] ?? 'kesalahan tidak dikenal').'.');
        }

        return $body;
    }

    private function client(): PendingRequest
    {
        $baseUrl = config('services.midtrans.is_production') ? 'https://api.midtrans.com' : 'https://api.sandbox.midtrans.com';

        return Http::baseUrl($baseUrl)
            ->withBasicAuth((string) config('services.midtrans.server_key'), '')
            ->acceptJson()
            ->asJson()
            ->connectTimeout(5)
            ->timeout(15);
    }
}
