==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\Geocoder.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\Client\ConnectionException;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\PendingRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Address lookups through OpenStreetMap Nominatim, biased to the service city.
 */
class Geocoder
{
    /**
     * Coordinates for a typed address, or null when nothing matches.
     *
     * @return array{latitude: float, longitude: float}|null
     */
    public function search(string $address): ?array
    {
        $query = Str::contains(Str::lower($address), Str::lower((string) config('sejuk.city')))
            ? $address
            : $address.', '.config('sejuk.city');

        return Cache::remember('geocode:search:'.md5(Str::lower($query)), now()->addDays(30), function () use ($query) {
            try {
                $response = $this->client()->get('/search', [
                    'q' => $query,
                    'format' => 'jsonv2',
                    'limit' => 1,
                    'countrycodes' => 'id',
                ]);
            } catch (ConnectionException) {
                return null;
            }

            $first = $response->successful() ? $response->json('0') : null;

            return is_array($first) ? ['latitude' => (float) $first['lat'], 'longitude' => (float) $first['lon']] : null;
        });
    }

    /**
     * A readable street address for coordinates, or null when the lookup fails.
     */
    public function reverse(float $latitude, float $longitude): ?string
    {
        $key = 'geocode:reverse:'.round($latitude, 4).','.round($longitude, 4);

        return Cache::remember($key, now()->addDays(30), function () use ($latitude, $longitude) {
            try {
                $response = $this->client()->get('/reverse', [
                    'lat' => $latitude,
                    'lon' => $longitude,
                    'format' => 'jsonv2',
                    'zoom' => 17,
                ]);
            } catch (ConnectionException) {
                return null;
            }

            if (! $response->successful()) {
                return null;
            }

            $parts = collect([
                $response->json('address.road'),
                $response->json('address.suburb') ?? $response->json('address.village'),
                $response->json('address.city') ?? $response->json('address.town') ?? $response->json('address.county'),
            ])->filter()->unique();

            return $parts->isNotEmpty() ? $parts->implode(', ') : $response->json('display_name');
        });
    }

    private function client(): PendingRequest
    {
        return Http::baseUrl((string) config('services.nominatim.url'))
            ->withUserAgent((string) config('services.nominatim.user_agent'))
            ->acceptJson()
            ->connectTimeout(3)
            ->timeout(6);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\Kpi.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\OrderOffer;
use App\Models\OrderStatusLog;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Review;
use App\Models\SearchLog;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;

/**
 * Product metrics from section 10 of the spec, for orders created in a period.
 */
class Kpi
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function summarize(CarbonInterface $from, CarbonInterface $to): array
    {
        $orders = Order::query()->whereBetween('created_at', [$from, $to]);
        $orderIds = (clone $orders)->pluck('id');
        $reachedStatus = fn (OrderStatus $status) => OrderStatusLog::whereIn('order_id', $orderIds)->where('to_status', $status)->distinct()->count('order_id');

        $requests = $orderIds->count();
        $completed = (clone $orders)->where('status', OrderStatus::Selesai)->get(['final_total', 'warranty_fee', 'estimate_min', 'estimate_max', 'rework_count', 'warranty', 'customer_id']);

        $responded = OrderOffer::whereIn('order_id', $orderIds)->whereIn('status', [OfferStatus::Diterima, OfferStatus::Ditolak])->whereNotNull('responded_at')->get(['created_at', 'responded_at']);
        $payments = Payment::whereIn('order_id', $orderIds)->whereIn('status', [PaymentStatus::Paid, PaymentStatus::Failed, PaymentStatus::Expired])->pluck('status');
        $finalCostDecided = OrderStatusLog::whereIn('order_id', $orderIds)->where('from_status', OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya)->where('to_status', '!=', OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya)->get(['order_id', 'to_status'])->unique('order_id');
        $estimateDecided = OrderStatusLog::whereIn('order_id', $orderIds)->where('from_status', OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk)->whereIn('to_status', [OrderStatus::Terjadwal, OrderStatus::CariCadangan])->get(['to_status']);
        $completedCustomers = Order::where('status', OrderStatus::Selesai)->selectRaw('customer_id, count(*) as total')->groupBy('customer_id')->pluck('total');

        return [
            'funnel' => [
                'Pencarian' => SearchLog::whereBetween('created_at', [$from, $to])->count(),
                'Permintaan' => $requests,
                'Estimasi disetujui' => $reachedStatus(OrderStatus::Terjadwal),
                'Dibayar' => $reachedStatus(OrderStatus::Dikerjakan),
                'Selesai' => $completed->count(),
            ],
            'avg_response_minutes' => $responded->isEmpty() ? null : (int) round($responded->avg(fn (OrderOffer $offer) => $offer->created_at?->diffInMinutes($offer->responded_at) ?? 0)),
            'backup_rate' => $this->percent($reachedStatus(OrderStatus::CariCadangan), $requests),
            'estimate_rejected_rate' => $this->percent($estimateDecided->where('to_status', OrderStatus::CariCadangan)->count(), $estimateDecided->count()),
            'final_cost_rejected_rate' => $this->percent($finalCostDecided->where('to_status', OrderStatus::Dibatalkan)->count(), $finalCostDecided->count()),
            'avg_over_estimate' => $completed->isEmpty() ? null : (int) round($completed->avg(fn (Order $order) => (int) $order->final_total - $order->warranty_fee - (int) $order->estimate_max)),
            'rework_rate' => $this->percent($completed->where('rework_count', '>', 0)->count(), $completed->count()),
            'payment_failed_rate' => $this->percent($payments->filter(fn (PaymentStatus $status) => $status !== PaymentStatus::Paid)->count(), $payments->count()),
            'avg_rating' => ($rating = Review::visible()->whereBetween('created_at', [$from, $to])->avg('rating')) === null ? null : round((float) $rating, 1),
            'repeat_rate' => $this->percent($completedCustomers->filter(fn ($total) => $total > 1)->count(), $completedCustomers->count()),
            'warranty_rate' => $this->percent((clone $orders)->where('warranty', true)->count(), $requests),
        ];
    }

    private function percent(int $part, int $whole): ?int
    {
        return $whole === 0 ? null : (int) round($part / $whole * 100);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\OrderWorkflow.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\MediaType;
use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Events\OrderStatusChanged;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Every order status change goes through here so the rules and the status log stay in one place.
 */
class OrderWorkflow
{
    public const REASON_FINAL_COST_REJECTED = 'Biaya final ditolak';

    public const REASON_CUSTOMER_CANCELLED = 'Dibatalkan pelanggan';

    public function __construct(private TechnicianSearch $search) {}

    /**
     * L-04: a customer sends a quote request to a technician.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $details  Order columns from the request form.
     * @param  list<UploadedFile>  $media
     */
    public function submit(User $customer, TechnicianProfile $technician, array $details, array $media = []): Order
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($customer, $technician, $details, $media) {
            $order = $customer->orders()->create([
                ...$details,
                'technician_id' => $technician->id,
                'warranty_fee' => ($details['warranty'] ?? false) ? (int) config('sejuk.warranty.fee') : 0,
                'status' => OrderStatus::MenungguRespons,
                'response_deadline' => $this->deadline(),
            ]);

            foreach ($media as $file) {
                $order->media()->create([
                    'path' => $file->store("order-media/{$order->id}", 'local'),
                    'type' => Str::startsWith((string) $file->getMimeType(), 'video/') ? MediaType::Video : MediaType::Foto,
                ]);
            }

            $order->offers()->create(['technician_id' => $technician->id, 'status' => OfferStatus::Menunggu]);
            $this->log($order, null, OrderStatus::MenungguRespons, $customer);
            OrderStatusChanged::dispatch($order, null, OrderStatus::MenungguRespons, $customer);

            return $order;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Re-send an order whose technician declined, timed out, or whose estimate was rejected,
     * without the customer filling in the form again.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $details  Updated order columns, if the customer edited the form.
     */
    public function reassign(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician, User $actor, array $details = []): Order
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::CariCadangan]);

        if ($order->offers()->where('technician_id', $technician->id)->exists()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Teknisi ini sudah pernah menerima pesanan ini.');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $technician, $actor, $details) {
            $order->fill([
                ...$details,
                'technician_id' => $technician->id,
                'estimate_min' => null,
                'estimate_max' => null,
                'estimate_note' => null,
                'scheduled_date' => null,
                'scheduled_window' => null,
                'response_deadline' => $this->deadline(),
            ]);

            if (array_key_exists('warranty', $details)) {
                $order->warranty_fee = $details['warranty'] ? (int) config('sejuk.warranty.fee') : 0;
            }

            $order->offers()->create(['technician_id' => $technician->id, 'status' => OfferStatus::Menunggu]);
            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::MenungguRespons, $actor, 'Dikirim ke '.$technician->business_name);

            return $order;
        });
    }

    /**
     * The assigned technician declines, the response window lapses, or the customer stops waiting.
     */
    public function releaseToBackup(Order $order, OfferStatus $offerOutcome, ?User $actor, string $note): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguRespons]);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $offerOutcome, $actor, $note) {
            $order->offers()
                ->where('technician_id', $order->technician_id)
                ->where('status', OfferStatus::Menunggu)
                ->update(['status' => $offerOutcome, 'responded_at' => now()]);

            $order->response_deadline = null;
            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::CariCadangan, $actor, $note);
        });
    }

    /**
     * The technician answers with an estimate and a visit slot.
     */
    public function submitEstimate(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician, int $minimum, int $maximum, CarbonInterface $date, TimeWindow $window, ?string $note): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguRespons]);
        $this->ensureAssigned($order, $technician);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $technician, $minimum, $maximum, $date, $window, $note) {
            $offer = $order->offers()
                ->where('technician_id', $technician->id)
                ->where('status', OfferStatus::Menunggu)
                ->firstOrFail();

            $offer->update(['status' => OfferStatus::Diterima, 'responded_at' => now()]);
            $this->recordResponseTime($technician, (int) round($offer->created_at?->diffInMinutes(now()) ?? 0));

            $order->fill([
                'estimate_min' => $minimum,
                'estimate_max' => $maximum,
                'estimate_note' => $note,
                'scheduled_date' => $date->toDateString(),
                'scheduled_window' => $window,
                'response_deadline' => null,
            ]);

            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk, $technician->user);
        });
    }

    public function approveEstimate(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk]);

        $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Terjadwal, $customer);
    }

    /**
     * L-05C: the customer turns the estimate down and looks for someone else. The form stays saved.
     */
    public function rejectEstimate(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk]);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $customer) {
            $order->offers()
                ->where('technician_id', $order->technician_id)
                ->where('status', OfferStatus::Diterima)
                ->update(['status' => OfferStatus::Ditolak]);

            $order->fill(['estimate_min' => null, 'estimate_max' => null, 'estimate_note' => null, 'scheduled_date' => null, 'scheduled_window' => null]);
            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::CariCadangan, $customer, 'Estimasi ditolak pelanggan');
        });
    }

    /**
     * L-07 (technician side): after inspecting the AC the technician sends the final cost lines.
     * The warranty fee the customer chose is added automatically. Sending again while the
     * customer has not decided replaces the previous lines.
     *
     * @param  list<array{label: string, amount: int, is_additional: bool}>  $items
     */
    public function submitFinalCost(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician, array $items): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::Terjadwal, OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya]);
        $this->ensureAssigned($order, $technician);

        if ($items === []) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Isi minimal satu rincian biaya.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $technician, $items) {
            $order->costItems()->delete();
            $order->costItems()->createMany($items);

            if ($order->warranty) {
                $order->costItems()->create([
                    'label' => 'Garansi Servis '.config('sejuk.warranty.days').' Hari',
                    'amount' => $order->warranty_fee,
                    'is_additional' => false,
                ]);
            }

            $order->final_total = (int) $order->costItems()->sum('amount');
            $order->final_cost_submitted_at = now();

            if ($order->status === OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya) {
                $order->save();
                $this->log($order, OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya, OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya, $technician->user, 'Biaya final diperbarui');

                return;
            }

            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya, $technician->user);
        });
    }

    public function approveFinalCost(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya]);

        $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran, $customer);
    }

    /**
     * Payment confirmed by Midtrans: the money is held by Sejuk and the technician starts work.
     */
    public function markPaid(Order $order, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran]);

        $order->fund_status = FundStatus::Ditahan;
        $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Dikerjakan, null, $note ?? 'Pembayaran diterima, dana ditahan Sejuk');
    }

    /**
     * L-08 (technician side): upload before/after photos and mark the job done.
     */
    public function submitProof(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician, UploadedFile $before, UploadedFile $after, ?string $note): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::Dikerjakan, OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang]);
        $this->ensureAssigned($order, $technician);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $technician, $before, $after, $note) {
            $round = $order->rework_count + 1;
            $directory = "work-proofs/{$order->id}";

            $order->workProofs()->create([
                'round' => $round,
                'before_path' => $before->store($directory, 'local'),
                'after_path' => $after->store($directory, 'local'),
                'note' => $note,
            ]);

            $order->proof_submitted_at = now();
            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi, $technician->user, $round > 1 ? 'Bukti baru setelah perbaikan ulang' : null);
        });
    }

    /**
     * "Selesai, AC sudah beres": the order closes and the held funds go to the technician.
     */
    public function confirmCompletion(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi]);

        DB::transaction(fn () => $this->complete($order, $customer, 'Dikonfirmasi pelanggan'));
    }

    /**
     * "Masih bermasalah": the technician fixes it again at no extra cost while funds stay held.
     * Past the rework limit the order goes to admin review instead.
     */
    public function requestRework(Order $order, User $customer, ?string $complaint): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi]);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $customer, $complaint) {
            $order->workProofs()->where('round', $order->rework_count + 1)->update([
                'rejected_at' => now(),
                'complaint' => $complaint,
            ]);

            $order->rework_count++;
            $order->proof_submitted_at = null;

            $overLimit = $order->rework_count > (int) config('sejuk.max_rework');
            $this->transition($order, $overLimit ? OrderStatus::Sengketa : OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang, $customer, $complaint);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Admin cancels an order that has not finished. Money already held is marked for a manual refund.
     */
    public function cancelByAdmin(Order $order, User $admin, string $reason): void
    {
        if (! $order->status->isActive()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Pesanan ini sudah selesai atau dibatalkan.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $admin, $reason) {
            $order->offers()->where('status', OfferStatus::Menunggu)->update(['status' => OfferStatus::Kedaluwarsa, 'responded_at' => now()]);

            $order->fill([
                'cancelled_reason' => 'Dibatalkan admin: '.$reason,
                'response_deadline' => null,
                'fund_status' => $order->fund_status === FundStatus::Ditahan ? FundStatus::Dikembalikan : $order->fund_status,
            ]);

            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Dibatalkan, $admin, $reason);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Admin settles a dispute: either the work stands and funds go to the technician, or the customer is refunded.
     */
    public function resolveDispute(Order $order, User $admin, bool $forwardToTechnician, string $note): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::Sengketa]);

        if ($forwardToTechnician) {
            DB::transaction(fn () => $this->complete($order, $admin, 'Sengketa diselesaikan admin: '.$note));

            return;
        }

        $this->cancelByAdmin($order, $admin, $note);
    }

    /**
     * Close orders whose customer did not respond within the confirmation window.
     */
    public function autoCompleteOverdue(): int
    {
        $overdue = Order::query()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi)
            ->where('proof_submitted_at', '<=', now()->subHours((int) config('sejuk.auto_complete_hours')))
            ->get();

        $overdue->each(fn (Order $order) => DB::transaction(
            fn () => $this->complete($order, null, 'Selesai otomatis, tidak ada konfirmasi dalam '.config('sejuk.auto_complete_hours').' jam'),
        ));

        return $overdue->count();
    }

    private function complete(Order $order, ?User $actor, string $note): void
    {
        $order->fill([
            'fund_status' => FundStatus::Diteruskan,
            'commission_amount' => (int) round((int) $order->final_total * (int) config('sejuk.commission_percent') / 100),
            'completed_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Selesai, $actor, $note);

        $order->technician?->increment('jobs_count');
    }

    /**
     * The customer declines the final cost: work does not start and the order closes.
     */
    public function rejectFinalCost(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        $this->ensureStatus($order, [OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya]);

        $order->cancelled_reason = self::REASON_FINAL_COST_REJECTED;
        $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Dibatalkan, $customer, 'Biaya final ditolak pelanggan');
    }

    /**
     * Free cancellation by the customer before the technician sets off.
     */
    public function cancelByCustomer(Order $order, User $customer): void
    {
        if (! $order->status->isCancellableByCustomer()) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Pesanan ini sudah tidak bisa dibatalkan.');
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($order, $customer) {
            $order->offers()->where('status', OfferStatus::Menunggu)->update(['status' => OfferStatus::Kedaluwarsa, 'responded_at' => now()]);

            $order->fill(['cancelled_reason' => self::REASON_CUSTOMER_CANCELLED, 'response_deadline' => null]);
            $this->transition($order, OrderStatus::Dibatalkan, $customer);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Expire one request whose response window has passed, so pages stay correct between scheduler runs.
     */
    public function expireIfOverdue(Order $order): bool
    {
        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::MenungguRespons || ! $order->response_deadline?->isPast()) {
            return false;
        }

        $this->releaseToBackup($order, OfferStatus::Kedaluwarsa, null, 'Teknisi tidak merespons dalam '.config('sejuk.response_minutes').' menit');

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Expire every request whose response window has passed.
     */
    public function expireOverdueResponses(): int
    {
        $overdue = Order::query()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::MenungguRespons)
            ->where('response_deadline', '<=', now())
            ->get();

        $overdue->each(fn (Order $order) => $this->expireIfOverdue($order));

        return $overdue->count();
    }

    /**
     * L-05B: up to three alternative technicians offering the same service, available today first, then nearest.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianProfile>
     */
    public function backupCandidates(Order $order): Collection
    {
        $alreadyOffered = array_values(array_map('intval', $order->offers()->pluck('technician_id')->all()));

        return $this->search
            ->search(
                latitude: (float) ($order->latitude ?? config('sejuk.default_location.latitude')),
                longitude: (float) ($order->longitude ?? config('sejuk.default_location.longitude')),
                serviceId: $order->service_id,
                radiusKm: 15,
                excludeIds: $alreadyOffered,
            )
            ->filter(fn (TechnicianProfile $technician) => $technician->is_accepting_orders)
            ->sortBy(fn (TechnicianProfile $technician) => [$technician->isAvailableToday() ? 0 : 1, $technician->distanceKm])
            ->take((int) config('sejuk.backup_technicians'))
            ->values();
    }

    private function transition(Order $order, OrderStatus $to, ?User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        $from = $order->status;
        $order->status = $to;
        $order->save();

        $this->log($order, $from, $to, $actor, $note);

        OrderStatusChanged::dispatch($order, $from, $to, $actor);
    }

    private function log(Order $order, ?OrderStatus $from, OrderStatus $to, ?User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        $order->statusLogs()->create([
            'from_status' => $from,
            'to_status' => $to,
            'actor_id' => $actor?->id,
            'note' => $note,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<OrderStatus>  $allowed
     */
    private function ensureStatus(Order $order, array $allowed): void
    {
        if (! in_array($order->status, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Status pesanan sudah berubah. Muat ulang halaman.');
        }
    }

    private function ensureAssigned(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician): void
    {
        if ($order->technician_id !== $technician->id) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Pesanan ini tidak lagi ditujukan kepadamu.');
        }
    }

    private function deadline(): CarbonInterface
    {
        return now()->addMinutes((int) config('sejuk.response_minutes'));
    }

    /**
     * Keep a rolling average of response times for the "Membalas Â±N menit" label.
     */
    private function recordResponseTime(TechnicianProfile $technician, int $minutes): void
    {
        $previous = $technician->avg_response_minutes;

        $technician->update([
            'avg_response_minutes' => max(1, $previous === null ? $minutes : (int) round($previous * 0.8 + $minutes * 0.2)),
        ]);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\PaymentService.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentMethod;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Services\Midtrans\MidtransClient;
use App\Services\Midtrans\MidtransException;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

/**
 * L-10: online payment through the Midtrans Core API. The order status only moves on a
 * signed webhook or a server-side status check, never on a browser redirect.
 */
class PaymentService
{
    public function __construct(private MidtransClient $midtrans, private OrderWorkflow $workflow) {}

    /**
     * Start a payment attempt with the chosen method.
     *
     * @throws InvalidOrderTransition|MidtransException
     */
    public function start(Order $order, PaymentMethod $method): Payment
    {
        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran || $order->final_total === null) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Pesanan ini tidak sedang menunggu pembayaran.');
        }

        if ($this->pendingPayment($order) !== null) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Masih ada pembayaran yang berjalan. Selesaikan atau ganti metode dulu.');
        }

        $minutes = (int) config('sejuk.payment_minutes');
        $payment = $order->payments()->create([
            'method' => $method,
            'amount' => $order->final_total,
            'status' => PaymentStatus::Pending,
            'expires_at' => now()->addMinutes($minutes),
        ]);
        $payment->update(['gateway_ref' => $order->code.'-P'.$payment->id]);

        try {
            $response = $this->midtrans->charge([
                ...$method->chargeParameters($order->code, route('orders.show', $order)),
                'transaction_details' => ['order_id' => $payment->gateway_ref, 'gross_amount' => $payment->amount],
                'item_details' => $order->costItems->map(fn ($item) => [
                    'id' => 'item-'.$item->id,
                    'price' => $item->amount,
                    'quantity' => 1,
                    'name' => mb_substr($item->label, 0, 50),
                ])->values()->all(),
                'customer_details' => [
                    'first_name' => $order->customer->name,
                    'email' => $order->customer->email,
                    'phone' => $order->customer->phone,
                ],
                'custom_expiry' => [
                    'order_time' => now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s O'),
                    'expiry_duration' => $minutes,
                    'unit' => 'minute',
                ],
            ]);
        } catch (MidtransException $exception) {
            $payment->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Failed]);

            throw $exception;
        }

        $payment->update([...$this->instructionsFrom($response), 'synced_at' => now()]);

        return $payment;
    }

    /**
     * Handle a Midtrans HTTP notification. Returns false when the signature or the transaction is unknown.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $notification
     */
    public function handleNotification(array $notification): bool
    {
        if (! $this->midtrans->hasValidSignature($notification)) {
            Log::warning('Midtrans notification with an invalid signature', Arr::only($notification, ['order_id', 'transaction_status']));

            return false;
        }

        $payment = Payment::where('gateway_ref', $notification['order_id'] ?? null)->first();

        if ($payment === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $this->apply($payment, $notification);

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Ask Midtrans for the current state of a pending attempt, then expire it locally if its time is up.
     */
    public function sync(Payment $payment): Payment
    {
        if ($payment->status === PaymentStatus::Pending && $payment->gateway_ref !== null && $this->midtrans->isConfigured()) {
            try {
                $this->apply($payment, $this->midtrans->status($payment->gateway_ref));
            } catch (MidtransException $exception) {
                Log::info('Midtrans status check failed', ['payment' => $payment->id, 'error' => $exception->getMessage()]);
            }

            $payment->forceFill(['synced_at' => now()])->save();
        }

        $this->expireIfOverdue($payment);

        return $payment->refresh();
    }

    /**
     * Stop a pending attempt so the customer can choose another method.
     */
    public function cancel(Payment $payment): void
    {
        if ($payment->status !== PaymentStatus::Pending) {
            return;
        }

        $this->cancelAtGateway($payment);
        $payment->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Cancelled]);
    }

    public function expireIfOverdue(Payment $payment): void
    {
        if (! $payment->isOverdue()) {
            return;
        }

        $this->cancelAtGateway($payment);
        $payment->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Expired]);
    }

    public function pendingPayment(Order $order): ?Payment
    {
        return $order->payments()->where('status', PaymentStatus::Pending)->latest('id')->first();
    }

    /**
     * Apply a transaction state from Midtrans (webhook or status check) to the attempt and its order.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $transaction
     */
    private function apply(Payment $payment, array $transaction): void
    {
        $gatewayStatus = (string) ($transaction['transaction_status'] ?? '');
        $fraudStatus = $transaction['fraud_status'] ?? null;
        $amountMatches = (int) round((float) ($transaction['gross_amount'] ?? 0)) === $payment->amount;

        $newStatus = match (true) {
            in_array($gatewayStatus, ['settlement', 'capture'], true) && in_array($fraudStatus, [null, 'accept'], true) && $amountMatches => PaymentStatus::Paid,
            $gatewayStatus === 'expire' => PaymentStatus::Expired,
            in_array($gatewayStatus, ['deny', 'failure'], true) => PaymentStatus::Failed,
            $gatewayStatus === 'cancel' => PaymentStatus::Cancelled,
            default => null,
        };

        DB::transaction(function () use ($payment, $transaction, $gatewayStatus, $newStatus) {
            $payment = Payment::whereKey($payment->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $payment->fill(['gateway_status' => $gatewayStatus, 'transaction_id' => $transaction['transaction_id'] ?? $payment->transaction_id]);

            if ($newStatus === PaymentStatus::Paid && $payment->status !== PaymentStatus::Paid) {
                $payment->fill(['status' => PaymentStatus::Paid, 'paid_at' => $transaction['settlement_time'] ?? now()]);
                $payment->save();
                $this->settleOrder($payment);

                return;
            }

            // A late failure or expiry never overrides a confirmed payment.
            if ($newStatus !== null && $newStatus !== PaymentStatus::Paid && $payment->status === PaymentStatus::Pending) {
                $payment->status = $newStatus;
            }

            $payment->save();
        });
    }

    private function settleOrder(Payment $payment): void
    {
        $order = Order::whereKey($payment->order_id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

        if ($order->status === OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran) {
            $this->workflow->markPaid($order, 'Pembayaran '.$payment->method->label().' diterima, dana ditahan Sejuk');

            return;
        }

        // Money arrived for an order that is no longer waiting (e.g. paid twice). Admin refunds it manually.
        Log::warning('Payment settled for an order that is not awaiting payment', ['order' => $order->code, 'payment' => $payment->id, 'status' => $order->status->value]);
    }

    /**
     * Pull what the customer needs to pay from the charge response.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $response
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function instructionsFrom(array $response): array
    {
        $actions = [];

        foreach ((array) ($response['actions'] ?? []) as $action) {
            if (is_array($action) && isset($action['name'], $action['url'])) {
                $actions[(string) $action['name']] = (string) $action['url'];
            }
        }

        return array_filter([
            'transaction_id' => $response['transaction_id'] ?? null,
            'gateway_status' => $response['transaction_status'] ?? null,
            'va_number' => $response['va_numbers'][0]['va_number'] ?? $response['permata_va_number'] ?? $response['bill_key'] ?? null,
            'biller_code' => $response['biller_code'] ?? null,
            'qr_string' => $response['qr_string'] ?? null,
            'qr_url' => $actions['generate-qr-code'] ?? null,
            'deeplink_url' => $actions['deeplink-redirect'] ?? null,
        ], fn ($value) => $value !== null);
    }

    private function cancelAtGateway(Payment $payment): void
    {
        if ($payment->gateway_ref === null || ! $this->midtrans->isConfigured()) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $this->midtrans->cancel($payment->gateway_ref);
        } catch (MidtransException) {
            // Midtrans also expires the transaction on its side; a late settlement is still honored.
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * Money and workload figures for a technician's dashboard and earnings page.
 */
class TechnicianEarnings
{
    /**
     * Net earnings (after commission) from orders completed in the given month.
     */
    public function earnedIn(TechnicianProfile $technician, CarbonInterface $month): int
    {
        return (int) $technician->orders()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::Selesai)
            ->whereBetween('completed_at', [$month->startOfMonth(), $month->endOfMonth()])
            ->get(['final_total', 'commission_amount'])
            ->sum(fn (Order $order) => $order->technicianPayout());
    }

    /**
     * @return array{this_month: int, last_month: int, change_percent: int|null}
     */
    public function monthlyComparison(TechnicianProfile $technician): array
    {
        $thisMonth = $this->earnedIn($technician, now());
        $lastMonth = $this->earnedIn($technician, now()->subMonthNoOverflow());

        return [
            'this_month' => $thisMonth,
            'last_month' => $lastMonth,
            'change_percent' => $lastMonth > 0 ? (int) round(($thisMonth - $lastMonth) / $lastMonth * 100) : null,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{active: int, needs_action: int}
     */
    public function workload(TechnicianProfile $technician): array
    {
        $statuses = $technician->orders()->whereIn('status', OrderStatus::active())->pluck('status');
        $needsAction = [OrderStatus::MenungguRespons, OrderStatus::Terjadwal, OrderStatus::Dikerjakan, OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang];

        return [
            'active' => $statuses->filter(fn (OrderStatus $status) => $status !== OrderStatus::CariCadangan)->count(),
            'needs_action' => $statuses->filter(fn (OrderStatus $status) => in_array($status, $needsAction, true))->count(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Share of accepted jobs that ended completed, out of those that ended at all.
     *
     * @return array{rate: int|null, completed: int, finished: int}
     */
    public function completionRate(TechnicianProfile $technician): array
    {
        $statuses = $technician->orders()
            ->whereHas('offers', fn ($offers) => $offers->where('technician_id', $technician->id)->where('status', OfferStatus::Diterima))
            ->whereIn('status', [OrderStatus::Selesai, OrderStatus::Dibatalkan, OrderStatus::Sengketa])
            ->pluck('status');

        $completed = $statuses->filter(fn (OrderStatus $status) => $status === OrderStatus::Selesai)->count();

        return [
            'rate' => $statuses->isEmpty() ? null : (int) round($completed / $statuses->count() * 100),
            'completed' => $completed,
            'finished' => $statuses->count(),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Totals by fund state: held by Sejuk, forwarded but not yet transferred, and already paid out.
     *
     * @return array{held: int, forwarded: int, paid_out: int}
     */
    public function balances(TechnicianProfile $technician): array
    {
        $orders = $technician->orders()
            ->whereIn('fund_status', [FundStatus::Ditahan, FundStatus::Diteruskan, FundStatus::Dicairkan])
            ->get(['fund_status', 'final_total', 'commission_amount']);

        $sum = fn (FundStatus $status) => (int) $orders->where('fund_status', $status)->sum(fn (Order $order) => $order->technicianPayout());

        return [
            'held' => $sum(FundStatus::Ditahan),
            'forwarded' => $sum(FundStatus::Diteruskan),
            'paid_out' => $sum(FundStatus::Dicairkan),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Orders with money attached, newest first.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    public function ledger(TechnicianProfile $technician, int $limit = 50): Collection
    {
        return $technician->orders()
            ->whereNotNull('fund_status')
            ->where('fund_status', '!=', FundStatus::Dikembalikan)
            ->with(['service', 'customer', 'payout'])
            ->latest('updated_at')
            ->limit($limit)
            ->get();
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Services\TechnicianSearch.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

/**
 * Finds published technicians near a point and ranks them.
 */
class TechnicianSearch
{
    public const SORT_RELEVANT = 'relevan';

    public const SORT_NEAREST = 'terdekat';

    public const SORT_RATING = 'rating';

    private const EARTH_RADIUS_KM = 6371;

    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $excludeIds
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianProfile>
     */
    public function search(
        float $latitude,
        float $longitude,
        ?int $serviceId = null,
        int $radiusKm = 5,
        bool $availableToday = false,
        ?TechnicianBadge $minimumBadge = null,
        string $sort = self::SORT_RELEVANT,
        array $excludeIds = [],
    ): Collection {
        $latitudeDelta = $radiusKm / 111;
        $longitudeDelta = $radiusKm / (111 * max(cos(deg2rad($latitude)), 0.01));

        $technicians = TechnicianProfile::query()
            ->published()
            ->with(['user', 'prices', 'serviceAreas', 'availabilities'])
            ->whereBetween('latitude', [$latitude - $latitudeDelta, $latitude + $latitudeDelta])
            ->whereBetween('longitude', [$longitude - $longitudeDelta, $longitude + $longitudeDelta])
            ->when($serviceId, fn ($query) => $query->whereHas('services', fn ($services) => $services->whereKey($serviceId)))
            ->when($minimumBadge, fn ($query) => $query->whereIn('badge', TechnicianBadge::atLeast($minimumBadge)))
            ->when($excludeIds !== [], fn ($query) => $query->whereKeyNot($excludeIds))
            ->get();

        $technicians->each(function (TechnicianProfile $technician) use ($latitude, $longitude) {
            $technician->distanceKm = self::distanceKm($latitude, $longitude, (float) $technician->latitude, (float) $technician->longitude);
        });

        $filtered = $technicians
            ->filter(fn (TechnicianProfile $technician) => $technician->distanceKm <= $radiusKm)
            ->filter(fn (TechnicianProfile $technician) => ! $availableToday || $technician->isAvailableToday());

        $sorted = $filtered->sortBy(fn (TechnicianProfile $technician) => [
            $technician->isPromotedNow() ? 0 : 1,
            match ($sort) {
                self::SORT_NEAREST => $technician->distanceKm,
                self::SORT_RATING => -$technician->rating_avg,
                default => -$this->relevance($technician),
            },
            $technician->distanceKm,
        ]);

        return $sorted->values();
    }

    /**
     * Closer, available today, higher rating, and higher badge rank all score better.
     */
    public function relevance(TechnicianProfile $technician): float
    {
        return -($technician->distanceKm ?? 0) * 1.2
            + ($technician->isAvailableToday() ? 2 : 0)
            + $technician->rating_avg * 1.5
            + $technician->badge->rank() * 0.8;
    }

    /**
     * Great-circle distance in kilometers (Haversine).
     */
    public static function distanceKm(float $fromLatitude, float $fromLongitude, float $toLatitude, float $toLongitude): float
    {
        $latitudeDelta = deg2rad($toLatitude - $fromLatitude);
        $longitudeDelta = deg2rad($toLongitude - $fromLongitude);

        $a = sin($latitudeDelta / 2) ** 2
            + cos(deg2rad($fromLatitude)) * cos(deg2rad($toLatitude)) * sin($longitudeDelta / 2) ** 2;

        return self::EARTH_RADIUS_KM * 2 * atan2(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a));
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Support\CustomerLocation.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Session\Session;

/**
 * The service location the customer is searching from, kept in the session.
 * Signed-in customers fall back to their primary saved address.
 */
class CustomerLocation
{
    private const SESSION_KEY = 'sejuk.location';

    public function __construct(private Session $session) {}

    /**
     * @return array{address: string, label: string|null, detail: string|null, latitude: float|null, longitude: float|null}|null
     */
    public function current(?User $user = null): ?array
    {
        /** @var array{address: string, label: string|null, detail: string|null, latitude: float|null, longitude: float|null}|null $stored */
        $stored = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_KEY);

        if ($stored !== null) {
            return $stored;
        }

        $primary = $user?->isCustomer() ? $user->primaryAddress : null;

        if ($primary === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'address' => $primary->address,
            'label' => $primary->label,
            'detail' => $primary->detail,
            'latitude' => $primary->latitude,
            'longitude' => $primary->longitude,
        ];
    }

    public function set(string $address, ?float $latitude, ?float $longitude, ?string $label = null, ?string $detail = null): void
    {
        $this->session->put(self::SESSION_KEY, [
            'address' => $address,
            'label' => $label,
            'detail' => $detail,
            'latitude' => $latitude,
            'longitude' => $longitude,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Coordinates to measure distance from, defaulting to the city center.
     *
     * @return array{0: float, 1: float}
     */
    public function coordinates(?User $user = null): array
    {
        $current = $this->current($user);

        if ($current !== null && $current['latitude'] !== null && $current['longitude'] !== null) {
            return [$current['latitude'], $current['longitude']];
        }

        return [(float) config('sejuk.default_location.latitude'), (float) config('sejuk.default_location.longitude')];
    }

    /**
     * Short text for the header chip.
     */
    public function shortLabel(?User $user = null): ?string
    {
        $current = $this->current($user);

        if ($current === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return $current['label'] ?: str($current['address'])->before(',')->limit(28)->toString();
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\Support\OrderSimulator.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentMethod;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Plays the technician and payment gateway for an order during local development, through the
 * real workflow, so the customer journey can be tried end to end from one account.
 */
class OrderSimulator
{
    public function __construct(private OrderWorkflow $workflow) {}

    public static function isEnabled(): bool
    {
        return app()->isLocal() && (bool) config('sejuk.simulation');
    }

    /**
     * All actions that make sense for the order's current status: key => button label.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function allActionsFor(Order $order): array
    {
        return match ($order->status) {
            OrderStatus::MenungguRespons => [
                'sendEstimate' => 'Teknisi kirim estimasi',
                'declineRequest' => 'Teknisi menolak',
                'expireResponse' => 'Lewati batas 15 menit',
            ],
            OrderStatus::Terjadwal => [
                'sendFinalCost' => 'Teknisi kirim biaya final (sesuai estimasi)',
                'sendFinalCostWithExtras' => 'Teknisi kirim biaya final + tambahan',
            ],
            OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran => [
                'payNow' => 'Pembayaran berhasil',
                'failPayment' => 'Pembayaran gagal',
                'expirePayment' => 'Waktu bayar habis',
            ],
            OrderStatus::Dikerjakan, OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang => [
                'uploadProof' => 'Teknisi unggah bukti kerja',
            ],
            OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi => [
                'autoComplete' => 'Lewati 24 jam (selesai otomatis)',
            ],
            default => [],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Actions displayed in the UI. When simulation_payment_only is active,
     * only payment gateway simulation actions are shown (technician acts via portal).
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function actionsFor(Order $order): array
    {
        $all = $this->allActionsFor($order);

        if (config('sejuk.simulation_payment_only', false)) {
            return $order->status === OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran ? $all : [];
        }

        return $all;
    }

    public function run(Order $order, string $action): void
    {
        if (! array_key_exists($action, $this->allActionsFor($order))) {
            throw new InvalidOrderTransition('Langkah simulasi ini tidak cocok dengan status pesanan sekarang.');
        }

        $this->{$action}($order);
    }

    private function sendEstimate(Order $order): void
    {
        $technician = $order->technician()->with('prices')->firstOrFail();
        $range = $technician->suggestedEstimate($order) ?? ['min' => 100000, 'max' => 150000];

        $this->workflow->submitEstimate(
            $order,
            $technician,
            $range['min'],
            $range['max'],
            CarbonImmutable::parse($order->preferred_date),
            $order->time_window,
            'Harga final menyesuaikan hasil pemeriksaan komponen di lokasi. (simulasi)',
        );
    }

    private function declineRequest(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->workflow->releaseToBackup($order, OfferStatus::Ditolak, $order->technician?->user, 'Ditolak teknisi (simulasi)');
    }

    private function expireResponse(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->update(['response_deadline' => now()->subSecond()]);
        $this->workflow->expireIfOverdue($order->refresh());
    }

    private function sendFinalCost(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->workflow->submitFinalCost($order, $order->technician()->firstOrFail(), [
            $this->baseLine($order),
        ]);
    }

    private function sendFinalCostWithExtras(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->workflow->submitFinalCost($order, $order->technician()->firstOrFail(), [
            $this->baseLine($order),
            ['label' => 'Isi ulang freon R32', 'amount' => 150000, 'is_additional' => true],
            ['label' => 'Ganti kapasitor 35 ÂµF', 'amount' => 85000, 'is_additional' => true],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Settle the order as if Midtrans confirmed a QRIS payment.
     */
    private function payNow(Order $order): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($order) {
            $order->payments()->where('status', PaymentStatus::Pending)->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Cancelled]);
            $payment = $this->simulatedPayment($order, PaymentStatus::Paid);
            $payment->update(['paid_at' => now()]);

            $this->workflow->markPaid($order, 'Pembayaran QRIS diterima (simulasi), dana ditahan Sejuk');
        });
    }

    private function failPayment(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->payments()->where('status', PaymentStatus::Pending)->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Cancelled]);
        $this->simulatedPayment($order, PaymentStatus::Failed);
    }

    private function expirePayment(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->payments()->where('status', PaymentStatus::Pending)->update(['status' => PaymentStatus::Cancelled]);
        $this->simulatedPayment($order, PaymentStatus::Expired);
    }

    private function uploadProof(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->workflow->submitProof(
            $order,
            $order->technician()->firstOrFail(),
            $this->placeholderPhoto('sebelum'),
            $this->placeholderPhoto('sesudah'),
            'AC dibersihkan, freon dicek, dan unit diuji menyala dingin. (simulasi)',
        );
    }

    private function autoComplete(Order $order): void
    {
        $order->update(['proof_submitted_at' => now()->subHours((int) config('sejuk.auto_complete_hours') + 1)]);
        $this->workflow->autoCompleteOverdue();
    }

    /**
     * @return array{label: string, amount: int, is_additional: bool}
     */
    private function baseLine(Order $order): array
    {
        $midpoint = (int) (round((($order->estimate_min ?? 100000) + ($order->estimate_max ?? 150000)) / 2 / 5000) * 5000);

        return ['label' => $order->service->name.' Â· '.$order->ac_capacity->label(), 'amount' => $midpoint, 'is_additional' => false];
    }

    private function simulatedPayment(Order $order, PaymentStatus $status): Payment
    {
        $payment = $order->payments()->create([
            'method' => PaymentMethod::Qris,
            'amount' => (int) $order->final_total,
            'status' => $status,
            'expires_at' => now(),
        ]);
        $payment->update(['gateway_ref' => $order->code.'-SIM'.$payment->id]);

        return $payment;
    }

    private function placeholderPhoto(string $side): UploadedFile
    {
        return new UploadedFile(resource_path("simulation/{$side}.svg"), "{$side}.svg", 'image/svg+xml', null, true);
    }
}

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\app\helpers.php ====================

<?php

if (! function_exists('rupiah')) {
    /**
     * Format an amount as Indonesian Rupiah, e.g. "Rp125.000".
     */
    function rupiah(int|float|null $amount): string
    {
        return 'Rp'.number_format((float) ($amount ?? 0), 0, ',', '.');
    }
}

if (! function_exists('rupiah_range')) {
    /**
     * Format a price range, e.g. "Rp65.000â€“Rp80.000".
     */
    function rupiah_range(int|float|null $minimum, int|float|null $maximum): string
    {
        if ($minimum === $maximum || $maximum === null) {
            return rupiah($minimum);
        }

        return rupiah($minimum).'â€“'.rupiah($maximum);
    }
}

<?php

use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureUserHasRole;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->alias([
            'role' => EnsureUserHasRole::class,
        ]);

        $middleware->validateCsrfTokens(except: [
            'webhooks/*',
        ]);
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        $exceptions->shouldRenderJsonWhen(
            fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson(),
        );
    })->create();

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\database\factories\OrderFactory.php ====================

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Enums\AcCapacity;
use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Order>
 */
class OrderFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'customer_id' => User::factory(),
            'technician_id' => TechnicianProfile::factory(),
            'service_id' => Service::factory(),
            'ac_capacity' => AcCapacity::One,
            'ac_brand' => 'Daikin',
            'address' => fake()->streetAddress().', Malang',
            'latitude' => -7.9435,
            'longitude' => 112.6150,
            'preferred_date' => now()->addDay()->toDateString(),
            'time_window' => TimeWindow::Pagi,
            'warranty' => false,
            'warranty_fee' => 0,
            'status' => OrderStatus::MenungguRespons,
            'response_deadline' => now()->addMinutes((int) config('sejuk.response_minutes')),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Record the offer to the assigned technician, as a real request would.
     */
    public function offered(OfferStatus $status = OfferStatus::Menunggu): static
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (Order $order) use ($status) {
            if ($order->technician_id !== null) {
                $order->offers()->create(['technician_id' => $order->technician_id, 'status' => $status]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function withEstimate(int $minimum = 100000, int $maximum = 150000): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'status' => OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk,
            'estimate_min' => $minimum,
            'estimate_max' => $maximum,
            'scheduled_date' => now()->addDay()->toDateString(),
            'scheduled_window' => TimeWindow::Pagi,
            'response_deadline' => null,
        ])->offered(OfferStatus::Diterima);
    }

    public function status(OrderStatus $status): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'status' => $status,
        ]);
    }
}

     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        $business = fake()->unique()->company().' AC';

        return [
            'user_id' => User::factory()->technician()->state(fn () => ['phone' => fake()->unique()->numerify('0813########')]),
            'business_name' => $business,
            'slug' => Str::slug($business).'-'.Str::lower(Str::random(4)),

            'latitude' => -7.9666,

            'badge' => TechnicianBadge::Terdaftar,
            'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Approved,
            'verified_at' => now(),
            'is_active' => true,
            'is_accepting_orders' => true,
            'is_promoted' => false,
            'avg_response_minutes' => 5,
            'rating_avg' => 4.5,
            'reviews_count' => 0,
        ];
    }

    public function pending(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Pending,
            'verified_at' => null,
            'is_accepting_orders' => false,
        ]);
    }

    public function badge(TechnicianBadge $badge): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'badge' => $badge,
        ]);
    }

    public function promoted(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'is_promoted' => true,
        ]);
    }

    public function at(float $latitude, float $longitude): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'latitude' => $latitude,
            'longitude' => $longitude,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Available every day in every time window.
     */
    public function alwaysAvailable(): static
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (TechnicianProfile $technician) {
            foreach (range(0, 6) as $day) {
                foreach (TimeWindow::cases() as $window) {
                    $technician->availabilities()->create([
                        'day_of_week' => $day,
                        'time_window' => $window,
                        'is_available' => true,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Enums\UserRole;

 * @extends Factory<User>

class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */

     * Define the model's default state.

     * @return array<string, mixed>

    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),

            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
            'role' => UserRole::Customer,
            'city' => 'Malang',
        ];
    }

    public function customer(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'role' => UserRole::Customer,
        ]);
    }

    public function technician(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'role' => UserRole::Technician,
        ]);
    }

    public function admin(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'role' => UserRole::Admin,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

     * Reference point the sample distances are measured from: Jl. Kertoraharjo, Ketawanggede.
     */
    public const ORIGIN = [-7.9455, 112.6150];

    /**
     * Base reference prices per service: [service, note, min, max]. Each technician scales them.
     *
     * @var list<array{0: string, 1: string, 2: int, 3: int}>
     */
    private const BASE_PRICES = [
        ['cuci', '0,5â€“1 PK', 60000, 85000],
        ['cuci', '1,5â€“2 PK', 85000, 110000],
        ['perbaikan', 'Cek + perbaikan ringan', 100000, 250000],
        ['bongkar', 'Bongkar + pasang ulang', 300000, 450000],
        ['berkala', 'Per unit, per kunjungan', 75000, 95000],
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private const GALLERY = [
        'photo-1759772238012-9d5ad59ae637',
        'photo-1722131646940-b821a6cc6252',
        'photo-1762341123870-d706f257a12e',
        'photo-1758798157512-f0a864c696c9',
        'photo-1787675907927-ae62773f56f6',
        'photo-1698479603408-1a66a6d9e80f',
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<array{0: string, 1: string}>
     */
    private const REVIEWS = [
        ['Nadia Putri', 'Teknisi datang sesuai jadwal, komunikasinya jelas, dan AC kembali dingin.'],
        ['Raka Aditya', 'Pengerjaan rapi dan setiap tambahan biaya dijelaskan sebelum dikerjakan.'],
        ['Sinta Maharani', 'Respons cepat. Teknisi juga memberi saran perawatan supaya AC tidak cepat kotor.'],
        ['Fajar Nugroho', 'Masalah tetesan air berhasil diperbaiki dan area kerja dibersihkan kembali.'],
        ['Ayu Lestari', 'Hasil servis memuaskan. Suara AC jauh lebih halus setelah selesai dikerjakan.'],
    ];

    /**
     * Run the database seeds.
     */
    public function run(): void
    {
        $services = Service::all()->keyBy('slug');

        foreach ($this->technicians() as $index => $data) {
            [$latitude, $longitude] = self::pointAt($data['distance'], $data['bearing']);

            $user = User::factory()->create([
                'name' => $data['name'],
                'email' => $data['id'].'@sejuk.test',
                'phone' => $data['phone'],
                'phone_verified_at' => now(),
                'role' => UserRole::Technician,
                'avatar_path' => self::unsplash($data['photo'], 600),
            ]);

            $technician = $user->technicianProfile()->create([
                'business_name' => $data['business'],
                'slug' => Str::slug($data['business']),
                'bio' => $data['bio'],
                'years_experience' => $data['years'],
                'jobs_count' => $data['jobs'],
                'service_radius_km' => 10,
                'base_area' => $data['areas'][0],
                'latitude' => $latitude,
                'longitude' => $longitude,
                'badge' => $data['badge'],
                'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Approved,
                'verified_at' => now()->subMonths(6 - $index),
                'is_active' => true,
                'is_accepting_orders' => true,
                'is_promoted' => $data['promo'],
                'avg_response_minutes' => $data['response'],
                'rating_avg' => $data['rating'],
                'reviews_count' => $data['reviews'],
            ]);

            foreach ($data['services'] as $slug) {
                $technician->services()->attach($services[$slug]);
            }

            foreach (self::BASE_PRICES as [$slug, $note, $min, $max]) {
                if (in_array($slug, $data['services'], true)) {
                    $technician->prices()->create([
                        'service_id' => $services[$slug]->id,
                        'note' => $note,
                        'price_min' => self::roundPrice($min * $data['price_factor']),
                        'price_max' => self::roundPrice($max * $data['price_factor']),
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $technician->serviceAreas()->createMany(array_map(fn (string $area) => ['area_name' => $area], $data['areas']));
            $technician->brands()->createMany(array_map(fn (string $brand) => ['brand' => $brand], $data['brands']));
            $technician->photos()->createMany(array_map(fn (string $photo) => ['path' => self::unsplash($photo)], self::GALLERY));

            $this->seedAvailability($technician, $data['windows'], $data['available_today']);
            $this->seedReviews($technician, $index, $data['rating']);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<TimeWindow>  $windows
     */
    private function seedAvailability(TechnicianProfile $technician, array $windows, bool $availableToday): void
    {
        foreach (range(0, 6) as $day) {
            foreach ($windows as $window) {
                $technician->availabilities()->create(['day_of_week' => $day, 'time_window' => $window, 'is_available' => true]);
            }
        }

        if (! $availableToday) {
            foreach (TimeWindow::cases() as $window) {
                $technician->availabilities()->create(['date' => today(), 'time_window' => $window, 'is_available' => false]);
            }
        }
    }

    private function seedReviews(TechnicianProfile $technician, int $offset, float $rating): void
    {
        foreach (range(0, 4) as $index) {
            [$name, $comment] = self::REVIEWS[($index + $offset) % count(self::REVIEWS)];

            $customer = User::firstOrCreate(
                ['email' => Str::slug($name, '.').'@pelanggan.test'],
                ['name' => $name, 'password' => 'password', 'role' => UserRole::Customer, 'city' => 'Malang'],
            );

            $technician->reviews()->forceCreate([
                'customer_id' => $customer->id,
                'rating' => $index === 3 && $rating < 4.8 ? 4 : 5,
                'comment' => $comment,
                'created_at' => now()->subWeeks($index + 2),
                'updated_at' => now()->subWeeks($index + 2),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Coordinates the given distance (km) and bearing (degrees) away from the origin.
     *
     * @return array{0: float, 1: float}
     */
    public static function pointAt(float $distanceKm, float $bearing): array
    {
        [$latitude, $longitude] = self::ORIGIN;
        $radians = deg2rad($bearing);

        return [
            round($latitude + ($distanceKm / 111) * cos($radians), 7),
            round($longitude + ($distanceKm / (111 * cos(deg2rad($latitude)))) * sin($radians), 7),
        ];
    }

    private static function roundPrice(float $amount): int
    {
        return (int) (round($amount / 5000) * 5000);
    }

    private static function unsplash(string $id, int $width = 800): string
    {
        return "https://images.unsplash.com/{$id}?auto=format&fit=crop&w={$width}&q=75";
    }

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\resources\views\components\⚡notification-bell.blade.php ====================

<?php

use Illuminate\Notifications\DatabaseNotification;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Component;

new class extends Component {
    public bool $dark = false;

    #[Computed]
    public function unreadCount(): int
    {
        return auth()->user()->unreadNotifications()->count();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, DatabaseNotification>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function latest(): Collection
    {
        return auth()->user()->notifications()->latest()->limit(8)->get();
    }

    public function open(string $id): void
    {
        $notification = auth()->user()->notifications()->findOrFail($id);
        $notification->markAsRead();

        $url = (string) ($notification->data['url'] ?? '');

        if (str_starts_with($url, url('/'))) {
            $this->redirect($url, navigate: true);
        }
    }

    public function markAllRead(): void
    {
        auth()->user()->unreadNotifications->markAsRead();
        unset($this->unreadCount, $this->latest);
    }
}; ?>

<div class="relative" x-data="{ open: false }" @click.outside="open = false" @keydown.escape.window="open = false" wire:poll.30s>
    <button type="button" @click="open = ! open" :aria-expanded="open" aria-label="Notifikasi{{ $this->unreadCount ? ', '.$this->unreadCount.' belum dibaca' : '' }}"
        @class(['relative grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full transition', 'text-white/70 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white' => $dark, 'bg-white text-ink ring-1 ring-line hover:ring-ink/30' => ! $dark])>
        <flux:icon.bell class="size-[18px]" />
        @if ($this->unreadCount > 0)
            <span class="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 grid min-w-4.5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-coral px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white tnum">{{ min($this->unreadCount, 9) }}{{ $this->unreadCount > 9 ? '+' : '' }}</span>
        @endif
    </button>

    <div x-show="open" x-cloak x-transition.origin.top
        @class(['absolute z-50 mt-2 w-[min(22rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white text-ink shadow-2xl shadow-ink/15 ring-1 ring-line', 'left-0' => $dark, 'right-0' => ! $dark])>
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
            <p class="text-sm font-bold">Notifikasi</p>
            @if ($this->unreadCount > 0)
                <button type="button" wire:click="markAllRead" class="text-xs font-semibold text-ice hover:text-ice-deep">Tandai semua dibaca</button>
            @endif
        </div>
        <div class="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            @forelse ($this->latest as $notification)
                <button type="button" wire:key="n-{{ $notification->id }}" wire:click="open('{{ $notification->id }}')"
                    @class(['flex w-full gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3 text-left last:border-b-0 hover:bg-paper', 'bg-frost/40' => $notification->read_at === null])>
                    <span @class(['mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', 'bg-coral' => $notification->read_at === null, 'bg-transparent' => $notification->read_at !== null])></span>
                    <span class="min-w-0">
                        <span class="block text-sm font-semibold">{{ $notification->data['title'] ?? 'Pembaruan' }}</span>
                        <span class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-xs text-ink-soft">{{ $notification->data['body'] ?? '' }}</span>
                        <span class="mt-1 block text-[11px] text-mute">{{ $notification->created_at?->diffForHumans() }}</span>
                    </span>
                </button>
            @empty
                <p class="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-mute">Belum ada notifikasi.</p>
            @endforelse
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Pesanan')] class extends Component {
    use WithPagination;

    #[Url]
    public string $status = 'aktif';

    #[Url(as: 'q')]
    public string $search = '';

    public function updated(string $property): void
    {
        if (in_array($property, ['status', 'search'], true)) {
            $this->resetPage();
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, Order>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function orders(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $term = trim($this->search);

        return Order::query()
            ->with(['customer', 'technician', 'service'])
            ->when($this->status === 'aktif', fn ($query) => $query->active())
            ->when(OrderStatus::tryFrom($this->status), fn ($query, $status) => $query->where('status', $status))
            ->when($term !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where(fn ($inner) => $inner
                ->where('code', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                ->orWhereHas('customer', fn ($customer) => $customer->where('name', 'like', "%{$term}%"))
                ->orWhereHas('technician', fn ($technician) => $technician->where('business_name', 'like', "%{$term}%"))))
            ->latest()
            ->paginate(20);
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Flux\Flux;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    public string $reason = '';

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->order = $order;
    }

    public function cancel(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:300']], attributes: ['reason' => 'alasan']);

        $this->run(fn () => $workflow->cancelByAdmin($this->order, auth()->user(), $this->reason));
    }

    public function resolve(bool $forwardToTechnician, OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:300']], attributes: ['reason' => 'catatan keputusan']);

        $this->run(fn () => $workflow->resolveDispute($this->order, auth()->user(), $forwardToTechnician, $this->reason));
    }

    public function render(): \Illuminate\Contracts\View\View
    {
        $this->order->load([
            'customer', 'technician.user', 'service', 'media', 'costItems', 'payments', 'review',
            'workProofs', 'offers.technician', 'statusLogs' => fn ($logs) => $logs->with('actor')->orderBy('id'),
        ]);

        return $this->view()->title('Pesanan #'.$this->order->code);
    }

    private function run(Closure $action): void
    {
        try {
            $action();
            $this->reset('reason');
            Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Pesanan diperbarui.');
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->order->refresh();
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;

use Livewire\WithPagination;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Teknisi')] class extends Component {
    use WithPagination;

    #[Url(as: 'q')]

    {
        $this->resetPage();

     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, TechnicianProfile>

        return TechnicianProfile::query()
            ->with('user')
            ->where('verification_status', VerificationStatus::Approved)
            ->when($this->search !== '', fn ($query) => $query->where(fn ($inner) => $inner
                ->where('business_name', 'like', "%{$this->search}%")
                ->orWhereHas('user', fn ($user) => $user->where('name', 'like', "%{$this->search}%"))))
            ->orderBy('business_name')
            ->paginate(20);
    }

    public function changeBadge(int $technicianId, string $badge): void
    {
        $technician = TechnicianProfile::findOrFail($technicianId);
        $technician->update(['badge' => TechnicianBadge::tryFrom($badge) ?? abort(422)]);

        Flux::toast(text: "Badge {$technician->business_name} diubah.");
    }

    public function toggleActive(int $technicianId): void
    {
        $technician = TechnicianProfile::findOrFail($technicianId);
        $technician->update(['is_active' => ! $technician->is_active]);

        Flux::toast(text: $technician->business_name.($technician->is_active ? ' diaktifkan.' : ' dinonaktifkan.'));
    }

    /**
     * Pin a technician on top of search results with the PROMOSI label, optionally for a number of days.
     */
    public function setPromotion(int $technicianId, int $days): void
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($days, [0, -1, 7, 30], true), 422);
        $technician = TechnicianProfile::findOrFail($technicianId);

        $technician->update(match ($days) {
            0 => ['is_promoted' => false, 'promoted_until' => null],
            -1 => ['is_promoted' => true, 'promoted_until' => null],
            default => ['is_promoted' => true, 'promoted_until' => now()->addDays($days)->endOfDay()],
        });

        Flux::toast(text: $days === 0 ? "Promosi {$technician->business_name} dihentikan." : "{$technician->business_name} dipromosikan.");
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;

use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;

use Livewire\Attributes\Url;

use Livewire\WithPagination;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Verifikasi teknisi')] class extends Component {
    use WithPagination;

    #[Url]
    public string $status = 'pending';

    public function updatedStatus(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /**
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, TechnicianProfile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function technicians(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return TechnicianProfile::query()
            ->with(['user', 'services', 'documents', 'experience'])
            ->where('verification_status', VerificationStatus::tryFrom($this->status) ?? VerificationStatus::Pending)
            ->oldest()
            ->paginate(15);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function counts(): array
    {
        return TechnicianProfile::query()
            ->selectRaw('verification_status, count(*) as total')
            ->groupBy('verification_status')
            ->pluck('total', 'verification_status')
            ->map(fn ($total) => (int) $total)
            ->all();
    }
}; ?>

    {
        $this->technician = $technician->load(['user', 'services', 'serviceAreas', 'documents', 'experience']);
        $hasCert = $this->technician->documents->contains(fn ($d) => ($d->type instanceof DocumentType ? $d->type->value : (string) $d->type) === 'sertifikat');
        $this->badge = $hasCert ? 'sertifikat' : 'identitas';
