    public function approve(ReviewTechnicianVerification $review): void
    {
        $this->validate(['badge' => ['required', Rule::enum(TechnicianBadge::class)]]);

        $review->approve($this->technician, TechnicianBadge::from($this->badge), auth()->user());

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: $this->technician->business_name.' disetujui dan dipublikasikan.');
        $this->redirectRoute('admin.verifications.index', navigate: true);
    }

    public function reject(ReviewTechnicianVerification $review): void
    {
        $this->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:10', 'max:500']], attributes: ['reason' => 'alasan penolakan']);

        $review->reject($this->technician, $this->reason, auth()->user());

        Flux::toast(variant: 'warning', text: $this->technician->business_name.' ditolak.');
        $this->redirectRoute('admin.verifications.index', navigate: true);
    }
}; ?>

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Services\Kpi;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Ringkasan')] class extends Component {
    #[Url(as: 'hari')]
    public int $days = 30;

    /**
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function attention(): array
    {
        return [
            'Menunggu verifikasi' => TechnicianProfile::where('verification_status', VerificationStatus::Pending)->count(),
            'Sengketa' => Order::where('status', OrderStatus::Sengketa)->count(),
            'Pesanan aktif' => Order::active()->count(),
            'Siap dicairkan' => Order::where('fund_status', FundStatus::Diteruskan)->whereNull('payout_id')->distinct()->count('technician_id'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function kpi(): array
    {
        $days = in_array($this->days, [7, 30, 90], true) ? $this->days : 30;

        return app(Kpi::class)->summarize(now()->subDays($days)->startOfDay(), now());
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Actions\Payouts\RecordPayout;
use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payout;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection as SupportCollection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Dana & pencairan')] class extends Component {
    /**
     * Transfer references typed per technician.
     *
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    public array $references = [];

    /**
     * @return array{held: int, forwarded: int, paid_out: int, refund: int}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function totals(): array
    {
        $sum = fn (FundStatus $status) => (int) Order::where('fund_status', $status)->sum('final_total');

        return [
            'held' => $sum(FundStatus::Ditahan),
            'forwarded' => (int) Order::where('fund_status', FundStatus::Diteruskan)->get(['final_total', 'commission_amount'])->sum(fn (Order $order) => $order->technicianPayout()),
            'paid_out' => (int) Payout::sum('amount'),
            'refund' => $sum(FundStatus::Dikembalikan),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Technicians with forwarded earnings not yet transferred.
     *
     * @return SupportCollection<int, array{technician: TechnicianProfile, amount: int, orders: int}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function pending(): SupportCollection
    {
        $orders = Order::where('fund_status', FundStatus::Diteruskan)->whereNull('payout_id')->get(['id', 'technician_id', 'final_total', 'commission_amount']);
        $technicians = TechnicianProfile::with(['user', 'payoutAccount'])->whereKey($orders->pluck('technician_id')->unique())->get()->keyBy('id');

        return $orders->groupBy('technician_id')->map(fn (Collection $group, int $technicianId) => [
            'technician' => $technicians[$technicianId],
            'amount' => (int) $group->sum(fn (Order $order) => $order->technicianPayout()),
            'orders' => $group->count(),
        ])->sortByDesc('amount')->values();
    }

    /**
     * Paid orders the admin cancelled, which need a manual refund to the customer.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function refunds(): Collection
    {
        return Order::where('fund_status', FundStatus::Dikembalikan)->with('customer')->latest('updated_at')->limit(20)->get();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Payout>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function payouts(): Collection
    {
        return Payout::with('technician')->latest('transferred_at')->limit(20)->get();
    }

    public function markTransferred(int $technicianId, RecordPayout $recordPayout): void
    {
        $technician = TechnicianProfile::with('payoutAccount')->findOrFail($technicianId);
        $reference = trim($this->references[$technicianId] ?? '') ?: null;

        try {
            $payout = $recordPayout->handle($technician, auth()->user(), $reference);
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());

            return;
        }

        unset($this->references[$technicianId], $this->pending, $this->payouts, $this->totals);
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: rupiah($payout->amount).' ke '.$technician->business_name.' ditandai sudah ditransfer.');
    }
}; ?>

@php
    $totals = $this->totals;
@endphp

<?php

use App\Actions\Reviews\ToggleReviewVisibility;
use App\Models\Review;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

new #[Layout('layouts::admin'), Title('Ulasan')] class extends Component {
    use WithPagination;

    #[Url]
    public string $filter = 'semua';

    public function updatedFilter(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    /**
     * @return LengthAwarePaginator<int, Review>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function reviews(): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return Review::query()
            ->with(['customer', 'technician', 'order'])
            ->when($this->filter === 'disembunyikan', fn ($query) => $query->where('is_hidden', true))
            ->when($this->filter === 'rendah', fn ($query) => $query->where('rating', '<=', 2))
            ->latest()
            ->paginate(20);
    }

    public function toggle(int $reviewId, ToggleReviewVisibility $toggle): void
    {
        $review = $toggle->handle(Review::findOrFail($reviewId));

        Flux::toast(text: $review->is_hidden ? 'Ulasan disembunyikan dari profil teknisi.' : 'Ulasan ditampilkan lagi.');
    }
}; ?>

        @foreach (['semua' => 'Semua', 'rendah' => 'Rating â‰¤ 2', 'disembunyikan' => 'Disembunyikan'] as $value => $label)

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Kirim Estimasi')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    public ?int $price_min = null;

    public ?int $price_max = null;

    public string $visit_date = '';

    public string $time_window = '';

    public string $note = 'Harga final menyesuaikan hasil pemeriksaan komponen di lokasi.';

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('respond', $order);

        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::MenungguRespons) {
            $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $order);

            return;
        }

        $this->order = $order;
        $technician = auth()->user()->technicianProfile->load('prices');
        $suggested = $technician->suggestedEstimate($order);

        $this->price_min = $suggested['min'] ?? null;
        $this->price_max = $suggested['max'] ?? null;
        $this->visit_date = $order->preferred_date->toDateString();
        $this->time_window = $order->time_window->value;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'price_min' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:5000', 'max:50000000'],
            'price_max' => ['required', 'integer', 'gte:price_min', 'max:50000000'],
            'visit_date' => ['required', 'date', 'after_or_equal:today', 'before_or_equal:'.now()->addDays((int) config('sejuk.booking_days_ahead') + 7)->toDateString()],
            'time_window' => ['required', Rule::enum(TimeWindow::class)],
            'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function validationAttributes(): array
    {
        return ['price_min' => 'harga minimum', 'price_max' => 'harga maksimum', 'visit_date' => 'tanggal kedatangan', 'time_window' => 'rentang waktu', 'note' => 'catatan'];
    }

    public function submit(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('respond', $this->order);
        $validated = $this->validate();

        try {
            $workflow->submitEstimate(
                $this->order,
                auth()->user()->technicianProfile,
                (int) $validated['price_min'],
                (int) $validated['price_max'],
                CarbonImmutable::parse($validated['visit_date']),
                TimeWindow::from($validated['time_window']),
                $validated['note'] ?: null,
            );
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());
            $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $this->order, navigate: true);

            return;
        }

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Penawaran berhasil dikirim ke pelanggan.');
        $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $this->order, navigate: true);
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Input Biaya Final')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    /**
     * @var list<array{label: string, amount: int|string|null, is_additional: bool}>
     */
    public array $items = [];

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('respond', $order);

        if (! in_array($order->status, [OrderStatus::Terjadwal, OrderStatus::MenungguPersetujuanBiaya], true)) {
            $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $order);

            return;
        }

        $this->order = $order->load(['service', 'costItems']);

        $existing = $order->costItems->reject(fn ($item) => $order->warranty && $item->amount === $order->warranty_fee && str_starts_with($item->label, 'Garansi Servis'));

        $this->items = $existing->isNotEmpty()
            ? $existing->map(fn ($item) => ['label' => $item->label, 'amount' => $item->amount, 'is_additional' => $item->is_additional])->values()->all()
            : [[
                'label' => $order->service->name.' Â· '.$order->ac_capacity->label(),
                'amount' => (int) (round((($order->estimate_min ?? 0) + ($order->estimate_max ?? 0)) / 2 / 5000) * 5000),
                'is_additional' => false,
            ]];
    }

    public function addItem(): void
    {
        $this->items[] = ['label' => '', 'amount' => null, 'is_additional' => true];
    }

    public function removeItem(int $index): void
    {
        unset($this->items[$index]);
        $this->items = array_values($this->items);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function total(): int
    {
        return (int) collect($this->items)->sum(fn (array $item) => (int) ($item['amount'] ?: 0)) + ($this->order->warranty ? $this->order->warranty_fee : 0);
    }

    public function submit(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('respond', $this->order);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:15'],
            'items.*.label' => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'items.*.amount' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:50000000'],
            'items.*.is_additional' => ['boolean'],
        ], attributes: ['items.*.label' => 'nama biaya', 'items.*.amount' => 'nominal', 'items' => 'rincian biaya']);

        try {
            $workflow->submitFinalCost(
                $this->order,
                auth()->user()->technicianProfile,
                array_map(fn (array $item) => [
                    'label' => trim($item['label']),
                    'amount' => (int) $item['amount'],
                    'is_additional' => (bool) ($item['is_additional'] ?? false),
                ], $validated['items']),
            );
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());

            return;
        }

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Biaya final berhasil dikirim untuk persetujuan pelanggan.');
        $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $this->order, navigate: true);
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Pesanan')] class extends Component {
    #[Url]
    public string $tab = 'masuk';

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile;
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function incoming(): Collection
    {
        return $this->profile->orders()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::MenungguRespons)
            ->with(['service', 'customer'])
            ->orderBy('response_deadline')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function active(): Collection
    {
        return $this->profile->orders()
            ->whereIn('status', array_values(array_filter(OrderStatus::active(), fn (OrderStatus $status) => ! in_array($status, [OrderStatus::MenungguRespons, OrderStatus::CariCadangan], true))))
            ->with(['service', 'customer'])
            ->orderBy('scheduled_date')
            ->get();
    }

    /**
     * Finished or cancelled orders, plus orders this technician declined or let lapse.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Order>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function history(): Collection
    {
        $profileId = $this->profile->id;

        return Order::query()
            ->whereHas('offers', fn ($offers) => $offers->where('technician_id', $profileId))
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query
                ->whereIn('status', [OrderStatus::Selesai, OrderStatus::Dibatalkan])
                ->orWhere('technician_id', '!=', $profileId)
                ->orWhereNull('technician_id'))
            ->with(['service', 'customer', 'offers' => fn ($offers) => $offers->where('technician_id', $profileId)])
            ->latest()
            ->limit(50)
            ->get();
    }
}; ?>

@endphp

        $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.show', $this->order, navigate: true);
    }

<?php

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use App\Services\TechnicianSearch;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $order);

        $this->order = $order;
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function isMine(): bool
    {
        return $this->order->technician_id === auth()->user()->technicianProfile->id;
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function distanceKm(): ?float
    {
        $profile = auth()->user()->technicianProfile;

        if ($this->order->latitude === null || $profile->latitude === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return TechnicianSearch::distanceKm((float) $profile->latitude, (float) $profile->longitude, $this->order->latitude, (float) $this->order->longitude);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function customerCompletedOrders(): int
    {
        return $this->order->customer->orders()->where('status', OrderStatus::Selesai)->count();
    }

    public function reject(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('respond', $this->order);

        try {
            $workflow->releaseToBackup($this->order, OfferStatus::Ditolak, auth()->user(), 'Ditolak teknisi');
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());

            return;
        }

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Pesanan ditolak dan dikembalikan ke pelanggan untuk memilih teknisi cadangan.');
        $this->redirectRoute('mitra.orders.index', navigate: true);
    }

    public function render(): \Illuminate\Contracts\View\View
    {
        $this->order->refresh();
        app(OrderWorkflow::class)->expireIfOverdue($this->order);
        $this->order->load(['service', 'customer', 'media', 'costItems', 'workProofs']);

        return $this->view()->title('Pesanan #'.$this->order->code);
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Services\TechnicianEarnings;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Dashboard')] class extends Component {
    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile;
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function latestIncoming(): ?Order
    {
        return $this->profile->orders()
            ->where('status', OrderStatus::MenungguRespons)
            ->where('response_deadline', '>', now())
            ->with(['service', 'customer'])
            ->orderBy('response_deadline')
            ->first();
    }

    /**
     * @return array{earnings: array{this_month: int, last_month: int, change_percent: int|null}, workload: array{active: int, needs_action: int}, completion: array{rate: int|null, completed: int, finished: int}}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function stats(): array
    {
        $earnings = app(TechnicianEarnings::class);

        return [
            'earnings' => $earnings->monthlyComparison($this->profile),
            'workload' => $earnings->workload($this->profile),
            'completion' => $earnings->completionRate($this->profile),
        ];
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profileIncomplete(): bool
    {
        return blank($this->profile->bio) || ! $this->profile->prices()->exists() || ! $this->profile->photos()->exists();
    }

    public function toggleAccepting(): void
    {
        $this->profile->update(['is_accepting_orders' => ! $this->profile->is_accepting_orders]);
    }

    public function greeting(): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            now()->hour < 4 => 'Selamat malam',
            now()->hour < 11 => 'Selamat pagi',
            now()->hour < 15 => 'Selamat siang',
            now()->hour < 18 => 'Selamat sore',
            default => 'Selamat malam',
        };
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Models\TechnicianPhoto;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Galeri kerja')] class extends Component {
    use WithFileUploads;

    public const MAX_PHOTOS = 12;

    /** @var list<TemporaryUploadedFile> */
    public array $uploads = [];

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile;
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianPhoto>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function photos(): Collection
    {
        return $this->profile->photos()->latest()->get();
    }

    public function updatedUploads(): void
    {
        $remaining = self::MAX_PHOTOS - $this->photos->count();

        $this->validate([
            'uploads' => ['array', 'max:'.max($remaining, 0)],
            'uploads.*' => ['image', 'max:5120'],
        ], ['uploads.max' => "Galeri maksimal ".self::MAX_PHOTOS." foto. Sisa {$remaining} slot."], ['uploads.*' => 'foto']);

        foreach ($this->uploads as $file) {
            $this->profile->photos()->create(['path' => $file->store("gallery/{$this->profile->id}", 'public')]);
        }

        $this->uploads = [];
        unset($this->photos);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Foto ditambahkan ke galeri.');
    }

    public function updateCaption(int $id, string $caption): void
    {
        $this->profile->photos()->findOrFail($id)->update(['caption' => Str::limit(trim($caption), 120, '') ?: null]);
    }

    public function deletePhoto(int $id): void
    {
        $photo = $this->profile->photos()->findOrFail($id);

        if (! Str::startsWith($photo->path, ['http://', 'https://'])) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($photo->path);
        }

        $photo->delete();
        unset($this->photos);
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianPrice;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Harga acuan')] class extends Component {
    /**
     * Editable rows keyed by price id.
     *
     * @var array<int, array{note: string, price_min: int|string, price_max: int|string}>
     */
    public array $rows = [];

    /**
     * New-row drafts keyed by service id.
     *
     * @var array<int, array{note: string, price_min: int|string, price_max: int|string}>
     */
    public array $drafts = [];

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->loadRows();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile;
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function services(): Collection
    {
        return $this->profile->services()->get();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianPrice>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function prices(): Collection
    {
        return $this->profile->prices()->orderBy('price_min')->get();
    }

    public function saveRow(int $priceId): void
    {
        $price = $this->profile->prices()->findOrFail($priceId);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            "rows.$priceId.note" => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
            "rows.$priceId.price_min" => ['required', 'integer', 'min:5000', 'max:50000000'],
            "rows.$priceId.price_max" => ['required', 'integer', "gte:rows.$priceId.price_min", 'max:50000000'],
        ], attributes: $this->attributesFor("rows.$priceId"));

        $price->update($validated['rows'][$priceId]);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Harga disimpan.');
    }

    public function addRow(int $serviceId): void
    {
        abort_unless($this->services->contains('id', $serviceId), 403);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            "drafts.$serviceId.note" => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
            "drafts.$serviceId.price_min" => ['required', 'integer', 'min:5000', 'max:50000000'],
            "drafts.$serviceId.price_max" => ['required', 'integer', "gte:drafts.$serviceId.price_min", 'max:50000000'],
        ], attributes: $this->attributesFor("drafts.$serviceId"));

        $this->profile->prices()->create(['service_id' => $serviceId, ...$validated['drafts'][$serviceId]]);

        unset($this->prices);
        $this->loadRows();

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Baris harga ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function deleteRow(int $priceId): void
    {
        $this->profile->prices()->whereKey($priceId)->delete();

        unset($this->prices);
        $this->loadRows();
    }

    private function loadRows(): void
    {
        $this->rows = $this->prices
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (TechnicianPrice $price) => [$price->id => ['note' => $price->note, 'price_min' => $price->price_min, 'price_max' => $price->price_max]])
            ->all();

        $this->drafts = $this->services
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Service $service) => [$service->id => ['note' => '', 'price_min' => '', 'price_max' => '']])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    private function attributesFor(string $prefix): array
    {
        return ["$prefix.note" => 'keterangan', "$prefix.price_min" => 'harga minimum', "$prefix.price_max" => 'harga maksimum'];
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;

use App\Models\Service;

use App\Models\User;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Profil Teknisi')] class extends Component {
    use ProfileValidationRules, WithFileUploads;

    public bool $editing = false;

    public string $name = '';

    public string $business_name = '';

    public string $phone = '';

    public string $email = '';

    public string $base_area = '';

    public int $years_experience = 0;

    public int $service_radius_km = 10;

    public string $bio = '';

    /** @var list<int> */
    public array $service_ids = [];

    /** @var list<string> */
    public array $brands = [];

    public string $areas = '';

    /** @var TemporaryUploadedFile|null */
    public $photo = null;

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->fillFromProfile();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile->load(['user', 'services', 'brands', 'serviceAreas', 'documents', 'experience']);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function allServices(): Collection
    {
        return Service::orderBy('sort_order')->get();
    }

    public function edit(): void
    {
        $this->editing = true;
    }

    public function cancel(): void
    {
        $this->resetValidation();
        $this->fillFromProfile();
        $this->editing = false;
    }

    public function save(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile;
        $user = $profile->user;
        $this->phone = User::normalizePhone($this->phone);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'email' => $this->emailRules($user->id),
            'phone' => $this->phoneRules($user->id),
            'business_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'base_area' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'years_experience' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:60'],
            'service_radius_km' => ['required', Rule::in(config('sejuk.technician_radius_options'))],
            'bio' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
            'service_ids' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'service_ids.*' => [Rule::exists('services', 'id')],
            'brands' => ['array'],
            'brands.*' => [Rule::in(config('sejuk.brands'))],
            'areas' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'photo' => ['nullable', 'image', 'max:4096'],
        ], attributes: ['service_ids' => 'layanan', 'areas' => 'area layanan', 'base_area' => 'area utama', 'photo' => 'foto profil']);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $user, $validated) {
            $user->fill(['name' => $validated['name'], 'email' => $validated['email'], 'phone' => $validated['phone']]);

            if ($user->isDirty('email')) {
                $user->email_verified_at = null;
            }

            if ($this->photo !== null) {
                $user->avatar_path = $this->photo->store('avatars', 'public');
            }

            $user->save();

            $profile->update([
                'business_name' => $validated['business_name'],
                'base_area' => $validated['base_area'],
                'years_experience' => $validated['years_experience'],
                'service_radius_km' => $validated['service_radius_km'],
                'bio' => $validated['bio'] ?: null,
            ]);

            $profile->services()->sync($validated['service_ids']);
            $profile->prices()->whereNotIn('service_id', $validated['service_ids'])->delete();

            $profile->brands()->delete();
            $profile->brands()->createMany(array_map(fn (string $brand) => ['brand' => $brand], array_values(array_unique($validated['brands']))));

            $profile->serviceAreas()->delete();
            $areas = collect(explode(',', $validated['areas']))->map(fn (string $area) => trim($area))->filter()->unique();
            $profile->serviceAreas()->createMany($areas->map(fn (string $area) => ['area_name' => $area])->values()->all());
        });

        unset($this->profile);
        $this->photo = null;
        $this->editing = false;

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Profil berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    private function fillFromProfile(): void
    {
        $profile = $this->profile;

        $this->name = $profile->user->name;
        $this->business_name = $profile->business_name;
        $this->phone = (string) $profile->user->phone;
        $this->email = $profile->user->email;
        $this->base_area = (string) $profile->base_area;
        $this->years_experience = $profile->years_experience;
        $this->service_radius_km = $profile->service_radius_km;
        $this->bio = (string) $profile->bio;
        $this->service_ids = $profile->services->pluck('id')->all();
        $this->brands = $profile->brands->pluck('brand')->all();
        $this->areas = $profile->serviceAreas->pluck('area_name')->implode(', ');
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Actions\Technician\RegisterTechnician;
use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Daftar Sejuk Mitra')] class extends Component {
    use ProfileValidationRules, WithFileUploads;

    public string $name = '';

    public string $business_name = '';

    public string $phone = '';

    public string $email = '';

    public string $password = '';

    public string $area = '';

    public ?int $service_id = null;

    public int $radius = 10;

    /** @var TemporaryUploadedFile|null */
    public $ktp = null;

    public string $competency = 'certificate';

    /** @var TemporaryUploadedFile|null */
    public $certificate = null;

    public ?int $experience_years = null;

    public string $reference_phone = '';

    public string $experience_description = '';

    public bool $agreed = false;

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->service_id = $this->services->first()?->id;
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function services(): Collection
    {
        return Service::orderBy('sort_order')->get();
    }

    /**
     * What still blocks submission, mirroring the disabled submit button.
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function canSubmit(): bool
    {
        $competencyReady = $this->competency === 'certificate'
            ? $this->certificate !== null
            : $this->experience_years !== null && $this->reference_phone !== '' && $this->experience_description !== '';

        return $this->ktp !== null && $this->agreed && $competencyReady;
    }

    public function updatedKtp(): void
    {
        $this->validateOnly('ktp');
    }

    public function updatedCertificate(): void
    {
        $this->validateOnly('certificate');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function rules(): array
    {
        $usesCertificate = $this->competency === 'certificate';

        return [
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'business_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'phone' => $this->phoneRules(),
            'email' => $this->emailRules(),
            'password' => ['required', 'string', Password::default()],
            'area' => ['required', 'string', 'max:120'],
            'service_id' => ['required', Rule::exists('services', 'id')],
            'radius' => ['required', Rule::in(config('sejuk.technician_radius_options'))],
            'ktp' => ['required', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:5120'],
            'competency' => ['required', Rule::in(['certificate', 'experience'])],
            'certificate' => [Rule::requiredIf($usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'file', 'mimes:pdf,jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:10240'],
            'experience_years' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:60'],
            'reference_phone' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'experience_description' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
            'agreed' => ['accepted'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function validationAttributes(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => 'nama lengkap',
            'area' => 'area layanan',
            'service_id' => 'layanan utama',
            'radius' => 'radius layanan',
            'ktp' => 'foto KTP',
            'certificate' => 'sertifikat',
            'experience_years' => 'lama pengalaman',
            'reference_phone' => 'nomor referensi',
            'experience_description' => 'cerita pengalaman',
            'agreed' => 'pernyataan data benar',
        ];
    }

    public function register(RegisterTechnician $registerTechnician): void
    {
        $this->phone = User::normalizePhone($this->phone);
        $this->email = str($this->email)->lower()->trim()->toString();

        $validated = $this->validate();
        $usesCertificate = $this->competency === 'certificate';

        $user = $registerTechnician->handle(
            account: [
                'name' => $validated['name'],
                'business_name' => $validated['business_name'],
                'phone' => $validated['phone'],
                'email' => $validated['email'],
                'password' => $validated['password'],
                'area' => $validated['area'],
                'service_id' => (int) $validated['service_id'],
                'radius' => (int) $validated['radius'],
            ],
            ktp: $this->ktp,
            certificate: $usesCertificate ? $this->certificate : null,
            experience: $usesCertificate ? null : [
                'years' => (int) $validated['experience_years'],
                'reference_phone' => $validated['reference_phone'],
                'description' => $validated['experience_description'],
            ],
        );

        Auth::login($user);
        session()->regenerate();

        $this->redirectRoute('mitra.verification');
    }
}; ?>

            @endif
        </div>
    </form>

<?php

use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::mitra'), Title('Jadwal')] class extends Component {
    /**
     * Weekly availability: day of week (0 = Minggu) => window value => available.
     *
     * @var array<int, array<string, bool>>
     */
    public array $weekly = [];

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $rules = $this->profile->availabilities()->whereNull('date')->where('is_available', true)->get();

        foreach (range(0, 6) as $day) {
            foreach (TimeWindow::cases() as $window) {
                $this->weekly[$day][$window->value] = $rules->contains(fn ($rule) => $rule->day_of_week === $day && $rule->time_window === $window);
            }
        }
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile;
    }

    /**
     * The next 14 days with whether each is marked as a day off.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, array{date: CarbonImmutable, off: bool, windows: list<TimeWindow>}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function upcoming(): Collection
    {
        $profile = $this->profile->load('availabilities');

        return collect(range(0, 13))->map(function (int $offset) use ($profile) {
            $date = CarbonImmutable::today()->addDays($offset);
            $off = $profile->availabilities->contains(fn ($rule) => $rule->date?->isSameDay($date) && ! $rule->is_available);

            return ['date' => $date, 'off' => $off, 'windows' => $profile->windowsOn($date)];
        });
    }

    public function toggle(int $day, string $window): void
    {
        abort_unless(isset($this->weekly[$day]) && TimeWindow::tryFrom($window), 422);

        $this->weekly[$day][$window] = ! $this->weekly[$day][$window];
    }

    public function saveWeekly(): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () {
            $this->profile->availabilities()->whereNull('date')->delete();

            foreach ($this->weekly as $day => $windows) {
                foreach ($windows as $window => $available) {
                    if ($available) {
                        $this->profile->availabilities()->create(['day_of_week' => $day, 'time_window' => $window, 'is_available' => true]);
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        unset($this->upcoming);
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Jadwal mingguan disimpan.');
    }

    /**
     * Mark a date as a day off, or undo it so the weekly schedule applies again.
     */
    public function toggleDayOff(string $date): void
    {
        $day = CarbonImmutable::parse($date)->startOfDay();
        abort_if($day->isPast() && ! $day->isToday(), 422);

        $overrides = $this->profile->availabilities()->whereDate('date', $day);

        if ($overrides->exists()) {
            $overrides->delete();
        } else {
            foreach (TimeWindow::cases() as $window) {
                $this->profile->availabilities()->create(['date' => $day, 'time_window' => $window, 'is_available' => false]);
            }
        }

        unset($this->upcoming, $this->profile);
    }
}; ?>

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\resources\views\pages\mitra\⚡verification.blade.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\DocumentStatus;
use App\Enums\DocumentType;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\TechnicianDocument;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Menunggu verifikasi')] class extends Component {
    use WithFileUploads;

    public bool $isEditing = false;

    public string $competency = 'certificate';

    /** @var \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile|null */
    public $ktp = null;

    /** @var \Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile|null */
    public $certificate = null;

    public ?int $experience_years = null;

    public string $reference_phone = '';

    public string $experience_description = '';

    public function mount(): void
    {
        if ($this->profile?->verification_status === VerificationStatus::Approved) {
            $this->redirectRoute('mitra.dashboard');
        }
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function profile(): ?TechnicianProfile
    {
        return auth()->user()->technicianProfile?->load(['documents', 'experience']);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function hasCertificate(): bool
    {
        $documents = $this->profile?->documents ?? collect();

        return $documents->contains(function ($document) {
            $typeVal = $document->type instanceof DocumentType ? $document->type->value : (string) $document->type;

            return $typeVal === 'sertifikat';
        });
    }

    public function startEditing(): void
    {
        $this->isEditing = true;
        $this->competency = $this->hasCertificate ? 'certificate' : 'experience';

        if ($this->profile?->experience) {
            $this->experience_years = $this->profile->experience->years;
            $this->reference_phone = $this->profile->experience->reference_phone;
            $this->experience_description = $this->profile->experience->description;
        }
    }

    public function cancelEditing(): void
    {
        $this->isEditing = false;
        $this->reset(['ktp', 'certificate', 'experience_years', 'reference_phone', 'experience_description']);
    }

    public function resubmit(): void
    {
        $usesCertificate = $this->competency === 'certificate';
        $hasExistingCertificate = $this->hasCertificate;

        $rules = [
            'ktp' => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:5120'],
            'competency' => ['required', Rule::in(['certificate', 'experience'])],
            'certificate' => [
                Rule::requiredIf($usesCertificate && ! $hasExistingCertificate),
                'nullable',
                'file',
                'mimes:pdf,jpg,jpeg,png',
                'max:10240',
            ],
            'experience_years' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:60'],
            'reference_phone' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'experience_description' => [Rule::requiredIf(! $usesCertificate), 'nullable', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ];

        $this->validate($rules, attributes: [
            'ktp' => 'foto KTP',
            'certificate' => 'sertifikat',
            'experience_years' => 'lama pengalaman',
            'reference_phone' => 'nomor referensi',
            'experience_description' => 'cerita pengalaman',
        ]);

        $profile = $this->profile;
        if (! $profile) {
            return;
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($profile, $usesCertificate) {
            // Perbarui KTP jika ada file baru diunggah
            if ($this->ktp) {
                $oldKtp = $profile->documents()->firstWhere('type', DocumentType::Ktp);
                if ($oldKtp) {
                    Storage::disk(TechnicianDocument::DISK)->delete($oldKtp->path);
                    $oldKtp->delete();
                }

                $profile->documents()->create([
                    'type' => DocumentType::Ktp,
                    'path' => $this->ktp->store("technician-documents/{$profile->id}", TechnicianDocument::DISK),
                    'status' => DocumentStatus::Pending,
                ]);
            } else {
                // Kembalikan status KTP ke pending jika sebelumnya ditolak
                $profile->documents()->where('type', DocumentType::Ktp)->update([
                    'status' => DocumentStatus::Pending,
                ]);
            }

            if ($usesCertificate) {
                if ($this->certificate) {
                    $oldCert = $profile->documents()->where('type', DocumentType::Sertifikat)->first();
                    if ($oldCert) {
                        Storage::disk(TechnicianDocument::DISK)->delete($oldCert->path);
                        $oldCert->delete();
                    }

                    $profile->documents()->create([
                        'type' => DocumentType::Sertifikat,
                        'path' => $this->certificate->store("technician-documents/{$profile->id}", TechnicianDocument::DISK),
                        'status' => DocumentStatus::Pending,
                    ]);
                } else {
                    $profile->documents()->where('type', DocumentType::Sertifikat)->update([
                        'status' => DocumentStatus::Pending,
                    ]);
                }

                // Hapus data pengalaman lama jika beralih ke jalur sertifikat
                $profile->experience()?->delete();
                $profile->update(['years_experience' => 0]);
            } else {
                // Jalur pengalaman: hapus sertifikat jika sebelumnya ada
                $oldCerts = $profile->documents()->where('type', DocumentType::Sertifikat)->get();
                foreach ($oldCerts as $cert) {
                    Storage::disk(TechnicianDocument::DISK)->delete($cert->path);
                    $cert->delete();
                }

                $profile->experience()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['technician_id' => $profile->id],
                    [
                        'years' => (int) $this->experience_years,
                        'reference_phone' => $this->reference_phone,
                        'description' => $this->experience_description,
                    ]
                );

                $profile->update([
                    'years_experience' => (int) $this->experience_years,
                ]);
            }

            // Kembalikan status akun ke Pending
            $profile->update([
                'verification_status' => VerificationStatus::Pending,
                'verification_note' => null,
            ]);
        });

        // Invalidate Livewire computed cache agar tampilan langsung ter-refresh dengan data baru
        unset($this->profile);
        unset($this->hasCertificate);
        unset($this->steps);

        $this->isEditing = false;
        $this->reset(['ktp', 'certificate', 'experience_years', 'reference_phone', 'experience_description']);
        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Data verifikasi berhasil dikirim ulang dan sedang ditinjau kembali oleh tim Sejuk.');
    }

    /**
     * The three verification steps and whether each is finished.
     *
     * @return list<array{title: string, detail: string, done: bool}>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function steps(): array
    {
        $documents = $this->profile?->documents ?? collect();
        $ktpDone = $documents->contains(function ($document) {
            $typeVal = $document->type instanceof DocumentType ? $document->type->value : (string) $document->type;
            $statusVal = $document->status instanceof DocumentStatus ? $document->status->value : (string) $document->status;

            return $typeVal === 'ktp' && $statusVal === 'approved';
        });

        $hasCert = $this->hasCertificate;
        $competencyReviewed = $hasCert
            ? $documents->contains(function ($document) {
                $typeVal = $document->type instanceof DocumentType ? $document->type->value : (string) $document->type;
                $statusVal = $document->status instanceof DocumentStatus ? $document->status->value : (string) $document->status;

                return $typeVal === 'sertifikat' && $statusVal !== 'pending';
            })
            : ($this->profile?->verification_status === VerificationStatus::Approved);

        return [
            ['title' => 'Identitas', 'detail' => 'KTP diperiksa', 'done' => $ktpDone],
            ['title' => 'Kompetensi', 'detail' => $hasCert ? 'Sertifikat ditinjau' : 'Video call alat kerja', 'done' => $competencyReviewed],
            ['title' => 'Aktivasi', 'detail' => 'Profil dipublikasikan', 'done' => false],
        ];
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Enums\PaymentMethod;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Services\Midtrans\MidtransException;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use App\Services\PaymentService;
use App\Support\OrderSimulator;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    public bool $confirmRejectFinal = false;

    public ?string $paymentMethod = null;

    public bool $showReworkForm = false;

    public string $complaint = '';

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('manage', $order);

        $this->order = $order;
        $this->expireIfOverdue();
    }

    /**
     * Pick up changes made by the technician or the scheduler while the page is open.
     */
    public function refreshOrder(): void
    {
        $this->order->refresh();
        $this->expireIfOverdue();
        $this->syncPendingPayment(onlyIfStale: true);
        unset($this->backupCandidates, $this->pendingPayment, $this->lastPaymentAttempt);
    }

    public function startPayment(PaymentService $payments): void
    {
        $method = PaymentMethod::tryFrom((string) $this->paymentMethod);

        if ($method === null) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: 'Pilih metode pembayaran dulu.');

            return;
        }

        try {
            $payments->start($this->order, $method);
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition|MidtransException $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->refreshOrder();
    }

    public function changePaymentMethod(PaymentService $payments): void
    {
        if ($this->pendingPayment !== null) {
            $payments->cancel($this->pendingPayment);
        }

        $this->refreshOrder();
    }

    /**
     * "Saya sudah bayar": check with Midtrans right away instead of waiting for the webhook.
     */
    public function checkPayment(): void
    {
        $this->syncPendingPayment(onlyIfStale: false);
        $this->order->refresh();
        unset($this->pendingPayment, $this->lastPaymentAttempt);

        if ($this->order->status === OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran && $this->pendingPayment !== null) {
            Flux::toast(text: 'Pembayaran belum kami terima. Halaman ini akan berpindah otomatis setelah diterima.');
        }
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function pendingPayment(): ?Payment
    {
        return app(PaymentService::class)->pendingPayment($this->order);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function lastPaymentAttempt(): ?Payment
    {
        return $this->order->payments()->latest('id')->first();
    }

    public function requestBackup(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->releaseToBackup($this->order, OfferStatus::Kedaluwarsa, auth()->user(), 'Pelanggan memilih teknisi cadangan'));
    }

    public function chooseBackup(int $technicianId, OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $technician = $this->backupCandidates->firstWhere('id', $technicianId);

        if (! $technician instanceof TechnicianProfile) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: 'Teknisi ini sudah tidak tersedia. Pilih yang lain.');
            unset($this->backupCandidates);

            return;
        }

        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->reassign($this->order, $technician, auth()->user()));
    }

    public function approveEstimate(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->approveEstimate($this->order, auth()->user()));
    }

    public function rejectEstimate(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $businessName = $this->order->technician?->business_name;

        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->rejectEstimate($this->order, auth()->user()));

        if ($this->order->status === OrderStatus::CariCadangan) {
            session([
                'sejuk.hidden_technicians' => $this->order->offers()->pluck('technician_id')->all(),
                'sejuk.pending_order' => $this->order->code,
            ]);
            session()->flash('sejuk.rejected_notice', "Estimasi dari {$businessName} ditolak. Pilih teknisi lain, formulirmu tetap tersimpan.");

            $this->redirectRoute('search', ['layanan' => $this->order->service->slug], navigate: true);
        }
    }

    public function approveFinalCost(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->approveFinalCost($this->order, auth()->user()));
    }

    public function rejectFinalCost(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->rejectFinalCost($this->order, auth()->user()));
        $this->confirmRejectFinal = false;
    }

    public function confirmCompletion(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->confirmCompletion($this->order, auth()->user()));
    }

    public function requestRework(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->validate(['complaint' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500']], attributes: ['complaint' => 'keluhan']);

        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->requestRework($this->order, auth()->user(), trim($this->complaint) ?: null));
        $this->reset('showReworkForm', 'complaint');
    }

    /**
     * Local development only: run a technician or payment step from the simulation panel.
     */
    public function simulate(string $action, OrderSimulator $simulator): void
    {
        abort_unless(OrderSimulator::isEnabled(), 404);
        Gate::authorize('manage', $this->order);

        $this->runAction(fn () => $simulator->run($this->order->refresh(), $action));
    }

    public function findOtherTechnician(): void
    {
        session([
            'sejuk.hidden_technicians' => $this->order->offers()->pluck('technician_id')->all(),
            'sejuk.pending_order' => $this->order->code,
        ]);

        $this->redirectRoute('search', ['layanan' => $this->order->service->slug], navigate: true);
    }

    public function cancel(OrderWorkflow $workflow): void
    {
        $this->runAction(fn () => $workflow->cancelByCustomer($this->order, auth()->user()));
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianProfile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function backupCandidates(): Collection
    {
        if ($this->order->status !== OrderStatus::CariCadangan) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        return app(OrderWorkflow::class)->backupCandidates($this->order);
    }

    public function render(): \Illuminate\Contracts\View\View
    {
        $this->order->loadMissing(['technician.user', 'service', 'media', 'offers', 'costItems', 'payments', 'workProofs', 'review']);

        return $this->view()->title('Pesanan #'.$this->order->code);
    }

    private function runAction(Closure $action): void
    {
        try {
            $action();
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->refreshOrder();
    }

    private function syncPendingPayment(bool $onlyIfStale): void
    {
        $payment = app(PaymentService::class)->pendingPayment($this->order);

        if ($payment === null) {
            return;
        }

        if ($onlyIfStale && $payment->synced_at !== null && $payment->synced_at->gt(now()->subSeconds(15)) && ! $payment->isOverdue()) {
            return;
        }

        app(PaymentService::class)->sync($payment);
        $this->order->refresh();
    }

    private function expireIfOverdue(): void
    {
        if (app(OrderWorkflow::class)->expireIfOverdue($this->order)) {
            $this->order->refresh();
        }
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\AcCapacity;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Services\Geocoder;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use App\Support\CustomerLocation;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Features\SupportFileUploads\TemporaryUploadedFile;
use Livewire\WithFileUploads;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Minta penawaran')] class extends Component {
    use WithFileUploads;

    #[Locked]
    public TechnicianProfile $technician;

    /**
     * Code of an existing order being re-sent to this technician.
     */
    #[Url(as: 'pesanan'), Locked]
    public ?string $orderCode = null;

    #[Url(as: 'layanan')]
    public string $serviceSlug = '';

    public ?int $service_id = null;

    public string $ac_capacity = '';

    public string $ac_brand = '';

    public string $ac_brand_other = '';

    /** @var list<TemporaryUploadedFile> */
    public array $media = [];

    /** @var list<TemporaryUploadedFile> */
    public array $newMedia = [];

    public string $address = '';

    public string $address_detail = '';

    public ?int $day = null;

    public string $time_window = '';

    public bool $warranty = false;

    public string $notes = '';

    public function mount(TechnicianProfile $technician, CustomerLocation $location): void
    {
        abort_unless($technician->verification_status === VerificationStatus::Approved && $technician->is_active, 404);

        $this->technician = $technician->load(['user', 'services']);

        if ($this->existingOrder !== null) {
            $this->fillFromOrder($this->existingOrder);

            return;
        }

        $this->service_id = $this->offeredServices->firstWhere('slug', $this->serviceSlug)?->id ?? $this->offeredServices->first()?->id;

        $current = $location->current(auth()->user());
        $this->address = $current['address'] ?? '';
        $this->address_detail = $current['detail'] ?? (auth()->user()->primaryAddress?->detail ?? '');
    }

    /**
     * The order being re-sent, when the customer comes back from backup selection or a rejected estimate.
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function existingOrder(): ?Order
    {
        if ($this->orderCode === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $order = Order::with('media')->where('code', $this->orderCode)->first();

        abort_if($order === null || $order->customer_id !== auth()->id(), 404);

        // A stale link (the order moved on or was cancelled) starts a fresh request instead.
        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::CariCadangan) {
            session()->forget('sejuk.pending_order');
            $this->orderCode = null;

            return null;
        }

        return $order;
    }

    /**
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, \App\Models\Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function offeredServices(): \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection
    {
        return $this->technician->services;
    }

    /**
     * Dates the customer can pick: today and the next six days.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function dayOptions(): Collection
    {
        return collect(range(0, (int) config('sejuk.booking_days_ahead')))->mapWithKeys(fn (int $offset) => [
            $offset => match ($offset) {
                0 => 'Hari ini',
                1 => 'Besok',
                default => now()->addDays($offset)->translatedFormat('D, j M'),
            },
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Required fields still empty, in the order shown by the form.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function missingFields(): array
    {
        return array_keys(array_filter([
            'PK AC' => $this->ac_capacity === '',
            'merek AC' => $this->ac_brand === '' || ($this->ac_brand === 'Lainnya' && trim($this->ac_brand_other) === ''),
            'alamat' => trim($this->address) === '',
            'tanggal' => $this->day === null,
            'jam' => $this->time_window === '',
        ]));
    }

    public function updatedNewMedia(): void
    {
        $this->validate([
            'newMedia.*' => ['file', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp,heic,mp4,mov,webm', 'max:20480'],
        ], attributes: ['newMedia.*' => 'file']);

        $remaining = $this->mediaLimit() - count($this->media);
        $this->media = [...$this->media, ...array_slice($this->newMedia, 0, max(0, $remaining))];
        $this->newMedia = [];
    }

    public function removeMedia(int $index): void
    {
        array_splice($this->media, $index, 1);
    }

    public function mediaLimit(): int
    {
        return (int) config('sejuk.max_order_media') - ($this->existingOrder?->media->count() ?? 0);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'service_id' => ['required', Rule::in($this->offeredServices->pluck('id')->all())],
            'ac_capacity' => ['required', Rule::enum(AcCapacity::class)],
            'ac_brand' => ['required', Rule::in(config('sejuk.brands'))],
            'ac_brand_other' => ['required_if:ac_brand,Lainnya', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'media' => ['array', 'max:'.$this->mediaLimit()],
            'media.*' => ['file', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp,heic,mp4,mov,webm', 'max:20480'],
            'address' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'address_detail' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'day' => ['required', 'integer', 'between:0,'.config('sejuk.booking_days_ahead')],
            'time_window' => ['required', Rule::enum(TimeWindow::class)],
            'warranty' => ['boolean'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function validationAttributes(): array
    {
        return ['ac_brand_other' => 'merek AC', 'day' => 'tanggal', 'address_detail' => 'detail lokasi', 'notes' => 'catatan', 'media' => 'foto/video'];
    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->withValidator(function (Validator $validator) {
            $validator->after(function (Validator $validator) {
                $window = TimeWindow::tryFrom($this->time_window);

                if ($this->day === 0 && $window !== null && now()->hour >= $window->startHour() + 2) {
                    $validator->errors()->add('time_window', 'Slot waktu ini sudah lewat untuk hari ini. Pilih slot lain.');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    public function submit(OrderWorkflow $workflow, CustomerLocation $location, Geocoder $geocoder): void
    {
        abort_unless($this->technician->is_accepting_orders, 422, 'Teknisi sedang tidak menerima pesanan.');

        $validated = $this->validate();

        $current = $location->current(auth()->user());
        $coordinates = $current !== null && $current['address'] === $validated['address'] && $current['latitude'] !== null
            ? ['latitude' => $current['latitude'], 'longitude' => $current['longitude']]
            : $geocoder->search($validated['address']);

        $details = [
            'service_id' => $validated['service_id'],
            'ac_capacity' => $validated['ac_capacity'],
            'ac_brand' => $validated['ac_brand'],
            'ac_brand_other' => $validated['ac_brand'] === 'Lainnya' ? $validated['ac_brand_other'] : null,
            'address' => $validated['address'],
            'address_detail' => $validated['address_detail'] ?: null,
            'latitude' => $coordinates['latitude'] ?? null,
            'longitude' => $coordinates['longitude'] ?? null,
            'preferred_date' => now()->addDays((int) $validated['day'])->toDateString(),
            'time_window' => $validated['time_window'],
            'warranty' => (bool) $validated['warranty'],
            'notes' => $validated['notes'] ?: null,
        ];

        try {
            if ($this->existingOrder !== null) {
                $order = $workflow->reassign($this->existingOrder, $this->technician, auth()->user(), $details);
                $this->storeExtraMedia($order);
            } else {
                $order = $workflow->submit(auth()->user(), $this->technician, $details, $this->media);
            }
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());

            return;
        }

        $location->set($validated['address'], $details['latitude'], $details['longitude'], detail: $details['address_detail']);
        session()->forget(['sejuk.hidden_technicians', 'sejuk.rejected_notice', 'sejuk.pending_order']);

        $this->redirectRoute('orders.show', $order, navigate: true);
    }

    private function storeExtraMedia(Order $order): void
    {
        foreach ($this->media as $file) {
            $order->media()->create([
                'path' => $file->store("order-media/{$order->id}", 'local'),
                'type' => str_starts_with((string) $file->getMimeType(), 'video/') ? 'video' : 'foto',
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function fillFromOrder(Order $order): void
    {
        $this->service_id = $this->offeredServices->contains('id', $order->service_id) ? $order->service_id : $this->offeredServices->first()?->id;
        $this->ac_capacity = $order->ac_capacity->value;
        $this->ac_brand = $order->ac_brand;
        $this->ac_brand_other = (string) $order->ac_brand_other;
        $this->address = $order->address;
        $this->address_detail = (string) $order->address_detail;
        $offset = (int) now()->startOfDay()->diffInDays($order->preferred_date->startOfDay(), false);
        $this->day = $offset >= 0 && $offset <= (int) config('sejuk.booking_days_ahead') ? $offset : null;
        $this->time_window = $order->time_window->value;
        $this->warranty = $order->warranty;
        $this->notes = (string) $order->notes;
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Actions\Reviews\SubmitReview;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Beri ulasan')] class extends Component {
    public Order $order;

    public int $rating = 0;

    public string $comment = '';

    public bool $sent = false;

    public function mount(Order $order): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('manage', $order);

        if ($order->status !== OrderStatus::Selesai) {
            $this->redirectRoute('orders.show', $order);

            return;
        }

        $this->order = $order->load(['technician.user', 'service', 'review']);
        $this->sent = $order->review !== null;
    }

    public function setRating(int $rating): void
    {
        $this->rating = max(1, min(5, $rating));
    }

    public function submit(SubmitReview $submitReview): void
    {
        Gate::authorize('manage', $this->order);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'rating' => ['required', 'integer', 'between:1,5'],
            'comment' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ], ['rating.between' => 'Pilih rating 1 sampai 5 bintang.'], ['comment' => 'cerita pengalaman']);

        try {
            $submitReview->handle($this->order, (int) $validated['rating'], trim($validated['comment'] ?? '') ?: null);
        } catch (InvalidOrderTransition $exception) {
            Flux::toast(variant: 'danger', text: $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->order->load('review');
        $this->sent = $this->order->review !== null;
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Concerns\PasswordValidationRules;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Laravel\Fortify\Actions\DisableTwoFactorAuthentication;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;
use Laravel\Fortify\Fortify;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Title('Security settings')] class extends Component {
    use PasswordValidationRules;

    public string $current_password = '';
    public string $password = '';
    public string $password_confirmation = '';



    /**
     * Mount the component.
     */
    public function mount(DisableTwoFactorAuthentication $disableTwoFactorAuthentication): void
    {

    }

    /**
     * Update the password for the currently authenticated user.
     */
    public function updatePassword(): void
    {
        try {
            $validated = $this->validate([
                'current_password' => $this->currentPasswordRules(),
                'password' => $this->passwordRules(),
            ]);
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->reset('current_password', 'password', 'password_confirmation');

            throw $e;
        }

        Auth::user()->update([
            'password' => $validated['password'],
        ]);

        $this->reset('current_password', 'password', 'password_confirmation');

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: __('Password updated.'));
    }


}; ?>

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\resources\views\pages\⚡account.blade.php ====================

<?php

use App\Concerns\ProfileValidationRules;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\CustomerAddress;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Geocoder;
use App\Support\CustomerLocation;
use Flux\Flux;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Profil saya')] class extends Component {
    use ProfileValidationRules;

    public bool $editing = false;

    public string $name = '';

    public string $phone = '';

    public string $email = '';

    public string $city = '';

    /**
     * Address being edited: null = none, 0 = new address, otherwise the address id.
     */
    public ?int $addressFormId = null;

    public string $label = '';

    public string $address = '';

    public string $detail = '';

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->fillProfile();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function user(): User
    {
        return auth()->user();
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, CustomerAddress>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function addresses(): Collection
    {
        return $this->user->addresses()->orderByDesc('is_primary')->oldest()->get();
    }

    /**
     * @return array{total: int, completed: int, active: int}
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function summary(): array
    {
        $orders = $this->user->orders()->pluck('status');

        return [
            'total' => $orders->count(),
            'completed' => $orders->filter(fn (OrderStatus $status) => $status === OrderStatus::Selesai)->count(),
            'active' => $orders->filter(fn (OrderStatus $status) => $status->isActive())->count(),
        ];
    }

    public function edit(): void
    {
        $this->editing = true;
    }

    public function cancelEdit(): void
    {
        $this->resetValidation();
        $this->fillProfile();
        $this->editing = false;
    }

    public function saveProfile(): void
    {
        $user = $this->user;
        $this->phone = User::normalizePhone($this->phone);

        $validated = $this->validate([
            'name' => $this->nameRules(),
            'phone' => $this->phoneRules($user->id),
            'email' => $this->emailRules($user->id),
            'city' => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
        ], attributes: ['city' => 'kota']);

        $user->fill($validated);

        if ($user->isDirty('phone')) {
            $user->phone_verified_at = null;
        }

        if ($user->isDirty('email')) {
            $user->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $user->save();
        $this->editing = false;

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Profil disimpan.');
    }

    public function newAddress(): void
    {
        $this->resetValidation();
        $this->reset('label', 'address', 'detail');
        $this->addressFormId = 0;
    }

    public function editAddress(int $id): void
    {
        $address = $this->user->addresses()->findOrFail($id);

        $this->resetValidation();
        $this->label = $address->label;
        $this->address = $address->address;
        $this->detail = (string) $address->detail;
        $this->addressFormId = $address->id;
    }

    public function cancelAddress(): void
    {
        $this->addressFormId = null;
    }

    public function saveAddress(Geocoder $geocoder, CustomerLocation $location): void
    {
        $validated = $this->validate([
            'label' => ['required', 'string', 'max:40'],
            'address' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'detail' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ], attributes: ['label' => 'nama alamat', 'address' => 'alamat', 'detail' => 'detail lokasi']);

        $existing = $this->addressFormId ? $this->user->addresses()->findOrFail($this->addressFormId) : null;
        $coordinates = $existing !== null && $existing->address === $validated['address']
            ? ['latitude' => $existing->latitude, 'longitude' => $existing->longitude]
            : $geocoder->search($validated['address']);

        $values = [
            'label' => $validated['label'],
            'address' => $validated['address'],
            'detail' => $validated['detail'] ?: null,
            'latitude' => $coordinates['latitude'] ?? null,
            'longitude' => $coordinates['longitude'] ?? null,
        ];

        if ($existing !== null) {
            $existing->update($values);
            $address = $existing;
        } else {
            $address = $this->user->addresses()->create([...$values, 'is_primary' => $this->addresses->isEmpty()]);
        }

        if ($address->is_primary) {
            $this->useForSearch($address, $location);
        }

        $this->addressFormId = null;
        unset($this->addresses);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: 'Alamat disimpan.');
    }

    public function makePrimary(int $id, CustomerLocation $location): void
    {
        $address = $this->user->addresses()->findOrFail($id);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($address) {
            $this->user->addresses()->update(['is_primary' => false]);
            $address->update(['is_primary' => true]);
        });

        $this->useForSearch($address, $location);
        unset($this->addresses);

        Flux::toast(variant: 'success', text: $address->label.' jadi alamat utama.');
    }

    public function deleteAddress(int $id): void
    {
        $address = $this->user->addresses()->findOrFail($id);
        $wasPrimary = $address->is_primary;
        $address->delete();

        if ($wasPrimary) {
            $this->user->addresses()->oldest()->first()?->update(['is_primary' => true]);
        }

        unset($this->addresses);
    }

    }
