<?php

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Services\Geocoder;
use App\Support\CustomerLocation;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Teknisi AC terdekat di Malang')] class extends Component {
    public string $address = '';

    public ?float $latitude = null;

    public ?float $longitude = null;

    public bool $showAddressWarning = false;

    public bool $locationOff = false;

    public function mount(CustomerLocation $location): void
    {
        $current = $location->current(auth()->user());

        if ($current !== null) {
            $this->address = $current['address'];
            $this->latitude = $current['latitude'];
            $this->longitude = $current['longitude'];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Typing a new address invalidates coordinates from an earlier lookup.
     */
    public function updatedAddress(): void
    {
        $this->latitude = null;
        $this->longitude = null;

        if (trim($this->address) !== '') {
            $this->showAddressWarning = false;
            $this->locationOff = false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Called from the browser after the Geolocation API returns a position.
     */
    public function useCoordinates(float $latitude, float $longitude, Geocoder $geocoder): void
    {
        $this->latitude = $latitude;
        $this->longitude = $longitude;
        $this->address = $geocoder->reverse($latitude, $longitude) ?? 'Lokasi saya ('.number_format($latitude, 4).', '.number_format($longitude, 4).')';
        $this->showAddressWarning = false;
        $this->locationOff = false;
    }

    public function locationDenied(): void
    {
        $this->locationOff = true;
    }

    public function searchService(string $slug, CustomerLocation $location, Geocoder $geocoder): void
    {
        $this->address = trim($this->address);

        if ($this->address === '') {
            $this->showAddressWarning = true;
            $this->dispatch('focus-address');

            return;
        }

        if ($this->latitude === null || $this->longitude === null) {
            $coordinates = $geocoder->search($this->address);
            $this->latitude = $coordinates['latitude'] ?? null;
            $this->longitude = $coordinates['longitude'] ?? null;
        }

        $location->set($this->address, $this->latitude, $this->longitude);

        $this->redirectRoute('search', ['layanan' => $slug], navigate: true);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function services(): Collection
    {
        return Service::orderBy('sort_order')->get();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function activeTechnicians(): int
    {
        return TechnicianProfile::published()->count();
    }
}; ?>

<?php

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Models\SearchLog;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Services\TechnicianSearch;
use App\Support\CustomerLocation;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Livewire\Attributes\Computed;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Title;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

new #[Layout('layouts::customer'), Title('Cari teknisi AC')] class extends Component {
    #[Url(as: 'layanan')]
    public string $service = 'cuci';

    #[Url]
    public int $radius = 5;

    #[Url(as: 'tersedia')]
    public bool $availableToday = false;

    #[Url]
    public string $badge = '';

    #[Url(as: 'urut')]
    public string $sort = TechnicianSearch::SORT_RELEVANT;

    public ?string $notice = null;

    public function mount(): void
    {
        if (! in_array($this->radius, config('sejuk.search_radius_options'), true)) {
            $this->radius = (int) config('sejuk.default_search_radius');
        }

        if ($this->selectedService === null) {
            $this->service = (string) $this->services->first()?->slug;
        }

        $this->notice = session('sejuk.rejected_notice');

        SearchLog::create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'service_id' => $this->selectedService?->id,
            'results_count' => $this->technicians->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function resetFilters(): void
    {
        $this->availableToday = false;
        $this->badge = '';
        $this->radius = (int) config('sejuk.default_search_radius');
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Service>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function services(): Collection
    {
        return Service::orderBy('sort_order')->get();
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function selectedService(): ?Service
    {
        return $this->services->firstWhere('slug', $this->service);
    }

    #[Computed]
    public function address(): ?string
    {
        return app(CustomerLocation::class)->current(auth()->user())['address'] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Technicians the customer chose to skip (e.g. after rejecting an estimate).
     *
     * @return list<int>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function hiddenTechnicianIds(): array
    {
        return array_map('intval', (array) session('sejuk.hidden_technicians', []));
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, TechnicianProfile>
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function technicians(): Collection
    {
        [$latitude, $longitude] = app(CustomerLocation::class)->coordinates(auth()->user());

        return app(TechnicianSearch::class)->search(
            latitude: $latitude,
            longitude: $longitude,
            serviceId: $this->selectedService?->id,
            radiusKm: $this->radius,
            availableToday: $this->availableToday,
            minimumBadge: TechnicianBadge::tryFrom($this->badge),
            sort: $this->sort,
            excludeIds: $this->hiddenTechnicianIds,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The next larger radius option to suggest when nothing is found.
     */
    #[Computed]
    public function widerRadius(): ?int
    {
        return collect(config('sejuk.search_radius_options'))->first(fn (int $option) => $option > $this->radius);
    }
}; ?>

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\Admin\FundsAndModerationTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payout;
use App\Models\Review;
use App\Models\SearchLog;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->admin = User::factory()->admin()->create();
    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->create(['business_name' => 'Budi Teknik AC', 'rating_avg' => 4.0, 'reviews_count' => 2]);
});

function forwardedOrder(TechnicianProfile $technician, int $total): Order
{
    return Order::factory()->for($technician, 'technician')->create([
        'status' => OrderStatus::Selesai,
        'final_total' => $total,
        'commission_amount' => (int) ($total * 0.1),
        'fund_status' => FundStatus::Diteruskan,
        'completed_at' => now(),
    ]);
}

it('records a payout for all forwarded orders of a technician', function () {
    $this->technician->payoutAccount()->create(['bank_name' => 'BCA', 'account_name' => 'Budi Santoso', 'account_number' => '1234567890']);
    $first = forwardedOrder($this->technician, 500000);
    $second = forwardedOrder($this->technician, 200000);
    $this->actingAs($this->admin);

    Livewire::test('pages::admin.funds')
        ->assertSee('Rp630.000')
        ->set("references.{$this->technician->id}", 'TRF-001')
        ->call('markTransferred', $this->technician->id)
        ->assertSee('Tidak ada saldo yang menunggu pencairan');

    $payout = Payout::sole();

    expect($payout->amount)->toBe(630000)
        ->and($payout->reference)->toBe('TRF-001')
        ->and($payout->account_number)->toBe('1234567890')
        ->and($first->refresh()->fund_status)->toBe(FundStatus::Dicairkan)
        ->and($second->refresh()->payout_id)->toBe($payout->id);

    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user)
        ->get(route('mitra.earnings'))
        ->assertSee('Ref. TRF-001');
});

it('refuses a payout when the technician has no bank account', function () {
    forwardedOrder($this->technician, 500000);
    $this->actingAs($this->admin);

    Livewire::test('pages::admin.funds')->call('markTransferred', $this->technician->id);

    expect(Payout::count())->toBe(0);
});

it('hides a review and adjusts the technician rating, then restores it', function () {
    $review = Review::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->create(['rating' => 1, 'comment' => 'Kata kasar']);
    $this->technician->update(['rating_avg' => 3.0, 'reviews_count' => 3]);
    $this->actingAs($this->admin);

    Livewire::test('pages::admin.reviews')->call('toggle', $review->id);

    expect($review->refresh()->is_hidden)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($this->technician->refresh()->reviews_count)->toBe(2)
        ->and($this->technician->rating_avg)->toBe(4.0);

    $this->get(route('technicians.show', $this->technician))->assertDontSee('Kata kasar');

    Livewire::test('pages::admin.reviews')->call('toggle', $review->id);

<?php

use App\Models\User;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

test('login screen can be rendered', function () {
    $response = $this->get(route('login'));

    $response->assertOk();
});

test('users can authenticate using the login screen', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'password',
    ]);

    $response
        ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('home'));

    $this->assertAuthenticated();
});

test('users can not authenticate with invalid password', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ]);

    $response->assertSessionHasErrorsIn('email');

    $this->assertGuest();
});

test('users with two factor enabled are redirected to two factor challenge', function () {
    $this->skipUnlessFortifyHas(Features::twoFactorAuthentication());

    Features::twoFactorAuthentication([
        'confirm' => true,
        'confirmPassword' => true,
    ]);

    $user = User::factory()->withTwoFactor()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'password',
    ]);

    $response->assertRedirect(route('two-factor.login'));
    $this->assertGuest();
});

test('users can logout', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('logout'));

    $response->assertRedirect(route('home'));

    $this->assertGuest();
});

<?php

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Notifications\ResetPassword;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->skipUnlessFortifyHas(Features::resetPasswords());
});

test('reset password link screen can be rendered', function () {
    $response = $this->get(route('password.request'));

    $response->assertOk();
});

test('reset password link can be requested', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.request'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class);
});

test('reset password screen can be rendered', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.request'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class, function ($notification) {
        $response = $this->get(route('password.reset', $notification->token));

        $response->assertOk();

        return true;
    });
});

test('password can be reset with valid token', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.request'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class, function ($notification) use ($user) {
        $response = $this->post(route('password.update'), [
            'token' => $notification->token,
            'email' => $user->email,
            'password' => 'password',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password',
        ]);

        $response
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('login', absolute: false));

        return true;
    });
});

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\CustomerAddress;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    Http::preventStrayRequests();
    Http::fake(['nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search*' => Http::response([['lat' => '-7.9500', 'lon' => '112.6200']])]);

    $this->customer = User::factory()->customer()->create(['phone' => '081200000001', 'phone_verified_at' => now()]);
    $this->actingAs($this->customer);
});

it('shows the phone badge and order summary', function () {
    Order::factory()->for($this->customer, 'customer')->status(OrderStatus::Selesai)->create();
    Order::factory()->for($this->customer, 'customer')->status(OrderStatus::Terjadwal)->create();

    Livewire::test('pages::account')
        ->assertSee('Nomor HP terverifikasi')
        ->assertSet('name', $this->customer->name)
        ->assertSee('Ringkasan pesanan');
});

it('updates personal info and drops phone verification when the number changes', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::account')
        ->call('edit')
        ->set('name', 'Dimas P.')
        ->set('phone', '+62 812-0000-0099')
        ->set('city', 'Batu')
        ->call('saveProfile')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    expect($this->customer->refresh())
        ->name->toBe('Dimas P.')
        ->phone->toBe('081200000099')
        ->city->toBe('Batu')
        ->phone_verified_at->toBeNull();
});

it('adds a geocoded address that becomes primary and the search location', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::account')
        ->call('newAddress')
        ->set('label', 'Kos Melati')
        ->set('address', 'Jl. Kertoraharjo')
        ->set('detail', 'Kamar 12')
        ->call('saveAddress')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertSee('Kos Melati');

    $address = CustomerAddress::sole();

    expect($address->is_primary)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($address->latitude)->toBe(-7.95)
        ->and(session('sejuk.location.address'))->toBe('Jl. Kertoraharjo');
});

it('switches the primary address', function () {
    $first = CustomerAddress::factory()->for($this->customer)->primary()->create(['label' => 'Kos']);
    $second = CustomerAddress::factory()->for($this->customer)->create(['label' => 'Rumah']);

    Livewire::test('pages::account')->call('makePrimary', $second->id);

    expect($second->refresh()->is_primary)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($first->refresh()->is_primary)->toBeFalse()
        ->and(session('sejuk.location.label'))->toBe('Rumah');
});

it('promotes another address when the primary one is deleted', function () {
    $primary = CustomerAddress::factory()->for($this->customer)->primary()->create();
    $other = CustomerAddress::factory()->for($this->customer)->create();

    Livewire::test('pages::account')->call('deleteAddress', $primary->id);

    expect(CustomerAddress::find($primary->id))->toBeNull()
        ->and($other->refresh()->is_primary)->toBeTrue();
});

it('cannot change someone else address', function () {
    $foreign = CustomerAddress::factory()->create();

    Livewire::test('pages::account')->call('deleteAddress', $foreign->id)->assertNotFound();

    expect(CustomerAddress::find($foreign->id))->not->toBeNull();
});

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\Customer\SearchTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Livewire\Livewire;

/**
 * Customer location used by every test: Jl. MT Haryono, Lowokwaru.
 */
beforeEach(function () {
    session(['sejuk.location' => [
        'address' => 'Jl. MT Haryono',
        'label' => null,
        'detail' => null,
        'latitude' => -7.9435,
        'longitude' => 112.6150,
    ]]);

    $this->service = Service::factory()->create(['slug' => 'cuci', 'name' => 'Cuci AC']);
});

function technicianOffering(Service $service, float $latitude, float $longitude, array $attributes = []): TechnicianProfile
{
    $technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->at($latitude, $longitude)->alwaysAvailable()->create($attributes);
    $technician->services()->attach($service);
    $technician->prices()->create(['service_id' => $service->id, 'note' => '0,5â€“1 PK', 'price_min' => 65000, 'price_max' => 80000]);

    return $technician;
}

it('lists only technicians within the chosen radius', function () {
    $near = technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9440, 112.6160, ['business_name' => 'Dekat AC']);
    $far = technicianOffering($this->service, -8.0300, 112.6150, ['business_name' => 'Jauh AC']);

    Livewire::test('pages::search', ['service' => 'cuci', 'radius' => 3])
        ->assertSee($near->business_name)
        ->assertDontSee($far->business_name);
});

it('puts promoted technicians above closer ones', function () {
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9436, 112.6151, ['business_name' => 'Paling Dekat AC']);
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9600, 112.6150, ['business_name' => 'Promosi AC', 'is_promoted' => true]);

    Livewire::test('pages::search', ['service' => 'cuci', 'sort' => 'terdekat'])
        ->assertSeeInOrder(['Promosi AC', 'Paling Dekat AC']);
});

it('ignores an expired promotion', function () {
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9436, 112.6151, ['business_name' => 'Paling Dekat AC']);
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9600, 112.6150, ['business_name' => 'Bekas Promosi AC', 'is_promoted' => true, 'promoted_until' => now()->subDay()]);

    Livewire::test('pages::search', ['service' => 'cuci', 'sort' => 'terdekat'])
        ->assertSeeInOrder(['Paling Dekat AC', 'Bekas Promosi AC']);
});

it('filters by minimum badge', function () {
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9440, 112.6160, ['business_name' => 'Baru Daftar AC', 'badge' => TechnicianBadge::Terdaftar]);
    technicianOffering($this->service, -7.9441, 112.6161, ['business_name' => 'Sertifikat AC', 'badge' => TechnicianBadge::Sertifikat]);

    Livewire::test('pages::search', ['service' => 'cuci'])
        ->set('badge', 'identitas')
        ->assertSee('Sertifikat AC')
        ->assertDontSee('Baru Daftar AC');
});

it('hides technicians that do not offer the selected service', function () {
    $other = Service::factory()->create(['slug' => 'bongkar']);
    technicianOffering($other, -7.9440, 112.6160, ['business_name' => 'Spesialis Bongkar']);

    Livewire::test('pages::search', ['service' => 'cuci'])
        ->assertDontSee('Spesialis Bongkar');
});

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\Mitra\EarningsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->travelTo(now()->setDate(2026, 10, 20)->setTime(10, 0));
    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->create();
    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user);
});

function finishedOrder(TechnicianProfile $technician, int $total, $completedAt, FundStatus $fund = FundStatus::Diteruskan): Order
{
    return Order::factory()->for($technician, 'technician')->offered(OfferStatus::Diterima)->create([
        'status' => OrderStatus::Selesai,
        'final_total' => $total,
        'commission_amount' => (int) ($total * 0.1),
        'fund_status' => $fund,
        'completed_at' => $completedAt,
    ]);
}

it('shows this month earnings against last month and the completion rate', function () {
    finishedOrder($this->technician, 500000, now()->subDays(3));
    finishedOrder($this->technician, 200000, now()->subMonth());
    Order::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->offered(OfferStatus::Diterima)->create(['status' => OrderStatus::Dibatalkan]);
    Order::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->offered()->create(['status' => OrderStatus::MenungguRespons]);

    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.dashboard')
        ->assertSee('Rp450.000')
        ->assertSee('+150% dari bulan lalu')
        ->assertSee('1 perlu tindakan')
        ->assertSee('67%')
        ->assertSee('2 dari 3 pesanan');
});

it('splits balances into held, ready to pay out, and paid out', function () {
    Order::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->create(['status' => OrderStatus::Dikerjakan, 'final_total' => 300000, 'fund_status' => FundStatus::Ditahan]);
    finishedOrder($this->technician, 500000, now());
    finishedOrder($this->technician, 100000, now()->subWeek(), FundStatus::Dicairkan);

    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.earnings')
        ->assertSee('Rp270.000')
        ->assertSee('Rp450.000')
        ->assertSee('Rp90.000');
});

it('saves the payout bank account', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.earnings')
        ->call('editAccount')
        ->set('bank_name', 'BCA')
        ->set('account_name', 'Budi Santoso')
        ->set('account_number', '1234-5678-90')
        ->call('saveAccount')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertSee('â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢7890');

    expect($this->technician->payoutAccount()->sole()->account_number)->toBe('1234567890');
});

it('rejects an invalid account number', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.earnings')
        ->call('editAccount')
        ->set('bank_name', 'BCA')
        ->set('account_number', '12')
        ->call('saveAccount')
        ->assertHasErrors(['account_number']);
});

<?php

use App\Enums\MediaType;

use App\Models\Service;

beforeEach(function () {

    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->create(['avg_response_minutes' => null]);
    $this->technician->services()->attach($this->service);
    $this->technician->prices()->createMany([
        ['service_id' => $this->service->id, 'note' => '0,5â€“1 PK', 'price_min' => 60000, 'price_max' => 85000],
        ['service_id' => $this->service->id, 'note' => '1,5â€“2 PK', 'price_min' => 85000, 'price_max' => 110000],
    ]);

    $this->order = Order::factory()->for($this->service)->for($this->technician, 'technician')->offered()->create(['ac_capacity' => '1.5', 'time_window' => TimeWindow::Siang]);

        ->assertOk()
        ->assertSee('Detail Pesanan Masuk')
        ->assertSee('Kirim Penawaran');
});

it('lets the technician decline so the customer can pick a backup', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.show', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->call('reject')
        ->assertRedirect(route('mitra.orders.index'));

    expect($this->order->refresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::CariCadangan)
        ->and($this->order->offers()->sole()->status)->toBe(OfferStatus::Ditolak);
});

it('prefills the estimate from reference prices for larger units', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.estimate', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->assertSet('price_min', 85000)
        ->assertSet('price_max', 110000)
        ->assertSet('time_window', 'siang');
});

it('sends an estimate and schedule to the customer', function () {
    $this->travel(4)->minutes();

    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.estimate', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('price_min', 90000)
        ->set('price_max', 120000)
        ->set('visit_date', now()->addDays(2)->toDateString())
        ->set('time_window', 'sore')
        ->call('submit')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order));

    expect($this->order->refresh())
        ->status->toBe(OrderStatus::EstimasiMasuk)
        ->estimate_min->toBe(90000)
        ->estimate_max->toBe(120000)
        ->scheduled_window->toBe(TimeWindow::Sore)
        ->response_deadline->toBeNull()
        ->and($this->order->offers()->sole()->status)->toBe(OfferStatus::Diterima)
        ->and($this->technician->refresh()->avg_response_minutes)->toBe(4);
});

it('rejects an estimate maximum below the minimum', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.estimate', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('price_min', 120000)
        ->set('price_max', 90000)
        ->call('submit')
        ->assertHasErrors(['price_max' => 'gte']);

    expect($this->order->refresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::MenungguRespons);
});

    $this->travel(16)->minutes();
    $this->artisan('orders:expire-responses');

    $this->get(route('mitra.orders.estimate', $this->order))->assertRedirect(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order));
});

it('keeps other technicians out of the order', function () {

    $this->actingAs($stranger->user)->get(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order))->assertForbidden();
    $this->actingAs($stranger->user)->get(route('mitra.orders.estimate', $this->order))->assertForbidden();
});

it('streams damage photos only to people on the order', function () {
    Storage::fake('local');
    $media = $this->order->media()->create([
        'path' => UploadedFile::fake()->create('unit.jpg', 100, 'image/jpeg')->store('order-media', 'local'),

    ]);

    $this->get(route('orders.media', $media))->assertOk();
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer)->get(route('orders.media', $media))->assertOk();
    $this->actingAs(TechnicianProfile::factory()->create()->user)->get(route('orders.media', $media))->assertForbidden();
});

it('lists incoming orders in the inbox', function () {
    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.index')
        ->assertSee('#'.$this->order->code)
        ->set('tab', 'riwayat')
        ->assertDontSee('#'.$this->order->code);

<?php

use App\Enums\DocumentType;
use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Enums\VerificationStatus;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    Http::preventStrayRequests();
    Http::fake([
        'nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search*' => Http::response([['lat' => '-7.9420', 'lon' => '112.6120']]),
    ]);
    Storage::fake('local');

    $this->service = Service::factory()->create(['slug' => 'perbaikan']);
});

function filledRegistration(Service $service): Testable
{
    return Livewire::test('pages::mitra.register')
        ->set('name', 'Budi Santoso')
        ->set('business_name', 'Budi Sejuk Teknik')
        ->set('phone', '0812 3456 7890')
        ->set('email', 'budi@example.com')
        ->set('password', 'password')
        ->set('area', 'Lowokwaru, Malang')
        ->set('service_id', $service->id)
        ->set('radius', 10)
        ->set('ktp', UploadedFile::fake()->create('ktp.jpg', 120, 'image/jpeg'))
        ->set('agreed', true);
}

it('registers a technician with a certificate and waits for verification', function () {
    filledRegistration($this->service)
        ->set('certificate', UploadedFile::fake()->create('sertifikat.pdf', 200, 'application/pdf'))
        ->call('register')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('mitra.verification'));

    $user = User::where('email', 'budi@example.com')->firstOrFail();
    $profile = $user->technicianProfile;

    expect($user->role)->toBe(UserRole::Technician)
        ->and($user->phone)->toBe('081234567890')
        ->and($profile->verification_status)->toBe(VerificationStatus::Pending)
        ->and($profile->badge)->toBe(TechnicianBadge::Terdaftar)
        ->and($profile->is_accepting_orders)->toBeFalse()
        ->and($profile->latitude)->toBe(-7.942)
        ->and($profile->services->pluck('id')->all())->toBe([$this->service->id])
        ->and($profile->documents->pluck('type')->all())->toEqualCanonicalizing([DocumentType::Ktp, DocumentType::Sertifikat]);

    $profile->documents->each(fn ($document) => Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($document->path));
    $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);
});

it('registers a technician with work experience instead of a certificate', function () {
    filledRegistration($this->service)
        ->set('competency', 'experience')
        ->set('experience_years', 5)
        ->set('reference_phone', '081398762210')
        ->set('experience_description', 'Servis AC rumah dan kos sejak 2020.')
        ->call('register')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    $profile = User::where('email', 'budi@example.com')->firstOrFail()->technicianProfile;

    expect($profile->experience->years)->toBe(5)
        ->and($profile->years_experience)->toBe(5)
        ->and($profile->documents->pluck('type')->all())->toBe([DocumentType::Ktp]);
});

it('requires a KTP photo and the chosen competency proof', function () {
    filledRegistration($this->service)
        ->set('ktp', null)
        ->call('register')
        ->assertHasErrors(['ktp' => 'required', 'certificate' => 'required']);

    expect(User::where('email', 'budi@example.com')->exists())->toBeFalse();
});

it('rejects a KTP that is not an image', function () {
    filledRegistration($this->service)
        ->set('ktp', UploadedFile::fake()->create('ktp.pdf', 100, 'application/pdf'))
        ->assertHasErrors(['ktp']);
});

it('requires the data statement to be accepted', function () {
    filledRegistration($this->service)
        ->set('certificate', UploadedFile::fake()->create('sertifikat.png', 120, 'image/png'))
        ->set('agreed', false)
        ->call('register')
        ->assertHasErrors(['agreed' => 'accepted']);
});

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\Orders\CustomerOrderTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\OfferStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Service;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->service = Service::factory()->create(['slug' => 'cuci', 'name' => 'Cuci AC']);
    $this->customer = User::factory()->customer()->create();
    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->alwaysAvailable()->create(['business_name' => 'Budi Teknik AC']);
    $this->technician->services()->attach($this->service);

    $this->actingAs($this->customer);
});

function customerOrder(array $states = []): Order
{
    $factory = Order::factory()->for(test()->customer, 'customer')->for(test()->service)->for(test()->technician, 'technician');

    foreach ($states as $state => $argument) {
        $factory = is_int($state) ? $factory->{$argument}() : $factory->{$state}($argument);
    }

    return $factory->create();
}

function nearbyTechnician(Service $service, float $offsetKm, array $attributes = []): TechnicianProfile
{
    $technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->at(-7.9435 + $offsetKm / 111, 112.6150)->alwaysAvailable()->create($attributes);
    $technician->services()->attach($service);

    return $technician;
}

    expect($this->order->refresh()->workProofs()->count())->toBe(1);

    $page->call('simulate', 'autoComplete')->assertSee('AC kamu sudah beres');

        ->fund_status->toBe(FundStatus::Diteruskan);
});

<?php

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\PaymentMethod;
use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Exceptions\InvalidOrderTransition;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Services\PaymentService;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Livewire\Livewire;

const SANDBOX = 'https://api.sandbox.midtrans.com';

beforeEach(function () {
    config(['services.midtrans.server_key' => 'SB-Mid-server-test', 'services.midtrans.is_production' => false]);
    Http::preventStrayRequests();

    $this->order = Order::factory()->withEstimate()->create(['status' => OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran, 'final_total' => 550000]);
    $this->order->costItems()->create(['label' => 'Jasa perbaikan', 'amount' => 550000, 'is_additional' => false]);
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer);
});

function signedNotification(Payment $payment, string $status, array $extra = []): array
{
    $notification = [
        'order_id' => $payment->gateway_ref,
        'status_code' => $status === 'settlement' ? '200' : '201',
        'gross_amount' => number_format($payment->amount, 2, '.', ''),
        'transaction_status' => $status,
        'transaction_id' => 'trx-123',
        'payment_type' => 'qris',
        ...$extra,
    ];
    $notification['signature_key'] = hash('sha512', $notification['order_id'].$notification['status_code'].$notification['gross_amount'].'SB-Mid-server-test');

    return $notification;
}

function pendingPayment(Order $order, PaymentMethod $method = PaymentMethod::Qris, array $attributes = []): Payment
{
    $payment = $order->payments()->create([
        'method' => $method,
        'amount' => $order->final_total,
        'status' => PaymentStatus::Pending,
        'expires_at' => now()->addMinutes(15),
        ...$attributes,
    ]);
    $payment->update(['gateway_ref' => $order->code.'-P'.$payment->id]);

    return $payment;
}

it('starts a QRIS payment that expires in 15 minutes', function () {
    Http::fake([SANDBOX.'/v2/charge' => Http::response([
        'status_code' => '201', 'transaction_id' => 'trx-1', 'transaction_status' => 'pending',
        'actions' => [['name' => 'generate-qr-code', 'method' => 'GET', 'url' => 'https://api.sandbox.midtrans.com/v2/qris/trx-1/qr-code']],
    ])]);

    Livewire::test('pages::orders.show', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('paymentMethod', 'qris')
        ->call('startPayment')
        ->assertSee('Bayar sebelum')
        ->assertSee('Scan kode QR ini');

    $payment = Payment::sole();

    expect($payment->status)->toBe(PaymentStatus::Pending)
        ->and($payment->gateway_ref)->toBe($this->order->code.'-P'.$payment->id)
        ->and($payment->qr_url)->toContain('/qr-code')
        ->and($payment->expires_at->toDateTimeString())->toBe(now()->addMinutes(15)->toDateTimeString());

    Http::assertSent(fn (Request $request) => $request->url() === SANDBOX.'/v2/charge'
        && $request['payment_type'] === 'qris'
        && $request['transaction_details']['gross_amount'] === 550000
        && $request['custom_expiry']['expiry_duration'] === 15
        && $request->hasHeader('Authorization', 'Basic '.base64_encode('SB-Mid-server-test:')));
})->freezeTime();

it('shows the virtual account number for bank transfers', function () {
    Http::fake([SANDBOX.'/v2/charge' => Http::response([
        'status_code' => '201', 'transaction_status' => 'pending', 'va_numbers' => [['bank' => 'bca', 'va_number' => '12345678901']],
    ])]);

    Livewire::test('pages::orders.show', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('paymentMethod', 'bca_va')
        ->call('startPayment')
        ->assertSee('1234 5678 901');

    Http::assertSent(fn (Request $request) => $request['bank_transfer']['bank'] === 'bca');
});

it('uses a company code and bill key for Mandiri', function () {
    Http::fake([SANDBOX.'/v2/charge' => Http::response(['status_code' => '201', 'transaction_status' => 'pending', 'bill_key' => '990011223344', 'biller_code' => '70012'])]);

    $payment = app(PaymentService::class)->start($this->order, PaymentMethod::MandiriVa);

    expect($payment->va_number)->toBe('990011223344')->and($payment->biller_code)->toBe('70012');
    Http::assertSent(fn (Request $request) => $request['payment_type'] === 'echannel');
});

it('charges OVO and DANA as QRIS', function (PaymentMethod $method) {
    Http::fake([SANDBOX.'/v2/charge' => Http::response(['status_code' => '201', 'transaction_status' => 'pending'])]);

    app(PaymentService::class)->start($this->order, $method);

    Http::assertSent(fn (Request $request) => $request['payment_type'] === 'qris');
})->with([PaymentMethod::Ovo, PaymentMethod::Dana]);

it('explains when Midtrans keys are missing', function () {
    config(['services.midtrans.server_key' => null]);

    Livewire::test('pages::orders.show', ['order' => $this->order])

it('starts the work and holds the funds when Midtrans confirms payment', function () {

    $this->postJson(route('webhooks.midtrans'), signedNotification($payment, 'settlement'))->assertOk();
    $this->postJson(route('webhooks.midtrans'), signedNotification($payment, 'settlement'))->assertOk();

    expect($payment->refresh()->status)->toBe(PaymentStatus::Paid)
        ->and($payment->paid_at)->not->toBeNull()

it('honors a late settlement after the local deadline', function () {
    $payment = pendingPayment($this->order, attributes: ['status' => PaymentStatus::Expired]);

    $this->postJson(route('webhooks.midtrans'), signedNotification($payment, 'settlement'))->assertOk();

    expect($payment->refresh()->status)->toBe(PaymentStatus::Paid)
        ->and($this->order->refresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Dikerjakan);
});

it('ignores a late expiry for a payment already confirmed', function () {
    $payment = pendingPayment($this->order);
    $this->postJson(route('webhooks.midtrans'), signedNotification($payment, 'settlement'));

    $this->postJson(route('webhooks.midtrans'), signedNotification($payment, 'expire'))->assertOk();

    expect($payment->refresh()->status)->toBe(PaymentStatus::Paid);
});

        ->and($order->offers->sole()->status)->toBe(OfferStatus::Menunggu)
        ->and($order->media->pluck('type')->all())->toEqualCanonicalizing([MediaType::Foto, MediaType::Video])
        ->and($order->statusLogs->sole()->to_status)->toBe(OrderStatus::MenungguRespons);

    $order->media->each(fn ($media) => Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($media->path));
});

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\Orders\VisitRemindersTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TimeWindow;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Notifications\OrderVisitReminder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->travelTo(now()->setTime(10, 0));

    $this->order = Order::factory()->withEstimate()->create([
        'status' => OrderStatus::Terjadwal,
        'scheduled_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString(),
        'scheduled_window' => TimeWindow::Pagi,
    ]);
});

it('reminds the customer and the technician a day before the visit, once', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $this->artisan('orders:send-reminders')->assertSuccessful();
    $this->artisan('orders:send-reminders')->assertSuccessful();

    Notification::assertSentToTimes($this->order->customer, OrderVisitReminder::class, 1);
    Notification::assertSentTo($this->order->technician->user, OrderVisitReminder::class, fn (OrderVisitReminder $reminder) => $reminder->timing === OrderVisitReminder::DAY_BEFORE);

    expect($this->order->refresh()->reminded_day_before_at)->not->toBeNull()
        ->and($this->order->reminded_hour_before_at)->toBeNull();
});

it('reminds again an hour before the visit', function () {
    $this->order->update(['reminded_day_before_at' => now()]);
    $this->travelTo(today()->addDay()->setTime(7, 10));
    Notification::fake();

    $this->artisan('orders:send-reminders')->assertSuccessful();

    Notification::assertSentTo($this->order->customer, OrderVisitReminder::class, fn (OrderVisitReminder $reminder) => $reminder->timing === OrderVisitReminder::HOUR_BEFORE);
    expect($this->order->refresh()->reminded_hour_before_at)->not->toBeNull();
});

it('does not remind for visits more than a day away or orders no longer scheduled', function () {
    $this->order->update(['scheduled_date' => today()->addDays(2)->toDateString()]);
    Order::factory()->withEstimate()->create(['status' => OrderStatus::Dibatalkan, 'scheduled_date' => today()->addDay()->toDateString()]);
    Notification::fake();

    $this->artisan('orders:send-reminders')->assertSuccessful();

    Notification::assertNothingSent();
});

it('renders the reminder email in Indonesian with a link to the order', function () {
    $mail = (new OrderVisitReminder($this->order, OrderVisitReminder::DAY_BEFORE))->toMail($this->order->customer);

    expect($mail->subject)->toBe('Pengingat: teknisi datang besok')
        ->and($mail->actionUrl)->toBe(route('orders.show', $this->order));
});

<?php

use App\Enums\FundStatus;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;

use App\Enums\PaymentStatus;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\WorkProof;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    Storage::fake('local');

    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->create(['jobs_count' => 10]);
    $this->order = Order::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->withEstimate()->create([
        'status' => OrderStatus::Dikerjakan,
        'final_total' => 550000,
        'fund_status' => FundStatus::Ditahan,
    ]);
    $this->order->costItems()->create(['label' => 'Jasa perbaikan', 'amount' => 550000, 'is_additional' => false]);
    $this->order->payments()->create(['method' => PaymentMethod::Qris, 'amount' => 550000, 'status' => PaymentStatus::Paid, 'paid_at' => now()]);
});

function photo(string $name): UploadedFile
{
    return UploadedFile::fake()->create($name, 200, 'image/jpeg');
}

function submitProof(Order $order, TechnicianProfile $technician): void
{
    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->submitProof($order, $technician, photo('sebelum.jpg'), photo('sesudah.jpg'), 'Freon diisi, kapasitor diganti.');
}

it('lets the technician upload before and after photos and mark the job done', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user);

    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.proof', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('before', photo('sebelum.jpg'))
        ->set('after', photo('sesudah.jpg'))
        ->set('note', 'Freon diisi ulang.')
        ->call('submit')
        ->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->assertRedirect(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order));

    $proof = WorkProof::sole();

    expect($this->order->refresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi)
        ->and($this->order->proof_submitted_at)->not->toBeNull()
        ->and($proof->round)->toBe(1)
        ->and($proof->note)->toBe('Freon diisi ulang.');

    Storage::disk('local')->assertExists([$proof->before_path, $proof->after_path]);
});

it('requires both photos', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user);

    Livewire::test('pages::mitra.orders.proof', ['order' => $this->order])
        ->set('before', photo('sebelum.jpg'))
        ->call('submit')
        ->assertHasErrors(['after' => 'required']);
});

it('does not accept proof before the customer has paid', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user);
    $this->order->update(['status' => OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran]);

    $this->get(route('mitra.orders.proof', $this->order))->assertRedirect(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order));
});

it('shows the proof and checklist to the customer', function () {
    submitProof($this->order, $this->technician);

    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer)
        ->get(route('orders.show', $this->order))
        ->assertSee('Cek dulu sebelum menandai selesai')
        ->assertSee('AC menyala dan dingin')
        ->assertSee('Freon diisi, kapasitor diganti.')
        ->assertSee($this->order->workProofs()->first()->photoUrl('sebelum'));
});

it('completes the order and forwards the funds minus commission when the customer confirms', function () {
    submitProof($this->order, $this->technician);
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer);

    Livewire::test('pages::orders.show', ['order' => $this->order->refresh()])
        ->call('confirmCompletion')
        ->assertSee('AC kamu sudah beres')
        ->assertSee('Lunas')
        ->assertSee('QRIS');

    expect($this->order->refresh())
        ->status->toBe(OrderStatus::Selesai)
        ->fund_status->toBe(FundStatus::Diteruskan)
        ->commission_amount->toBe(55000)
        ->completed_at->not->toBeNull()
        ->and($this->order->technicianPayout())->toBe(495000)
        ->and($this->technician->refresh()->jobs_count)->toBe(11);
});

it('sends the job back for a free rework with the customer complaint', function () {
    submitProof($this->order, $this->technician);
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer);

    Livewire::test('pages::orders.show', ['order' => $this->order->refresh()])
        ->call('$set', 'showReworkForm', true)
        ->set('complaint', 'Masih ada tetesan air.')
        ->call('requestRework')
        ->assertSee('Menunggu perbaikan ulang');

    expect($this->order->refresh())
        ->status->toBe(OrderStatus::PerbaikanUlang)
        ->rework_count->toBe(1)
        ->fund_status->toBe(FundStatus::Ditahan)
        ->and(WorkProof::sole()->complaint)->toBe('Masih ada tetesan air.');

    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user)
        ->get(route('mitra.orders.proof', $this->order))
        ->assertSee('Masih ada tetesan air.');

    submitProof($this->order->refresh(), $this->technician);

    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer)
        ->get(route('orders.show', $this->order))
        ->assertSee('Bukti baru setelah perbaikan ulang');

    expect($this->order->workProofs()->pluck('round')->all())->toBe([1, 2]);
});

it('sends the order to admin review after too many reworks', function () {
    $workflow = app(OrderWorkflow::class);

    foreach (range(1, 3) as $round) {
        submitProof($this->order->refresh(), $this->technician);
        $workflow->requestRework($this->order->refresh(), $this->order->customer, null);
    }

    expect($this->order->refresh()->status)->toBe(OrderStatus::Sengketa)
        ->and($this->order->rework_count)->toBe(3)

});

    $this->artisan('orders:auto-complete')->assertSuccessful();

    expect($this->order->refresh())

        ->and($this->order->statusLogs()->latest('id')->value('note'))->toContain('otomatis');
});

    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer)->get($proof->photoUrl('sesudah'))->assertOk();
    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user)->get($proof->photoUrl('sebelum'))->assertOk();
    $this->actingAs(TechnicianProfile::factory()->create()->user)->get($proof->photoUrl('sebelum'))->assertForbidden();
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer)->get(route('orders.proofs.photo', ['proof' => $proof, 'side' => 'lain']))->assertNotFound();
});

    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->confirmCompletion($this->order->refresh(), $this->order->customer);

    $this->actingAs($this->technician->user)
        ->get(route('mitra.orders.show', $this->order))

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\Feature\NotificationsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Actions\Technician\ReviewTechnicianVerification;
use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Enums\TechnicianBadge;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\TechnicianProfile;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\OrderUpdated;
use App\Notifications\TechnicianVerificationReviewed;
use App\Services\OrderWorkflow;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Livewire\Livewire;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->technician = TechnicianProfile::factory()->create();
    $this->order = Order::factory()->for($this->technician, 'technician')->offered()->create();
});

it('notifies the customer when the estimate arrives, not the technician who sent it', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->submitEstimate($this->order, $this->technician, 100000, 150000, now()->addDay(), $this->order->time_window, null);

    Notification::assertSentTo($this->order->customer, OrderUpdated::class, fn (OrderUpdated $notification) => $notification->title === 'Estimasi sudah masuk' && str_contains($notification->body, 'Rp100.000'));
    Notification::assertNotSentTo($this->technician->user, OrderUpdated::class);
});

it('notifies the technician of a new request', function () {
    Notification::fake();
    $customer = User::factory()->customer()->create();

    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->submit($customer, $this->technician, [
        'service_id' => $this->order->service_id, 'ac_capacity' => '1', 'ac_brand' => 'Sharp', 'address' => 'Jl. Kertoraharjo',
        'preferred_date' => now()->addDay()->toDateString(), 'time_window' => 'pagi',
    ]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($this->technician->user, OrderUpdated::class, fn (OrderUpdated $notification) => $notification->title === 'Pesanan baru masuk');
    Notification::assertNotSentTo($customer, OrderUpdated::class);
});

it('tells both sides when payment arrives through the gateway', function () {
    $this->order->update(['status' => OrderStatus::MenungguPembayaran, 'final_total' => 200000]);
    Notification::fake();

    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->markPaid($this->order->refresh());

    Notification::assertSentTo($this->order->customer, OrderUpdated::class, fn ($notification) => $notification->title === 'Pembayaran diterima');
    Notification::assertSentTo($this->technician->user, OrderUpdated::class, fn ($notification) => $notification->title === 'Pembayaran diterima, mulai kerjakan');
});

it('alerts admins about disputes', function () {
    $admin = User::factory()->admin()->create();
    $this->order->update(['status' => OrderStatus::MenungguKonfirmasi, 'rework_count' => 2]);
    Notification::fake();

    app(OrderWorkflow::class)->requestRework($this->order->refresh(), $this->order->customer, null);

    Notification::assertSentTo($admin, OrderUpdated::class);
});

it('tells the technician about the verification decision', function () {
    $pending = TechnicianProfile::factory()->pending()->create();
    Notification::fake();

    app(ReviewTechnicianVerification::class)->approve($pending, TechnicianBadge::Identitas, User::factory()->admin()->create());

    Notification::assertSentTo($pending->user, TechnicianVerificationReviewed::class, fn ($notification) => $notification->approved);
});

it('shows unread notifications in the bell and marks them read', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer);
    $this->order->customer->notify(new OrderUpdated($this->order, 'Estimasi sudah masuk', 'Setujui untuk menjadwalkan.', route('orders.show', $this->order)));

    Livewire::test('notification-bell')
        ->assertSee('Estimasi sudah masuk')
        ->assertSet('unreadCount', 1)
        ->call('markAllRead')
        ->assertSet('unreadCount', 0);
});

it('opens the order from a notification', function () {
    $this->actingAs($this->order->customer);
    $this->order->customer->notify(new OrderUpdated($this->order, 'Judul', 'Isi', route('orders.show', $this->order)));
    $notification = $this->order->customer->notifications()->sole();

    Livewire::test('notification-bell')
        ->call('open', $notification->id)
        ->assertRedirect(route('orders.show', $this->order));

    expect($notification->refresh()->read_at)->not->toBeNull();
});

==================== FILE: D:\projek\Manpro-Sejuk\tests\TestCase.php ====================

<?php

namespace Tests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    protected function skipUnlessFortifyHas(string $feature, ?string $message = null): void
    {
        if (! Features::enabled($feature)) {
            $this->markTestSkipped($message ?? "Fortify feature [{$feature}] is not enabled.");
        }
    }
}
